+"""Build connector test inputs with Core-resolved cache metadata."""
+
+from copy import copy
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import resolve_cache_hit_alignment_tokens, resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import FullAttentionSpec, KVCacheGroupSpec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs
+
+from vllm_ascend.core.kv_cache_interface import register_ascend_kv_cache_specs
+
+
+def make_resolved_cache_config(config, cache=None):
+    cache = copy(cache)
+    if cache is None:
+        num_layers = config.model_config.get_num_layers(config.parallel_config)
+        cache = SimpleNamespace(
+            kv_cache_groups=[
+                KVCacheGroupSpec(
+                    [f"model.layers.{index}.attn" for index in range(num_layers)],
+                    FullAttentionSpec(
+                        block_size=config.cache_config.block_size,
+                        num_kv_heads=1,
+                        head_size=1,
+                        dtype=torch.float32,
+                    ),
+                )
+            ],
+            num_blocks=4,
+            hash_block_size=None,
+            cache_hit_alignment_tokens=None,
+            prefix_cache_retention_interval=config.cache_config.prefix_cache_retention_interval,
+        )
+    if isinstance(getattr(cache, "hash_block_size", None), int) and isinstance(
+        getattr(cache, "cache_hit_alignment_tokens", None), int
+    ):
+        return cache
+    # EngineCore resolves the scheduler representation, then publishes the same
+    # metadata to worker plans (whose UniformType containers remain intact).
+    scheduler_cache = copy(cache)
+    scheduler_cache.kv_cache_groups = [copy(group) for group in cache.kv_cache_groups]
+    for group in scheduler_cache.kv_cache_groups:
+        if isinstance(group.kv_cache_spec, UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs):
+            group.kv_cache_spec = next(iter(group.kv_cache_spec.kv_cache_specs.values()))
+    register_ascend_kv_cache_specs()
+    scheduler_block_size, hash_block_size = resolve_kv_cache_block_sizes(scheduler_cache, config)
+    if not isinstance(getattr(cache, "hash_block_size", None), int):
+        cache.hash_block_size = hash_block_size
+    if not isinstance(getattr(cache, "cache_hit_alignment_tokens", None), int):
+        cache.cache_hit_alignment_tokens = resolve_cache_hit_alignment_tokens(
+            scheduler_cache, config, scheduler_block_size, cache.hash_block_size
+        )
+    if "prefix_cache_retention_interval" not in vars(cache):
+        cache.prefix_cache_retention_interval = config.cache_config.prefix_cache_retention_interval
+    return cache

+class ByteStore:
+    requires_exists_before_put = True
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.values = {}
+
+    def exists(self, keys):
+        return [int(key in self.values) for key in keys]
+
+    def put(self, keys, addresses, sizes):
+        for key, ptrs, lengths in zip(keys, addresses, sizes, strict=True):
+            self.values[key] = b"".join(ctypes.string_at(p, n) for p, n in zip(ptrs, lengths, strict=True))
+        return [True] * len(keys)

+def test_load_mask_with_eagle_does_not_double_prune_full_attention():
+    """Regression for silent KV corruption with MTP/EAGLE-3.
+
+    The recv side calls ``load_mask(block_hashes, token_len)`` where
+    ``token_len`` is already the eagle-pruned hit length from ``lookup``.
+    A second eagle pop here used to shorten the mask by one extra block;
+    ``process_tokens`` then yielded a chunk past the mask, which the worker
+    silently skipped — leaving the trailing block of the loaded prefix
+    uninitialized in local KV.
+    """
+    groups = [KVCacheGroupSpec(["L0"], _full(16))]
+    coord = _make_coord(groups, hash_block_size=16, use_eagle=True)
+    hs = _hashes(4)
+    cmap = ExternalCachedBlockPool(16, {(0, bytes(h)) for h in hs})
+    _masks, hit = coord.find_longest_cache_hit(hs, max_length=64, cached_block_pool=cmap)
+    assert hit == 48  # eagle popped 1 block
+
+    masks = coord.load_mask(hs, token_len=hit)
+    # Every chunk that process_tokens(token_len=48, ...) would yield must
+    # have a corresponding mask slot. process_tokens emits chunk_id 0..2
+    # (start=0, 16, 32), so the mask must be length 3, all True.
+    assert masks[0] == [True, True, True]
+

+    hit, and adopting that length resumes the recurrent state ahead of the

+def test_eagle_flag_propagates_to_all_merged_swa_groups():
+    """Regression for MTP x PD external-store 0% prefix hit.
+
+    DSV4 splits SWA layers into several KV cache groups sharing one spec, and
+    only the group containing the MTP layer is annotated ``is_eagle_group``.
+    The lookup merges equal-spec groups, applies the eagle drop to the merged
+    group, and requires each chunk hash to exist in EVERY member group — so
+    the save-side masks must eagle-shift every member, not just the annotated
+    one. Without propagation the non-annotated groups never store the eagle
+    proof-run chunks and every external lookup returns 0.
+    """
+    swa = _swa(block_size=16, sliding_window=32)
+    groups = [
+        KVCacheGroupSpec(["L0"], _full(64)),
+        KVCacheGroupSpec(["L1"], swa),
+        KVCacheGroupSpec(["L2"], swa, is_eagle_group=True),
+    ]
+    coord = _make_coord(groups, hash_block_size=16, use_eagle=True)
+    assert coord.eagle_group_ids == {2}
+    assert coord.eagle_reachable_group_ids == {1, 2}
+
+    # Save side: both SWA groups must produce identical (eagle-shifted) masks.
+    masks = coord.store_mask(128, num_prompt_tokens=130)
+    assert masks[1] == masks[2]
+
+    # Round trip: everything store_mask kept is in the store; the eagle
+    # lookup must then serve a non-zero hit (it was 0 before the fix).
+    hs = _hashes(128 // 16)
+    exists = set()
+    for g_idx, g in enumerate(groups):
+        ghashes = chunk_hashes_for_block_size(hs, 16, g.kv_cache_spec.block_size)
+        mask = masks[g_idx]
+        for i in range(128 // g.kv_cache_spec.block_size):

+    _masks, hit = coord.find_longest_cache_hit(
+        hs, max_length=128, cached_block_pool=ExternalCachedBlockPool(16, exists)
+    )
+    assert hit == 64

commits.message:
[Performance] Start layerwise KV prefetch after connector wait (#23107)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Split the layerwise AscendStore attention gate into independent load and
save gates. After `wait_for_kv_layer_from_connector()` returns, the load
gate can release future-layer prefetch without recording the current
layer's save event. The save gate still records the existing KV-ready
event at the attention boundary and submits the current-layer save
there. Recurrent layers retain their post-compute save path.

The connector wait opens the prefetch gate only for layerwise
AscendStore connectors, including when wrapped by a MultiConnector. The
attention boundary remains an idempotent fallback for callers that do
not open the load gate earlier.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Layerwise AscendStore can start next-layer KV prefetch earlier,
after the current layer load completes. This changes transfer timing; no
measured latency or throughput gain is claimed. The release note is in
`release_notes/fragments/23107.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

- `PYTHONPATH=. /Users/jc/miniconda3/envs/weijinqian_base/bin/pytest
--noconftest -q tests/ut/kv_transfer/test_attention_gates.py`: 7 passed.
Covers early load versus save recording, idempotence, attention-window
failure cleanup, cancellation, recurrent handling, and connector
routing.
- Ruff check and Ruff format check on all 16 changed Python files:
passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.
- Full pytest collection is blocked locally because the installed vLLM
lacks `vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning`.
- `bash format.sh ci` was attempted but could not complete locally
because pre-commit's Node environment setup failed. The Python Ruff
hooks were run directly.
- Ascend NPU execution, E2E correctness, and before/after performance
measurements remain pending on suitable hardware.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: The gate tests cover repeated
recording, cancellation, recurrent layers, and connector routing.
- [x] **Regression test**: The early load gate test fails if prefetch
opening also records the save event.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: Attention-window exception and
gate cancellation are covered.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: The tests assert event recording
and callbacks independently.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: Hardware benchmark results and regression
coverage are still pending.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15

[BugFix] Fix DeepSeek V4.1 pipeline-parallel metadata and vision loading (#22823)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Deferred A5 MLA metadata tasks can execute in learned first-consumption
order rather than builder creation order. A ratio-1 task running before
the designated ratio-2 refresher can hit `assert visible is not None`,
or consume visibility retained from a previous execution.

Let the first nonzero-ratio task actually executed compute visibility,
and retain reuse only within the same builder closure and executor
submission. A fresh submission identity forces recomputation for
subsequent submissions, including capture after warmup. Synchronous
calls outside an executor recompute conservatively. Task ordering,
events, PP partitioning and the visibility formula are unchanged.

The module-level `ContextVar` holds only a submission identity, not a
tensor or a process-wide batch cache. Its lifetime is the synchronous
producer submission; `finally` restores the previous
thread/context-local value on success or failure, including nested
scopes. Visibility tensors remain in their existing builder closures.

With image input enabled under PP, the upstream tower context replaces
nonlocal vision/aligner modules with `StageMissingLayer`. These modules
are not `None`, so the previous loader still attempted to look up absent
local parameters and could raise `KeyError: aligner.w1.bias`. Skip only
disabled vision components or parameters belonging to a missing PP
tower; keep unknown local parameters as errors. This includes
LostFox11's commit `87ba8aae985254e916bbea5d0f45750a11351dbd`,
cherry-picked with attribution.

Fixes #22824.

Related: #20508.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Fixes an A5 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash startup failure exposed by reordered
metadata producers under PP2, while preserving submission-local
visible-length reuse. The dependency is on producer ordering, so it is
not inherently limited to PP configurations. Also fixes enabled-ViT PP
startup when checkpoint vision weights belong to another pipeline stage.
No new flags, environment variables, operator rebuilds or PP partition
changes.

### How was this patch tested?

On the proposed patch based on upstream
`29f19afb04e61e9a613edf3225808499469d4d4e`:

```text
TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 pytest -q \
  tests/ut/worker/test_device_metadata.py \
  tests/ut/worker/test_graph_device_metadata.py \
  tests/ut/attention/test_dsa_v41_cp.py \
  tests/ut/attention/test_replay_visibility_sharing.py
218 passed
```

The CPU regression coverage uses the real executor and metadata builders
with device streams/events and operators mocked. It covers all six
ratio-task permutations, reordered first consumption, changing sequence
lengths across repeated submissions, one visibility computation per
submission, conservative synchronous recomputation, scope restoration
and producer exceptions. Existing graph lifecycle and cross-group
visibility-sharing tests are included.

Red/green confirmation: restoring the unmodified main A5 metadata
builder makes six reordered-producer cases fail at the original `assert
visible is not None` (6 failed, 6 passed in the focused executor-order
subset). Restoring this fix makes all 218 affected tests pass again.

Separate historical hardware validation used the equivalent production
fix on R136 `7a7ed073c481d5e3a2fc2194c5b879efb2d373c0`, CANN 9.3, DSL
0.8.2, eight Ascend A5 devices, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, PP2/PCP4/EP4/TP1,
DSpark5 and FULL_DECODE_ONLY:

- Six NPU graph captures and 18 input-changing replays exercised
visibility arithmetic and producer events, with a stub metadata
operator.
- Actual model boot/capture/replay, health and input-changing smoke
requests passed in both prefix modes.
- Six fixed-concurrency performance cases completed 3,448 formal
requests with zero failures and mean TPOT <=50ms. Cases: 4K/2K p0 C256;
16K/1K p0 C88; 64K/1K p0 C17; 128K/1K p0 C10; 128K/1K p90 C107;
1,024,000/1,024 p99 C384. Each used C1/N1 warmup and 4C formal requests,
with the same original input files and deployment configuration as the
independent-computation baseline.

These hardware results belong to the recorded R136 revision, not the
current PR head. Exact-head NPU validation and official CI remain
pending. The performance comparison was one batch per case, not repeated
A/B; this PR makes no isolated speedup claim. No full model accuracy
evaluation was performed. A pre-existing UB link alarm was retained in
the test environment record.

Additional ViT PP validation on R136 `7a7ed073c` with the equivalent
fix:

- CPU positive regression: 9 passed (image enabled/disabled,
first/nonfirst PP rank, prefixed/unprefixed checkpoint names, and strict
unknown-local-parameter rejection). An isolated negative control
restoring the old loader reproduces `KeyError: aligner.w1.bias` in both
enabled-ViT nonfirst-stage cases (2 expected failures, 7 passed).

layer split 13/27, Engram CPU offload and shared memory, memory
utilization 0.95, max length 4096, batch tokens 256, max sequences 1,
image limit 1, DSpark5 FULL_DECODE_ONLY. All four workers loaded weights
and completed graph capture. Health returned 200; text `2+2` returned
`4`; a solid red image returned `Red`, both HTTP 200.
- These are targeted startup/smoke checks on R136, not exact-head NPU
validation or a broad multimodal accuracy/performance evaluation. An
earlier utilization-0.9 run failed from insufficient KV cache after
loading weights; it did not encounter the vision loader KeyError.

On the current PR tree plus the R136-compatible test fixture: the
focused ViT CPU regression passed again (9 passed, 11 deselected).
Pinned Ruff 0.14.0 check/format, release-note YAML parsing and `git diff
--check` passed. Full `bash format.sh ci` was attempted in an isolated
Linux checkout, but pre-commit could not bootstrap its hooks because
`github.com` DNS resolution failed. Full pre-commit and official device
CI remain pending.

[Feature] Pick the quantized all-reduce min_numel default per TP on A2 (#22085)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

The int8 quantized all-reduce added in #19000 is gated by a payload
threshold, `min_numel`, and ships with a single default of `16777216`
elements (32 MiB of bf16 payload). One number cannot fit all TP degrees:
the break-even payload is strongly TP-dependent, because the bf16 HCCS
bandwidth grows with the group size while the fixed cost of the int8
path (`absmax`, 8 KiB fp32 `amax` all-reduce, quantize, dequantize) does
not.

Measured on 910B3 (A2) with a dependent chain of 16 collectives — the
timing protocol that reproduces serving TTFT to within 1–5% — the
break-even payload is:

| TP | break-even (chained) | shipped default | this PR | payload | gain
at the gate | gain at the serving shape |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 9–11 MiB | 32 MiB | **8,388,608** | 16 MiB | 1.45x | 1.82x @160
MiB |
| 4 | 21–23 MiB | 32 MiB | **16,777,216** | 32 MiB | 1.30x | 1.59x @80
MiB |
| 8 | 31–38 MiB | 32 MiB | **31,457,280** | 60 MiB | 1.11x | 1.24x @160
MiB |

(`min_numel` is in elements; a bf16 payload of `N` elements is `N * 2`
bytes, so `N = MiB * 524,288`.)

The crossing is reproducible with a dependent chain: on an idle 8-card
910B3 node it reports 10.6 / 22.7 / 43.7 MiB for TP=2/4/8 and gains of
1.47x / 1.28x / 1.07x at the three defaults, with a second pass landing
at ~10 / ~21 / 41.4 MiB. A later 37-point rescan of TP=8 in 64-token
steps puts the chained crossing at 31–38 MiB (see **End-to-end results**
below); end to end, int8 is still neutral at 50 MiB and first pays at 60
MiB.

So the single 32 MiB default is ~1.5x above break-even at TP=2 and TP=4,
where it is simply conservative, but it undershoots TP=8's end-to-end
crossing: int8 is neutral at 50 MiB (+0.17% TTFT) and only turns
profitable at 60 MiB (−1.89%). That band is reached as soon as
`max_num_batched_tokens` is lowered or a smaller hidden size is served,
which is exactly when a bad gate costs throughput.

### End-to-end results with these gates

`vllm bench serve` against this branch on top of #19000: Qwen3.8-27B
(dense, hidden 5120, 64 layers, bf16) on 1 node × 8×910B3,
`--no-enable-prefix-caching`, `--max-concurrency 1`, 16 prompts, 256
output tokens, 2 warmups; each payload point is measured in 2 sweeps and
the tables report the median. The payload is pinned by construction: a
prefill chunk of `L` tokens issues `[L, 5120]` bf16 collectives, i.e. `L
× 10,240` bytes, so `payload (MiB) = L / 102.4`.

| TP | gate payload | bf16 TTFT | int8 TTFT | **Δ TTFT** | Δ p99 TTFT |
Δ at 160 MiB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 16.0 MiB (L=1639) | 396.1 | 360.5 | **−8.99%** | −7.17% | −12.79%
|
| 4 | 32.0 MiB (L=3277) | 439.3 | 409.6 | **−6.77%** | −7.03% | −9.27% |
| 8 | 60.0 MiB (L=6144) | 466.9 | 458.1 | **−1.89%** | −1.80% | −4.65% |

At payloads that are still too small the two arms are indistinguishable
(TP=8 21.5 MiB +0.10%, 43.0 +0.03%, 50.0 +0.17%; TP=4 22.0 −0.18%; TP=2
10.0 −0.58%), which is the ±0.6% noise floor of this setup. TPOT is flat
everywhere (max deviation 0.08 ms): a decode step moves 1 token, i.e.
5120 elements = 10 KiB, three orders of magnitude below the smallest
gate.

TP=8 is the only gate that is not ~1.5× above its crossing, so the whole
band was swept:

| payload | L | bf16 TTFT | int8 TTFT | Δ TTFT | Δ p99 TTFT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 21.5 MiB | 2202 | 314.9 | 315.2 | +0.10% | +0.85% |
| 43.0 MiB | 4403 | 355.6 | 355.7 | +0.03% | +0.55% |
| 50.0 MiB | 5121 | 406.4 | 407.1 | +0.17% | +0.77% |
| **60.0 MiB** | 6144 | 466.9 | 458.1 | **−1.89%** | **−1.80%** |
| 80.0 MiB | 8192 | 604.1 | 595.2 | −1.48% | −1.19% |
| 100.0 MiB | 10240 | 749.0 | 732.5 | −2.20% | −2.26% |
| 160.0 MiB | 16384 | 1212.6 | 1156.2 | −4.65% | −5.57% |

The bf16 column is linear over the whole range (`TTFT ≈ 39 + 0.0717
ms/token`, seven points, residual ≤3.7%), and the bf16 anchors
re-measured in the 60/80/100 MiB session agree with the earlier session
within 0.2% at 21.5 / 43 / 50 / 160 MiB. **The end-to-end crossing sits
between 50 and 60 MiB**, which is why the TP=8 default is 60 MiB rather
than the 31–38 MiB collective crossing: a real forward keeps only 40–90%
of the isolated chain's gain.

A 37-point scan of the collective itself in 64-token steps (chained
protocol, 16 dependent collectives per window):

| payload | 40 | 45 | 50 | 60 | 80 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| bf16 | 0.698 ms | 0.770 | 0.858 | 0.990 | 1.300 |
| int8 | 0.691 | 0.727 | 0.784 | 0.891 | 1.124 |
| speedup | 1.01× | 1.06× | 1.09× | 1.11× | 1.16× |

bf16 is a straight line across the whole range (no message-size or
algorithm step); the chained crossing is 31–38 MiB (31 MiB fitting the
≥46 MiB region, 38 MiB from the 40/80 MiB endpoints). At 60 MiB the
chain promises 0.099 ms × 128 collectives = 12.7 ms against 8.8 ms
measured end to end.

The gate fires only where intended: with `min_numel=31457280` the
activation log shows `(6144,5120)` ×32, `(8192,5120)` ×32 and
`(10240,5120)` ×48, and no `(2202,5120)` / `(4403,5120)` /
`(5121,5120)`. `(16384,5120)` is the graph-capture dummy pass at
start-up. `total_input_tokens = 16 × L` in every result JSON confirms no
length jitter, and no doubled-length shape appears, so two requests
never merged into one chunk.

Accuracy is unaffected: GPQA-diamond (198 questions,
`max_out_len=130000`, no MTP) shows no significant delta at any TP —
TP=8 +1.52 pp (pooled p=0.52), TP=4 +0.25 pp (p=1.00), TP=2 −1.01 pp
(p=0.64).

What changes:

- `QuantizedAllReduceConfig.min_numel` becomes `int | None = None`.
`None` means "pick the measured default of the selected backend"; an
explicit value still wins and is still validated (`>= 1`).
- The int8 default is resolved in `QuantizedAllReduce.__init__` rather
than in the config object, because that is the first place where both
the real group size and the device check are known
(`_validate_preconditions` only sees `tensor_parallel_size`, and the
config is frozen).
- New `_DEFAULT_MIN_NUMEL_A2` / `default_min_numel(world_size,
device_type)`: 8,388,608 (16 MiB) at TP=2, 16,777,216 (32 MiB) at TP=4,
31,457,280 (60 MiB) at TP=8. The table is A2-only: an A5 int8
configuration that leaves `min_numel` at `null` is rejected at config
time, because A5 has no int8 payload calibration and reusing the A2
gates there could enable the path below its own crossing. On A2, degrees
that were not measured (3, 5–7) take the next larger entry, so the gate
never undercuts a measured break-even; groups larger than 8 ranks keep
bf16 as before.
- The MXFP8 backend that landed in #21508 has no per-TP calibration, so
it resolves `None` to its own `_DEFAULT_MIN_NUMEL = 16,777,216` (32
MiB). `min_numel` therefore keeps one meaning on both backends — "`None`
= the backend's measured default" — without inventing A5 numbers here.
- The start-up log prints the group and the resolved gate (`INT8
quantized all-reduce enabled (group=..., min_numel=..., max_q=...)`),
since that value is group-dependent.
- `distributed/device_communicators/quantized_all_reduce.py` is renamed
to `int8_all_reduce.py`: it only implements the int8 backend, while
MXFP8 lives in `mxfp8_all_reduce.py`. The config key and the backend
selection are unchanged.

> **Rebased onto `main` after #21508 landed.** Both PRs edit
`ascend_config.py`, the int8 all-reduce module and
`npu_communicator.py`; the resolution keeps #21508's `quant_dtype`
selection and MXFP8 routing intact and only splits the threshold by
backend: int8 uses the per-TP table below, MXFP8 keeps 32 MiB.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes, a configuration default:
`additional_config.quantized_all_reduce_config.min_numel` now defaults
to `null` instead of `16777216`, and `AscendConfig.unified_json` reports
`"min_numel": null`. On the int8 backend `null` means "the measured gate
for this TP degree"; on MXFP8 it means 32 MiB as before, so A5
deployments on the default backend see no change. If the int8 backend is
forced on A5, `min_numel` must be set explicitly, since the per-TP table
is calibrated on A2 only. Existing configs that set `min_numel`
explicitly are unaffected, and the feature is still opt-in via `enable`.
A release note fragment is added.

### How was this patch tested?

Unit tests on 8x910B3 (CANN 9.2.1, torch_npu 2.10.0):

- `tests/ut/distributed/device_communicators/test_int8_all_reduce.py` →
23 passed, including four new cases: per-TP defaults (2/4/8), "the
per-TP defaults resolve on A2 only" (an A5 wrapper without an explicit
value raises), "an unmeasured TP never resolves below a measured
break-even" (3 → TP=4 entry, 5/6/7 → TP=8 entry), and "an explicit
`min_numel` wins over the default".
- `tests/ut/test_ascend_config.py -k QuantizedAllReduce` → 13 passed,
including the new `min_numel=None` case, the A5-without-`min_numel`
rejection, and the backend-default cases from #21508.
- `tests/ut/distributed/device_communicators/test_mxfp8_all_reduce.py` →
7 passed (untouched by the semantics change, re-run because
`Mxfp8AllReduce` now accepts `None`).
- `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` clean on all touched Python
files.
- End-to-end `vllm bench serve` for every gate payload, plus the TP=8
payload sweep, the 37-point collective scan and the activation-log check
— all numbers are in **End-to-end results** above. Timings are only
meaningful on an idle node: with a co-tenant job on one card the same
sweep reported 3.4 ms instead of 2.6 ms for bf16 at 160 MiB and produced
no crossing at all.

The local container ships an older vllm than current `main`, so the full
`tests/ut/test_ascend_config.py` cannot run unmodified here: 72 tests
fail on the missing
`CompilationConfig.prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes`. To make sure
that is not caused by this change, I ran the same file on a clean
`origin/main` checkout: 98 passed + the same 72 failures, versus 101
passed + the same 72 failures here. The change adds three passing tests
and no failure.

The dependent-chain convention was validated against end-to-end serving
in #19000 (chained predicts −2.09 s at TP=2 / 8K against −2.07 s
measured; the single-call convention predicts −1.87 s). This PR does not
touch the data path — it only moves the dispatch threshold — so the
gates were re-derived from those sweeps and then confirmed end to end
above.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: new tests cover
`min_numel=None`, an explicit value that differs from the default, and
unmeasured TP degrees (3, 5–7).
- [ ] **Regression test**: not a bug fix; the existing wrapper tests
already pin the int8/bf16 dispatch boundary.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: unchanged, the existing
`min_numel` validator tests still cover `0` and negative values.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: the new tests assert the resolved
gate behaviour, not just that construction succeeds.
- [x] **Performance impact**: end-to-end data above — −8.99% / −6.77% /
−1.89% TTFT at the three gates, −12.79% / −9.27% / −4.65% at 160 MiB;
every default now sits at or above its measured crossing.

commits.message:
[Doc] Standardize HCCL execution timeouts to 3600 in model tutorials (#23163)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Model deployment tutorials use inconsistent `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT` example
values. Standardize all explicit `export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT` assignments
in model tutorials to `3600` seconds. This changes 84 assignments across
nine model documents: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash,
DeepSeek-V4-Pro, GLM5.2, Kimi-K2.6, Kimi-K3.1-Pro, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash,
Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. Six existing assignments
already use `3600`, bringing the total to 90 consistent model
assignments.

The branch is rebased onto the latest fetched upstream main. Non-model
tutorials are outside the scope of this change.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Documentation-only update to example launch commands. No library
defaults or runtime implementation are changed. No release note fragment
is required for this small documentation edit.

### How was this patch tested?

- Verified all 90 explicit model tutorial assignments are `3600` and the
diff contains only the 84 numeric substitutions in nine model documents.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- `python -m mkdocs build --site-dir ../docs-preview`: passed; existing
unrelated navigation/anchor notices remain.
- `bash format.sh ci`: attempted; the local run remains blocked
installing the actionlint environment. Full lint verification remains
for CI.
- NPU execution: CI testing only. No hardware performance or effective
timeout behavior is claimed.
- No runtime tests added for numeric documentation substitutions.

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: Reviewed every explicit
assignment in all model tutorials; no runtime boundary behavior was
added.
- [ ] **Regression test**: Not applicable to this documentation-only
change.
- [ ] **Error / failure path coverage**: No runtime paths changed; NPU
execution remains for CI.
- [ ] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: No new runtime tests were added.
- [ ] **Performance impact**: No performance claim is made.

[Doc] Clarify RFork command placeholders and identity header configuration (#23244)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Use `<planner_port>` from the planner command to show which values to
replace. Update the Chinese configuration table to match the English
guide and the RFork parser. An explicit JSON boolean takes precedence,
an absent key enables environment fallback, and any other JSON type
causes initialization to fail.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This change updates the RFork guide and its Chinese translation.

### How was this patch tested?

- Built the English and Chinese documentation with `bash
tools/rtd_build.sh` in strict mode and verified the placeholder and
configuration row in both rendered RFork pages.

[Misc] Remove upstreamed MiniMax DSpark config patch (#23158)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

vLLM v0.34.0 and verified main
([vllm#64111](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/64111)) now
natively resolve MiniMax-M3 DSpark's `dspark/` draft checkpoint,
preserve `DSparkMiniMaxDraftModel`, and derive draft quantization from
`quantization_config`.

Remove the duplicated Ascend subfolder path selection, architecture
restoration, and quantization pinning from
`SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__` in `patch_speculative_config.py`,
along with the now-unused `Path` import, obsolete unit tests, and
outdated patch header comment. Keep the existing `hf_config_override`
short-circuit to `draft_hf_override` unchanged so `minimax_m3_dspark.py`
does not need any signature changes.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No. This removes duplicated upstream compatibility logic while retaining
the Ascend-specific draft config and weight-header quantization
normalization.

- Focused CPU unit tests against verified vLLM main
`c410543d9ffff03f5f6c4a8c0ae1d3ad082c4a15`: `61 passed` across
`tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_speculative_config_dspark.py`,

`tests/ut/models/minimax_m3/test_minimax_dspark_adapter.py`.
- `mypy --follow-imports skip --check-untyped-defs` passed for Python
3.10, 3.11, and 3.12 on all 3 changed files.
- `pre-commit` hooks (`ruff-check`, `ruff-format`, `check-logger`,
`check-forbidden-imports`, `check-boolean-context-manager`,
`check-long-functions`, `check-symbolic-meta`), `py_compile`, and `git
diff --check` passed.
- Full Ascend tests are delegated to CI; no NPU hardware validation was
run locally.

[BugFix][MoE] Share the MegaMoE buffer for DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark on A5 (#23017)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with DSpark can have 384 routed experts and top-k 6
in the target, and 128 experts and top-k 3 in the draft. The different
expert counts create distinct FUSED_MC2 communication objects. On Atlas
A5, creating two CANN MegaMoE buffers on the same communicator and op
tag can leave the second context with invalid peer addresses during
startup profiling. This PR follows up on #21727 and its revert #22964.

After the MRv2 DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark loader returns, it attempts sharing
only when the draft executes MoE, the hardware supports the A5 CANN MXFP
channel, MegaMoE is enabled and FUSED_MC2 is selected. A target and
draft with different expert counts can share if they execute serially,
use the same supported routed quantization and hidden width, have
compatible communication parameters, and the draft fits the target
buffer. The participating ranks must agree.

On CANN r148 the target and draft can use different expert counts on the
same communicator and op tag when they run serially, their communication
attributes match, and the draft fits the target allocation. The target
owns the allocation. The draft view retains that context and supplies
its own expert count and top-k.

After the layout checks, all ranks compare the draft's requirements with
the actual target allocation using the installed CANN size query. If the
target owns a buffer on this group and any rank rejects sharing, model
loading fails before the draft can allocate a second buffer on the same
tag.

Across sleep/wake, the shared buffer preserves the captured context
address. If the CANN factory raises on any rank, all ranks require a
fresh MC2 group before retrying because CANN may already have registered
the tag. Failures after a successful allocation can retry over that
allocation.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Eligible target/draft pairs on A5 reuse one MegaMoE buffer. Equal expert
counts and layouts rejected by the initial eligibility checks follow
their existing initialization paths. A final compatibility check that
fails after the current group has been claimed reports a startup error.
A3 skips the sharing check at the hardware gate. Relative to the PR
base, the quantization modules, the unquantized MoE weight path, and the
platform communication selector are unchanged.

### How was this patch tested?

#### CPU regression tests

The following runs cover earlier revisions of this PR.

| Source and test coverage | Result |
| --- | --- |
| #23017 focused suite with the repository's vLLM pin (`c410543d9`) |
732 passed |
| #23017 focused suite with the image's vLLM (`4ba787ec9`) | 725 passed,
7 skipped |
| #23017 and #21830 together with the repository's vLLM pin | 1069
passed |
| #23017 and #21830 together with the image's vLLM, rerun after the
test-file rename in 112's `lhf_r148` | 1062 passed, 7 skipped |

The core cases are in `tests/ut/ops/test_dspark_mega_moe_buffer.py`.
They cover a compatible 384/128 pair, equal expert counts, A3 and A5
hardware profiles, W4A8 target with an unquantized draft, existing draft
buffers, capacity checks, rank disagreement, and sleep/wake. The
incompatible-quantization cases verify that the existing buffers and
transport registry entries retain their identities. The wider suite
covers MoE, quantization, model loading, graph configuration, and other
model paths. A two-process CPU Gloo test exercised rank-local release
failure and collective retry with a simulated allocator.

On the review revision, three new regression cases failed against the
previous implementation and passed with the fix. They cover a local
capacity veto, a peer capacity veto, and a factory failure after tag
registration. The 12-file suite passed all 596 tests against the
repository's paired vLLM (`c410543d9`). A two-rank Gloo test injected
factory errors on one rank and on both ranks, verified that no rank
reallocated on the failed group, and recovered on a fresh group. CANN
allocation failures were simulated in this test.

#### A5 hardware validation

The two earlier runs used DeepSeek V4.1 Flash W4A8MXFP with five-token
DSpark, the CANN 9.3.0 r148 image (`9722b0304456`), and #23017 together
with #21830. MegaMoE was explicitly enabled with `enable_fused_mc2=2`.

- **1P1D on 107 and 108.** All eight Prefill ranks shared the target's
MegaMoE context with the draft and submitted the CANN MegaMoE kernel for
both models. Short, long, and decode requests returned HTTP 200, with
the same text and token IDs as the `dispatch_ffn_combine` baseline. A
separate fresh 2493-token prompt exercised Mooncake KV transfer and
produced 32 output tokens. The MegaMoE run recorded 33 draft proposals
and 80 accepted tokens.
- **Colocated Prefill and Decode on 112 in `lhf_r148`.** DP8/TP1/EP8
started with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`. All eight ranks confirmed that the
384-expert/top-6 target and 128-expert/top-3 draft had the same context,
device address, and buffer owner. All 22 requests returned HTTP 200,
including 11 long prompts of 2492 tokens. After the initial pair, four
serial calls and two eight-way concurrent rounds exercised all eight DP
ranks. The repeated rounds added 136 draft proposals and 218 accepted
tokens. All responses contained the expected answer. In 15 of 20
repeated calls, generated token IDs matched the corresponding initial
response. Five concurrent long responses differed in tokens after the
correct answer. The health check still returned HTTP 200 after the last
round.

**Review revision on A5 with EPLB enabled.** The Prefill and Decode
roles ran separately on the same eight A5 devices with the openEuler
CANN 9.3.0 r148 image (`9bd8129dbc44`), the reviewed MegaMoE changes and
#21830 on the image's vLLM-Ascend base. Both used DP8/TP1/EP8, W4A8MXFP,
five-token DSpark, `enable_fused_mc2=3`, and EPLB with 16 redundant
target experts. On all eight ranks in both roles, the 400-expert/top-6
target and 128-expert/top-3 draft shared the same context object, device
address and buffer owner.

- **Prefill, eager.** Six requests sent directly to the producer
returned HTTP 200 and generated 1, 1, 1, 8, 16 and 32 tokens.
Speculative decoding counters recorded 130 proposed tokens and 29
accepted tokens.
- **Decode, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`.** All eight API ranks became ready.
Graph capture completed for all 41 target and 37 draft sizes.

Native HCCL sleep/wake, formal accuracy evaluation, and throughput
benchmarking remain open.

@@ -0,0 +1,247 @@
+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-11-25 08:12+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-11-25 08:12+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid "# AI Code Review"
+msgstr "# AI 代码审查"
+
+msgid ""
+"The AI review agent provides deep, on-demand code review for pull requests. "
+"It complements — never replaces — human review: first-pass screening "
+"(CODEOWNERS routing, gemini-code-assist comments) and CI run automatically "
+"on every PR, while the AI review agent handles the deep rounds that a "
+"reviewer explicitly requests. The agent can never approve or merge; its "
+"verdict is advisory input for the human reviewer."
+msgstr ""
+"AI 审查 agent 为 pull request 提供深入的按需代码审查。它补充——而非取代——人工审查：第一轮筛查（CODEOWNERS "
+"路由、gemini-code-assist 评论）和 CI 会在每个 PR 上自动运行，而 AI 审查 agent 负责处理审查者明确请求的深度轮次。该"
+" agent 永远不能批准或合并；其结论仅作为人工审查者的参考输入。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The mechanism was proposed in [RFC #21451](https://github.com/vllm-"
+"project/vllm-ascend/issues/21451) and is currently in a **gray release** "
+"(limited reviewers, opt-in per PR)."
+msgstr ""
+"该机制在 [RFC #21451](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/21451) "
+"中提出，目前处于**灰度发布**阶段（限定审查者，按 PR 选择加入）。"
+
+msgid "## How it works, end to end"
+msgstr "## 端到端工作原理"
+
+msgid "### Triggering and the gray-release gate"
+msgstr "### 触发方式与灰度发布门禁"
+
+msgid ""
+"- A reviewer with write permission applies the `ai-review` label to a PR.\n"
+"- The reviewer applying the label must be listed in `.github/agent-review/allowlist.txt`. If that reviewer is missing from the list, the agent posts a notice and removes the label. The gray release scales by editing this file; removing lines rolls it back with no code change.\n"
+"- During the gray release the agent's PR comments are posted by the maintainer's bot account, with the summary headed **AI review · DeepSeek Harness headless · POC pilot**. The bot appends an Actions link to accepted command comments and explains rejections on the original comment."
+msgstr ""
+"- 具有写权限的审查者为某个 PR 添加 `ai-review` 标签。\n"
+"- 添加该标签的审查者必须列在 `.github/agent-review/allowlist.txt` 中。如果该审查者不在列表中，agent 会发布通知并移除该标签。灰度发布通过编辑此文件来扩大范围；删除行即可回滚，无需改动代码。\n"
+"- 在灰度发布期间，agent 的 PR 评论由维护者的 bot 账号发布，摘要标题为 **AI review · DeepSeek Harness headless · POC pilot**。该 bot 会在已接受的命令评论后附上 Actions 链接，并在原始评论中说明拒绝原因。"
+
+msgid "### Review rounds"
+msgstr "### 审查轮次"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each round is one agent invocation. The orchestrator assembles the prompt "
+"deterministically:"
+msgstr "每一轮即一次 agent 调用。编排器以确定性的方式组装 prompt："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. the output protocol (finding format, severities and updates),\n"
+"2. a working-environment section (where the PR code, docs and guidelines live),\n"
+"3. a knowledge-base map — file paths plus rule IDs, not full contents,\n"
+"4. the list of knowledge-base domains the PR touches (resolved from `domains.yaml`),\n"
+"5. the PR diff from the merge base to the current head, all previous findings, and the triggering comment, if any. A truncated diff cannot pass review."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 输出协议（发现项格式、严重级别与更新方式），\n"
+"2. 工作环境说明部分（PR 代码、文档和指南所在的位置），\n"
+"3. 知识库地图——文件路径加上规则 ID，而非完整内容，\n"
+"4. PR 涉及的知识库领域列表（由 `domains.yaml` 解析得出），\n"
+"5. 从 merge base 到当前 head 的 PR diff、所有既往发现项，以及触发该轮审查的评论（若有）。被截断的 diff 无法通过审查。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The agent reads the referenced checklist files itself from the checked-out "
+"repository and cites only rules it has actually read (every finding has a "
+"file path, a rule ID and a severity, with a line number for inline "
+"findings)."
+msgstr ""
+"agent 会自行从检出的仓库中读取所引用的 checklist 文件，并且只引用它实际读过的规则（每条发现项都包含文件路径、规则 ID "
+"和严重级别，行内发现项还会附带行号）。"
+
+msgid "### Multi-round interaction and termination"
+msgstr "### 多轮交互与终止"
+
+msgid ""
+"The bot updates one PR summary comment. Its hidden `ai-review-state` JSON "
+"block records the reviewed commit, published rounds and finding history. A "
+"round counts when the bot publishes its result or a notice that the code "
+"changed during review. If a run fails before publication, a rerun starts a "
+"fresh review from the last published summary."
+msgstr ""
+"bot 只更新同一条 PR 摘要评论。其隐藏的 `ai-review-state` JSON 块记录已审查的 commit、已发布的轮次和发现项历史。当"
+" bot "
+"发布审查结果，或发布“审查期间代码已变更”的通知时，该轮次才计入统计。如果某次运行在发布之前失败，重跑将从最近一次已发布的摘要开始一次全新的审查。"
+
+msgid "| Event | Effect |"
+msgstr "| 事件 | 影响 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| PR author or reviewer with write permission comments `/ai-review` | "
+"Request one review of the current PR. Include explanations for multiple "
+"findings in the same top-level comment. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| PR 作者或具有写权限的审查者评论 `/ai-review` | 请求对当前 PR "
+"进行一次审查。若有多项发现项需要说明，请在同一条顶层评论中一并给出。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Author pushes a commit | Revoke `ai-review-passed`. The next `/ai-review` "
+"reviews all changes together. |"
+msgstr "| 作者推送 commit | 撤销 `ai-review-passed`。下一次 `/ai-review` 会一并审查所有变更。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Reviewer comments `/ai-review-waive F003 reason` or `/ai-review-waive all "
+"reason` | Waive one or all open findings for the reviewed commit. Existing "
+"inline comments show `[WAIVED by @user]`. The bot updates the verdict "
+"without calling the agent. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 审查者评论 `/ai-review-waive F003 reason` 或 `/ai-review-waive all reason` | "
+"对已审查的 commit 豁免一项或全部未解决的发现项。已有的行内评论会显示 `[WAIVED by @user]`。bot 会在不调用 agent "
+"的情况下更新结论。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Reviewer removes the label or comments `/ai-review-stop` | Stop review and"
+" remove both labels. Wait for the Stop workflow to finish before reapplying "
+"`ai-review`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 审查者移除标签或评论 `/ai-review-stop` | 停止审查并移除两个标签。请等待 Stop workflow 执行完毕后再重新添加 "
+"`ai-review`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Review covers the full diff, no MUST-FIX remains open and no human "
+"decision is pending | The orchestrator applies `ai-review-passed`. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 审查覆盖完整 diff、没有未解决的 MUST-FIX，且没有待定的人工决策 | 编排器添加 `ai-review-passed`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Round cap reached (5 per commit) | Push changes and request review again, "
+"or ask an allowlisted reviewer to restart the session. |"
+msgstr "| 达到轮次上限（每个 commit 5 轮） | 推送变更并再次请求审查，或请白名单中的审查者重启会话。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Session budget exhausted (15 published rounds) | An allowlisted reviewer "
+"can remove and reapply the label to reset both counts. Existing findings are"
+" retained. |"
+msgstr "| 会话预算耗尽（已发布 15 轮） | 白名单中的审查者可以移除并重新添加标签，以重置两个计数。已有的发现项会保留。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each PR allows one running review job and one pending job. When another "
+"authorized request enters a full queue, it replaces the pending job."
+msgstr "每个 PR 允许存在一个正在运行的审查任务和一个待处理任务。当另一个已授权的请求进入已满的队列时，它会替换掉待处理任务。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`ai-review-passed` is **not an approve**. Human review remains the merge "
+"gate."
+msgstr "`ai-review-passed` **并不是批准**。人工审查仍然是合并的门禁。"
+
+msgid "## For PR authors"
+msgstr "## 面向 PR 作者"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. When you want a deep review, ask an allowlisted reviewer to apply the `ai-review` label to your PR.\n"
+"2. Read the summary comment for the verdict and the full list of findings. The agent also posts findings inline when it can attach them to a changed line.\n"
+"3. Fix what is marked `MUST-FIX` and push your changes. When ready, add a new **top-level PR comment** starting with `/ai-review`. Inline replies do not start a round.\n"
+"4. Everything is optional: without the label your PR flow is unchanged."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 当你需要深度审查时，请白名单中的审查者为你的 PR 添加 `ai-review` 标签。\n"
+"2. 阅读摘要评论，了解审查结论和完整的发现项列表。当 agent 能把发现项关联到某个变更行时，它也会发布行内评论。\n"
+"3. 修复标记为 `MUST-FIX` 的问题并推送变更。准备好后，添加一条以 `/ai-review` 开头的**新的顶层 PR 评论**。行内回复不会启动新一轮审查。\n"
+"4. 一切均为可选：不添加标签时，你的 PR 流程保持不变。"
+
+msgid "## Knowledge base maintenance"
+msgstr "## 知识库维护"
+
+msgid ""
+"The review rules live in `.github/agent-review/` and follow the project's "
+"ownership model — the people who own a module own the review rules for it:"
+msgstr "审查规则位于 `.github/agent-review/` 下，并遵循项目的归属模型——拥有某个模块的人同时拥有该模块的审查规则："
+
+msgid ""
+"- **Ownership is enforced by CODEOWNERS.** Each `L2/<domain>/` directory gets one CODEOWNERS entry naming that domain's owners (later entries win over the `/.github` wildcard). Editing a domain's rules then requires those owners' approval — the same gate as editing the code itself.\n"
+"- **Updating rules** is an ordinary PR against the checklist file. Changes are effective for the next review round; there is no deployment step.\n"
+"- **Adding a domain** takes three steps: create `L2/<domain>/checklist.md` with stable rule IDs (`L2-<domain>#slug`), add a coarse glob entry to `domains.yaml`, append the CODEOWNERS entry. Keep domains coarse — per-file directories are explicitly avoided.\n"
+"- **Rule discipline**: rule IDs are stable API (findings cite them); every rule must be decidable from the diff and repository files (things needing test runs or hardware belong to human review); explicitly exclude what the agent should not report."
+msgstr ""
+"- **归属由 CODEOWNERS 强制执行。** 每个 `L2/<domain>/` 目录对应一条 CODEOWNERS 条目，指定该领域的负责人（靠后的条目优先于 `/.github` 通配符）。因此编辑某个领域的规则需要这些负责人批准——与编辑代码本身的门禁相同。\n"
+"- **更新规则**是针对 checklist 文件的普通 PR。变更将在下一轮审查中生效，无需部署步骤。\n"
+"- **新增领域**需要三个步骤：创建含稳定规则 ID（`L2-<domain>#slug`）的 `L2/<domain>/checklist.md`，在 `domains.yaml` 中添加一条粗粒度的 glob 条目，追加 CODEOWNERS 条目。领域应保持粗粒度——明确避免按文件划分目录。\n"
+"- **规则纪律**：规则 ID 是稳定的 API（发现项会引用它们）；每条规则都必须能根据 diff 和仓库文件判定（需要运行测试或依赖硬件的应归入人工审查）；明确排除 agent 不应报告的内容。"
+
+msgid ""
+"During the gray release, maintainer feedback on the agent's inline comments "
+"(agree/disagree/corrections) is the main input for checklist iteration. "
+"Collect it and land checklist updates in small weekly batches rather than "
+"one change per finding."
+msgstr ""
+"灰度发布期间，维护者对 agent 行内评论的反馈（同意 / 不同意 / "
+"纠正）是检查清单迭代的主要输入。请收集这些反馈，并以每周小批量的方式提交检查清单更新，而不是每发现一个问题就修改一次。"
+
+msgid "## Components"
+msgstr "## 组件"
+
+msgid "| Path | Role |"
+msgstr "| 路径 | 作用 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `.github/workflows/ai_review.yml` | trigger orchestration (label / comment"
+" / push), gates, agent job on the self-hosted CPU pool |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `.github/workflows/ai_review.yml` | 触发编排（标签 / 评论 / push）、门禁，以及在自托管 CPU "
+"资源池上运行的 agent 任务 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `.github/workflows/scripts/ai_review.py` | state machine, prompt assembly,"
+" finding parsing, inline comment posting |"
+msgstr "| `.github/workflows/scripts/ai_review.py` | 状态机、提示词组装、问题解析、行内评论发布 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `.github/workflows/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.ai-review` | preinstalled agent "
+"image (Node + dsh CLI) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `.github/workflows/dockerfiles/Dockerfile.ai-review` | 预装 agent 的镜像（Node +"
+" dsh CLI） |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `.github/workflows/_schedule_ai_review_image_build.yaml` | image build "
+"workflow (Dockerfile changes or manual dispatch) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `.github/workflows/_schedule_ai_review_image_build.yaml` | "
+"镜像构建工作流（Dockerfile 变更或手动触发） |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `.github/agent-review/` | instructions, knowledge base, allowlist, domain "
+"registry |"
+msgstr "| `.github/agent-review/` | 指令、知识库、允许列表、领域注册表 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The agent engine is deliberately decoupled: the orchestrator invokes a "
+"configurable command (a repository variable), so the underlying engine can "
+"be replaced without workflow surgery."
+msgstr "agent 引擎有意做了解耦：编排器调用一个可配置的命令（仓库变量），因此无需改动工作流即可替换底层引擎。"

 msgstr "详细信息："
 
-msgid ""
-"1. (**Token level**) Use a simple formula to calculate `block table indices`: `request indices * K + positions / block size`. So it equals `[0 * 6 + 0 / 2, 0 * 6 + 1 / 2, 0 * 6 + 2 / 2, 1 * 6 + 0 / 2, 1 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 0 / 2, 2 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 2 / 2, 2 * 6 + 3 / 2, 2 * 6 + 4 / 2] = [0, 0, 1, 6, 6, 12, 12, 13, 13, 14]`. This could be used to select `device block number` from `block table`.\n"
-"2. (**Token level**) Use `block table indices` to select out `device block number` for each scheduled token. The pseudocode is `block_numbers = block_table[block_table_indices]`. So `device block number=[1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6]`\n"
-"3. (**Token level**) `block offsets` could be computed by `block offsets = positions % block size = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]`.\n"
-"4. Finally, use `block offsets` and `device block number` to create `slot mapping`: `device block number * block size + block_offsets = [2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]`"

@@ -465,3 +414,54 @@ msgstr "#### 获取输入"
 
 msgid "#### Build inputs attention metadata"
 msgstr "#### 构建输入注意力元数据"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `query start location`: start and end location of each request corresponding to the scheduled tokens.\n"
+"- `sequence length`: length of each request including both computed tokens and newly scheduled tokens.\n"
+"- `number of computed tokens`: number of computed tokens for each request.\n"
+"- `number of requests`: number of requests in this batch.\n"
+"- `number of tokens`: total number of scheduled tokens in this batch.\n"
+"- `block table`: translates the logical address (within its sequence) of each block to its global physical address in the device's memory.\n"
+"- `max query len`: the longest scheduled tokens length in this request batch.\n"
+"- `slot mapping`: indices of each token that input token will be stored into.\n"
+"- `attention mask`: mask matrix applied to attention scores before softmax to control which tokens can attend to each other (usually a causal attention)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `query start location`：每个请求对应的已调度 token 的起始和结束位置。\n"
+"- `sequence length`：每个请求的长度，包含已计算的 token 和新调度的 token。\n"
+"- `number of computed tokens`：每个请求已计算的 token 数量。\n"
+"- `number of requests`：该批次中的请求数量。\n"
+"- `number of tokens`：该批次中已调度 token 的总数。\n"
+"- `block table`：将每个块的逻辑地址（在其序列内）转换为设备内存中的全局物理地址。\n"
+"- `max query len`：该请求批次中最长的已调度 token 长度。\n"
+"- `slot mapping`：每个输入 token 将被存储到的索引位置。\n"
+"- `attention mask`：在 softmax 之前应用于注意力分数的掩码矩阵，用于控制哪些 token 可以相互关注（通常是因果注意力）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For each request, use **the number of computed tokens** + **the relative "
+"position of current scheduled tokens** (`request_0: [0 + 0, 0 + 1, 0 + 2]`, "
+"`request_1: [0 + 0, 0 + 1]`, `request_2: [0 + 0, 0 + 1, ..., 0 + 4]`) and "
+"then concatenate them together (`[0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]`)."
+msgstr ""
+"对于每个请求，使用 **已计算的 token 数量** + **当前已调度 token 的相对位置**（`request_0: [0 + 0, 0 + "
+"1, 0 + 2]`、`request_1: [0 + 0, 0 + 1]`、`request_2: [0 + 0, 0 + 1, ..., 0 + "
+"4]`），然后将它们拼接在一起（`[0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4]`）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"So `token indices` = `[0 + 0 * M, 1 + 0 * M, 2 + 0 * M, 0 + 1 * M, 1 + 1 * "
+"M, 0 + 2 * M, 1 + 2 * M, 2 + 2 * M, 3 + 2 * M, 4 + 2 * M]` = `[0, 1, 2, 12, "
+"13, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28]`."
+msgstr ""
+"因此 `token indices` = `[0 + 0 * M, 1 + 0 * M, 2 + 0 * M, 0 + 1 * M, 1 + 1 * "
+"M, 0 + 2 * M, 1 + 2 * M, 2 + 2 * M, 3 + 2 * M, 4 + 2 * M]` = `[0, 1, 2, 12, "
+"13, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28]`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"1. (**Token level**) Use a simple formula to calculate `block table indices`: `request indices * K + positions / block size`. So it equals `[0 * 6 + 0 / 2, 0 * 6 + 1 / 2, 0 * 6 + 2 / 2, 1 * 6 + 0 / 2, 1 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 0 / 2, 2 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 2 / 2, 2 * 6 + 3 / 2, 2 * 6 + 4 / 2] = [0, 0, 1, 6, 6, 12, 12, 13, 13, 14]`. This could be used to select `device block number` from `block table`.\n"
+"2. (**Token level**) Use `block table indices` to select out `device block number` for each scheduled token. The pseudocode is `block_numbers = block_table[block_table_indices]`. So `device block number = [1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6]`.\n"
+"3. (**Token level**) `block offsets` could be computed by `block offsets = positions % block size = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]`.\n"
+"4. Finally, use `block offsets` and `device block number` to create `slot mapping`: `device block number * block size + block_offsets = [2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]`."
+msgstr ""
+"1. （**Token 级别**）使用一个简单公式计算 `block table indices`：`request indices * K + positions / block size`。因此它等于 `[0 * 6 + 0 / 2, 0 * 6 + 1 / 2, 0 * 6 + 2 / 2, 1 * 6 + 0 / 2, 1 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 0 / 2, 2 * 6 + 1 / 2, 2 * 6 + 2 / 2, 2 * 6 + 3 / 2, 2 * 6 + 4 / 2] = [0, 0, 1, 6, 6, 12, 12, 13, 13, 14]`。这可用于从 `block table` 中选出 `device block number`。\n"
+"2. （**Token 级别**）使用 `block table indices` 为每个已调度的 token 选出 `device block number`。伪代码为 `block_numbers = block_table[block_table_indices]`。因此 `device block number = [1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6]`。\n"
+"3. （**Token 级别**）`block offsets` 可通过 `block offsets = positions % block size = [0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0]` 计算得到。\n"
+"4. 最后，使用 `block offsets` 和 `device block number` 创建 `slot mapping`：`device block number * block size + block_offsets = [2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12]`。"

+"   共享签名一致，禁用路径会把 `throttle_prefills`\n"
+"   直接转发给 `super()`。也就是说，**方法体对齐发布标签；签名\n"
+"   匹配两个受支持的版本；禁用路径直接委托。**"
+
+msgid ""
+"### Step 1 — Hook gather onto _has_global_unfinished_reqs and delete the "
+"EngineCore copies"
+msgstr ""
+"### 步骤 1 — 将 gather 挂接到 _has_global_unfinished_reqs，并删除 EngineCore 中的副本"
+
+msgid ""
+"The old `BalanceDPEngineCoreProc.run_busy_loop()` and `run_engine_core()` were\n"
+"verbatim copies of upstream methods and **already stale-drifted**: upstream\n"
+"`run_busy_loop` switched to `while self._handle_shutdown()`, added\n"
+"`eep_scaling_state` / `is_sleeping` guards and a trailing `raise SystemExit`,\n"
+"while the patch still had `while True` + a hand-written signal handler;\n"
+"`run_engine_core` similarly gained `SignalCallback`, NUMA, tracer logic. The\n"
+"goal is to delete both copies."
+msgstr ""
+"旧的 `BalanceDPEngineCoreProc.run_busy_loop()` 和 `run_engine_core()` 是对上游方法的\n"
+"逐字复制，并且**已经发生陈旧漂移**：上游的\n"
+"`run_busy_loop` 已改为 `while self._handle_shutdown()`，新增了\n"
+"`eep_scaling_state` / `is_sleeping` 守卫以及末尾的 `raise SystemExit`，\n"
+"而补丁中仍是 `while True` + 手写的信号处理器；\n"
+"`run_engine_core` 同样新增了 `SignalCallback`、NUMA、tracer 逻辑。\n"
+"目标是删除这两处副本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **`balance_gather` is pulled into `BalanceScheduler`** (no-arg signature, uses\n"
+"  `self.dp_group`), but **not called from `schedule()`** — the engine core\n"
+"  triggers it per step (see below).\n"
+"- **`BalanceDPEngineCoreProc` is not deleted but slimmed to one override**: it\n"
+"  hooks `_has_global_unfinished_reqs`, calling `super()._has_global_unfinished_reqs()`\n"
+"  first (which runs the cross-rank all-reduce every 32 steps) and then, still\n"
+"  inside that same call, injecting `dp_group` and calling `balance_gather()`\n"
+"  once. Upstream's `run_busy_loop` calls `_has_global_unfinished_reqs` exactly\n"
+"  once per iteration on every non-idle path (including dummy-batch iterations\n"
+"  where a drained rank never enters `schedule()`), so every rank participates in\n"
+"  the gather every active step. The `run_busy_loop` body is no longer copied.\n"
+"- **The `run_engine_core` copy is deleted entirely.** Upstream's `run_engine_core`\n"
+"  (a staticmethod) resolves `DPEngineCoreProc` by module-global name inside its\n"
+"  body (`engine_core = DPEngineCoreProc(*args, **kwargs)`, see\n"
+"  [vllm/v1/engine/core.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm)). So a thin\n"
+"  wrapper wraps `run_engine_core`: at its entry (where `vllm_config` is\n"
+"  available) it decides, via `_balance_scheduling_enabled`, whether to swap the\n"
+"  module-level `DPEngineCoreProc` to `BalanceDPEngineCoreProc` or restore the\n"
+"  upstream original, then calls the original `run_engine_core`. This is\n"
+"  **conditional activation** — with balance off, upstream's implementation is\n"
+"  used verbatim; signal handling, `SignalCallback`, NUMA, and tracer all stay\n"
+"  upstream-correct."
+msgstr ""
+"- **`balance_gather` 被并入 `BalanceScheduler`**（无参签名，使用\n"
+"  `self.dp_group`），但**不会从 `schedule()` 中调用** —— 由引擎核心\n"
+"  每步触发（见下文）。\n"
+"- **`BalanceDPEngineCoreProc` 并未删除，而是精简为单个覆写**：它\n"
+"  挂接 `_has_global_unfinished_reqs`，先调用 `super()._has_global_unfinished_reqs()`\n"
+"  （每 32 步执行一次跨 rank 的 all-reduce），然后仍在\n"
+"  同一次调用中，注入 `dp_group` 并调用一次 `balance_gather()`。\n"
+"  上游的 `run_busy_loop` 在每次迭代中、于所有非空闲路径上恰好调用一次\n"
+"  `_has_global_unfinished_reqs`（包括 dummy batch 迭代，\n"
+"  此时被排空的 rank 根本不会进入 `schedule()`），因此每个 rank 在每个活跃步\n"
+"  都会参与 gather。`run_busy_loop` 的方法体不再复制。\n"
+"- **`run_engine_core` 的副本被完全删除。**上游的 `run_engine_core`\n"
+"  （一个 staticmethod）在其方法体内通过模块级全局名解析 `DPEngineCoreProc`\n"
+"  （`engine_core = DPEngineCoreProc(*args, **kwargs)`，见\n"
+"  [vllm/v1/engine/core.py](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm)）。因此用一个轻量\n"
+"  包装器包裹 `run_engine_core`：在其入口处（此时 `vllm_config`\n"
+"  可用）通过 `_balance_scheduling_enabled` 决定是将模块级的 `DPEngineCoreProc`\n"
+"  换成 `BalanceDPEngineCoreProc`，还是恢复上游原版，然后调用原始的\n"
+"  `run_engine_core`。这就是**条件激活** —— 当 balance 关闭时，完全\n"
+"  沿用上游实现；信号处理、`SignalCallback`、NUMA 和 tracer 都保持\n"
+"  上游的正确行为。"
+
+msgid "### Step 2 — Replace the schedule() copy with a minimal seam"
+msgstr "### 步骤 2 — 用最小接缝替换 schedule() 副本"
+

 "用户指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kvpp.md)。支持表描述的是各个单独的组合；它并不表示所有组合都能一起工作。"
+
+msgid ""
+"MLA/SFA models can replicate historical KV caches across tensor parallelism "
+"(TP) and prefill context parallel (PCP) ranks, limiting capacity for long "
+"contexts and concurrent requests. KVPP distributes persistent caches by "
+"layer within each TP×PCP group and broadcasts a layer's cache when "
+"computation needs it."
+msgstr ""
+"MLA/SFA 模型会在张量并行（TP）和预填充上下文并行（PCP）的各 rank 之间复制历史 KV 缓存，从而限制长上下文和并发请求的容量。KVPP"
+" 在每个 TP×PCP 组内按层分发持久化缓存，并在计算需要时广播某一层的缓存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each pipeline parallelism (PP) stage sorts its local target layers by layer "
+"index and assigns contiguous, balanced partitions to owner ranks in its "
+"TP×PCP group. A layer's main KV, indexer KV, and quantization components "
+"form one bundle with a single owner. Draft-model caches, including MTP "
+"caches, remain independently allocated on each rank that requires them and "
+"are excluded from target-layer partitioning."
+msgstr ""
+"每个流水线并行（PP）阶段会按层索引对其本地目标层排序，并将连续、均衡的分区分配给其 TP×PCP 组中的属主 rank。一个层的主 KV、索引器 KV"
+" 和量化组件构成一个捆绑包，由单一属主管理。草稿模型缓存（包括 MTP 缓存）仍在需要它们的每个 rank 上独立分配，并被排除在目标层划分之外。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`enable_kvpp` defaults to `false`. Within each DP replica and PP stage, "
+"layer ownership and broadcasts use the KVPP group."
+msgstr "`enable_kvpp` 默认为 `false`。在每个 DP 副本和 PP 阶段内，层的属主关系与广播均使用 KVPP 组。"

 "`EXCLUDE` applies consistently to prepared inputs and the operator "

 msgstr "`EXCLUDE` 会一致地应用于准备好的输入和算子命名空间。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`.github/actions/csrc-l1-restore/action.yaml` invokes the helper, restores the\n"
+"keyed outer snapshot with compatibility prefixes, and removes `.updated` before\n"
+"the build. `.github/actions/csrc-l1-save/action.yaml` publishes only when the\n"
+"caller supplies a primary key, the local cache contains `.updated`, and trusted\n"
+"writer credentials are present. The local engine creates `.updated` only after\n"
+"an entry is newly saved or replaced; an all-HIT build consequently does not\n"
+"republish an unchanged snapshot. Restore and save transport failures are\n"
+"availability failures and remain fail-open. A missing or unparsable manifest,\n"
+"or a manifest object that fails schema or artifact validation, is a MISS and is\n"
+"rebuilt. Conflicts that could corrupt shared artifact publication or\n"
+"synchronization fail the build. A JSON manifest with a non-object top level\n"
+"currently raises during validation; it is not covered by the MISS fallback."
+msgstr ""
+"`.github/actions/csrc-l1-restore/action.yaml` 会调用该辅助程序，使用兼容性前缀恢复\n"
+"带键的外层快照，并在构建前删除 `.updated`。`.github/actions/csrc-l1-save/action.yaml`\n"
+"仅在调用方提供主键、本地缓存中包含 `.updated` 且存在受信任的写入方凭据时才会发布。\n"
+"本地引擎仅在某条目被新增保存或替换之后才创建 `.updated`；因此，全部命中的构建\n"
+"不会重新发布未发生变化的快照。恢复与保存过程中的传输失败属于可用性故障，\n"
+"并保持 fail-open（失败时放行）。清单缺失或无法解析，\n"
+"或清单对象未通过 schema 或产物校验，均属于 MISS 并会被重新构建。\n"
+"可能破坏共享产物发布或同步的冲突会导致构建失败。\n"
+"顶层不是对象的 JSON 清单目前会在校验期间抛出异常；它不在 MISS 回退的覆盖范围内。"

+msgid ""
+"### 26. Why do host pinned memory allocations fail with 207001 / EL0018 "
+"\"out of memory\" when the host still has free memory? {: #faq-host-pinned-"
+"memory-207001 }"
+msgstr ""
+"### 26. 宿主机仍有空闲内存时，为什么 host pinned memory 分配会因 207001 / EL0018 \"out of "
+"memory\" 失败？ {: #faq-host-pinned-memory-207001 }"
+
+msgid ""
+"`207001` (torch_npu) and `EL0018` (CANN runtime) report the same failed host\n"
+"pinned allocation."
+msgstr ""
+"`207001`（torch_npu）与 `EL0018`（CANN runtime）报出的是同一次失败的 host\n"
+"pinned 分配。"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Root cause:** the Ascend driver backs host pinned memory with 2 MB compound\n"
+"pages, so one 128 MB request needs 64 contiguous 2 MB blocks. On a host that\n"
+"also runs long-lived large host-memory consumers, the remaining free memory is\n"
+"mostly 4 KB fragments, and the kernel can rebuild 2 MB blocks only by\n"
+"compaction, which needs CPU time. When the supply of 2 MB blocks reaches zero,\n"
+"the allocation fails even though hundreds of GB are still free. The failure can\n"
+"occur while a worker starts or while the service is running, and it is a\n"
+"host-side problem: `free -g` and `dmesg` look normal and every NPU stays\n"
+"healthy."
+msgstr ""
+"**根本原因：** 昇腾驱动使用 2 MB 复合页来支撑 host pinned memory，因此一次 128 MB 的申请需要 64 个连续的 2 "
+"MB 块。如果该宿主机上还运行着长期占用大量主机内存的进程，则剩余的空闲内存大多是 4 KB 碎片，内核只能通过内存规整（compaction）来重建 "
+"2 MB 块，而这需要消耗 CPU 时间。当 2 MB 块的供给降为零时，即使仍有数百 GB 空闲内存，分配也会失败。该故障可能发生在 worker "
+"启动阶段，也可能发生在服务运行过程中，且它属于宿主机侧问题：`free -g` 和 `dmesg` 看起来都很正常，每个 NPU 也保持健康。"
+
+msgid "**Mitigation:**"
+msgstr "**缓解措施：**"
+
+msgid "**Step 1: check how many 2 MB blocks the host still has free.**"
+msgstr "**步骤 1：检查宿主机还剩多少个空闲的 2 MB 块。**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Compare the result with a known-good value from the same host: a healthy\n"
+"idle 2-3 TB host reports several thousand, and a 1 TB server proportionally\n"
+"less. Close to zero means the next pinned allocation will probably fail."
+msgstr ""
+"将该结果与同一台宿主机上已知良好的数值进行比较：一台健康的空闲 2-3 TB 宿主机通常会报告数千个，1 TB 服务器则按比例更少。接近零意味着下一次 "
+"pinned 分配很可能会失败。"
+
+msgid "**Step 2: if the number is low, check where the host memory went.**"
+msgstr "**步骤 2：如果该数值偏低，检查主机内存都去了哪里。**"
+
+msgid ""
+"When `free` is small while `buff/cache` is large, reclaim the file cache.\n"
+"Only page cache, dentries and inodes are dropped; process memory and pinned\n"
+"memory are not affected:"
+msgstr ""
+"当 `free` 较小而 `buff/cache` 较大时，回收文件缓存。\n"
+"此时只会释放 page cache、dentry 和 inode；进程内存与 pinned\n"
+"内存不受影响："
+
+msgid "**Step 3: merge the fragmented 4 KB pages back into 2 MB blocks.**"
+msgstr "**步骤 3：将碎片化的 4 KB 页重新合并为 2 MB 块。**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run the check from step 1 again. The count normally recovers within seconds\n"
+"to a couple of minutes; start the service after it is back to the healthy\n"
+"range."
+msgstr ""
+"再次执行步骤 1 中的检查。该计数通常会在几秒到几分钟内恢复；待其回到健康\n"
+"区间后再启动服务。"
+
+msgid ""
+"**Step 4: once the service is up, check `free -h` again.** If `free` is still\n"
+"small, clear the cache to give the memory back:"
+msgstr ""
+"**步骤 4：服务启动后，再次检查 `free -h`。** 如果 `free` 仍然\n"
+"很小，则清理缓存以归还内存："
+
+msgid ""
+"The next weight load will be slower, because the weights have to be read\n"
+"from storage again."
+msgstr ""
+"下一次加载权重会变慢，因为权重需要重新从\n"
+"存储中读取。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Steps 2 and 3 are most effective right before a (re)start, because weight\n"
+"loading fills the page cache again and compaction recovers the blocks only for a\n"
+"short while."
+msgstr ""
+"步骤 2 和步骤 3 在（重新）启动之前执行效果最好，因为权重\n"
+"加载会再次填满 page cache，而内存规整只能短暂地恢复这些块。"

+msgid ""
+"Choose one complete path based on your requirements. Container-based paths "
+"require Docker; see the [Docker installation "
+"guide](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/get-docker/) if needed. Those "
+"paths also need Ascend Docker Runtime on the host. [Use Ascend Docker "
+"Runtime](#installation-ascend-docker-runtime) introduces the runtime and "
+"gives the installation steps. If the host cannot install it, the other steps"
+" stay the same and only the Docker device mapping changes: use the flags in "
+"[Manual device mapping without Ascend Docker Runtime](#installation-"
+"container-without-runtime)."
+msgstr ""
+"请根据需求选择一条完整的路径。基于容器的路径需要 Docker；如有需要，请参阅 [Docker "
+"安装指南](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/get-docker/)。这些路径还需要在主机上安装 Ascend "
+"Docker Runtime。[使用 Ascend Docker Runtime](#installation-ascend-docker-"
+"runtime) 介绍了该运行时并给出了安装步骤。如果主机无法安装，其余步骤保持不变，只是 Docker 的设备映射方式不同：请使用 [不使用 "
+"Ascend Docker Runtime 手动映射设备](#installation-container-without-runtime) 中的参数。"
+
+msgid "!!! note \"Docker version\""
+msgstr "!!! note \"Docker 版本\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Docker Engine 20.10 or later is recommended when the host uses cgroup v2. "
+"Earlier Docker versions do not support cgroup v2; devices passed with "
+"`--device` may therefore be inaccessible inside the container, causing NPU "
+"initialization to fail. Check the Docker Engine and cgroup versions on the "
+"host if this occurs."
+msgstr ""
+"当主机使用 cgroup v2 时，建议使用 Docker Engine 20.10 或更高版本。更早的 Docker 版本不支持 cgroup "
+"v2，因此通过 `--device` 传入的设备在容器内可能无法访问，从而导致 NPU 初始化失败。若出现此问题，请检查主机上的 Docker "
+"Engine 和 cgroup 版本。"
+
+msgid ""
+"#### Use Ascend Docker Runtime {: #installation-ascend-docker-runtime }"
+msgstr ""
+"#### 使用 Ascend Docker Runtime {: #installation-ascend-docker-runtime }"
+
+msgid ""
+"Both container-based paths — the prebuilt image and the CANN environment — "
+"need Ascend Docker Runtime on the **host**. The runtime mounts the NPU "
+"devices and driver paths of the host into the container."
+msgstr ""
+"两种基于容器的方式——预构建镜像和 CANN 环境——都需要在**主机**上安装 Ascend Docker Runtime。该运行时会将该主机的 "
+"NPU 设备和驱动路径挂载到容器中。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Download the run package from the [MindCluster "
+"releases](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/mind-cluster/releases): in `Ascend-"
+"docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run`, `<version>` is the release you "
+"select and `<arch>` is `x86_64` or `aarch64`. Choose a release that supports"
+" the Ascend HDK version of the node, then install it as `root` on every node"
+" that runs containers:"
+msgstr ""
+"从 [MindCluster releases](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/mind-cluster/releases) "
+"下载 run 安装包：在 `Ascend-docker-runtime_<version>_linux-<arch>.run` "
+"中，`<version>` 为您选择的发布版本，`<arch>` 为 `x86_64` 或 `aarch64`。请选择支持该节点 Ascend HDK "
+"版本的发布版本，然后以 `root` 身份在所有运行容器的节点上安装："
+
+msgid "Confirm that the runtime is the default:"
+msgstr "确认该运行时为默认运行时："
+
+msgid "{% raw %}"
+msgstr "{% raw %}"
+
+msgid "{% endraw %}"
+msgstr "{% endraw %}"
+
+msgid ""
+"The output must be `default=ascend`. If it prints `runc`, check the "
+"`Runtimes:` line of `docker info`:"
+msgstr ""
+"输出必须为 `default=ascend`。如果输出为 `runc`，请检查 `docker info` 的 `Runtimes:` 行："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. If `ascend` is listed, either add `--runtime ascend` to `docker run`, or set `\"default-runtime\": \"ascend\"` in `/etc/docker/daemon.json` and restart Docker.\n"
+"2. If `ascend` is missing, rerun the installation and restart Docker."
+msgstr ""
+"1. 如果其中列出了 `ascend`，可在 `docker run` 中添加 `--runtime ascend`，或在 `/etc/docker/daemon.json` 中设置 `\"default-runtime\": \"ascend\"` 并重启 Docker。\n"
+"2. 如果缺少 `ascend`，请重新运行安装并重启 Docker。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The container commands in this guide assume Ascend Docker Runtime **26.3.0 "
+"or later**, whose default mount lists include "
+"`/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info` and `/etc/ascend_install.info`. The "
+"installed version is the `version=` field in `/usr/local/Ascend/Ascend-"
+"Docker-Runtime/ascend_docker_runtime_install.info` (for example "
+"`version=v26.3.0`). With an earlier release, mount those two paths "
+"explicitly with `-v <path>:<path>` or upgrade."
+msgstr ""
+"本指南中的容器命令假定使用 Ascend Docker Runtime **26.3.0 或更高版本**，其默认挂载列表包含 "
+"`/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info` 和 `/etc/ascend_install.info`。已安装版本为 "
+"`/usr/local/Ascend/Ascend-Docker-Runtime/ascend_docker_runtime_install.info`"
+" 中的 `version=` 字段（例如 `version=v26.3.0`）。如果使用更早的版本，请通过 `-v <path>:<path>` "
+"显式挂载这两个路径，或者升级。"
+
+msgid ""
+"To mount an extra host path, create a lowercase `.list` file in "
+"`/etc/ascend-docker-runtime.d/`, one path per line, and name it in "
+"`ASCEND_RUNTIME_MOUNTS` for the containers that need it, for example `-e "
+"ASCEND_RUNTIME_MOUNTS=mylist,base`: that variable replaces the default list,"
+" so include `base`; otherwise the container loses the driver libraries and "
+"`npu-smi`. The default lists mount `/usr/local/bin/npu-smi`; on a product "
+"that installs `npu-smi` under `/usr/local/sbin`, such as Atlas 200I Pro, "
+"mount that path explicitly as the tutorial commands do."
+msgstr ""
+"如需挂载额外的主机路径，请在 `/etc/ascend-docker-runtime.d/` 中创建一个名称小写的 `.list` "
+"文件，每行一个路径，并在需要该路径的容器的 `ASCEND_RUNTIME_MOUNTS` 中指定该文件名，例如 `-e "
+"ASCEND_RUNTIME_MOUNTS=mylist,base`：该变量会替换默认列表，因此必须包含 `base`；否则容器将丢失驱动库和 "
+"`npu-smi`。默认列表会挂载 `/usr/local/bin/npu-smi`；对于将 `npu-smi` 安装在 "
+"`/usr/local/sbin` 下的产品（例如 Atlas 200I Pro），请像教程中的命令那样显式挂载该路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=0` skips building the native extensions and custom operators. These components are enabled by default for a normal NPU installation.\n"
+"- `SOC_VERSION` supplies the package's target hardware without querying `npu-smi`. Use `ascend910b1` for A2, `ascend910_9391` for A3, `ascend310p1` for Atlas 300I Duo / Atlas 200I Pro, or `ascend950dt_9582` for 950DT Products. This selects build metadata; it does not emulate an NPU.\n"
+"- `--no-build-isolation` uses the packaging tools installed in this virtual environment instead of installing the full `pyproject.toml` build requirements.\n"
+"- `--no-deps` skips runtime dependencies from `requirements.txt`. Do not install those dependencies for this packaging-only check."
+msgstr ""
+"- `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=0` 跳过构建原生扩展和自定义算子。在常规的 NPU 安装中，这些组件默认启用。\n"
+"- `SOC_VERSION` 无需查询 `npu-smi` 即可指定软件包的目标硬件。A2 使用 `ascend910b1`，A3 使用 `ascend910_9391`，Atlas 300I Duo / Atlas 200I Pro 使用 `ascend310p1`，Ascend 950DT系列产品使用 `ascend950dt_9582`。此项仅用于选择构建元数据，并不会模拟 NPU。\n"
+"- `--no-build-isolation` 使用此虚拟环境中已安装的打包工具，而不是安装 `pyproject.toml` 中的全部构建依赖。\n"
+"- `--no-deps` 跳过 `requirements.txt` 中的运行时依赖。此检查仅用于打包验证，请勿安装这些依赖。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The commands below use `hccn_tool` (Huawei Collective Communication Network "
+"Tool), the Ascend NPU cluster network management tool installed with the "
+"driver; if the command is missing, check the driver installation and "
+"executable path."
+msgstr ""
+"以下命令使用 `hccn_tool`（Huawei Collective Communication Network Tool），这是随驱动一同安装的 "
+"Ascend NPU 集群网络管理工具；如果找不到该命令，请检查驱动安装情况和可执行文件路径。"
+
+msgid ""
+"### Manual device mapping without Ascend Docker Runtime {: #installation-"
+"container-without-runtime }"
+msgstr ""
+"### 不使用 Ascend Docker Runtime 手动映射设备 {: #installation-container-without-"
+"runtime }"
+
+msgid ""
+"{% include "
+"\"getting_started/installation/without_ascend_docker_runtime.inc.md\" %}"
+msgstr ""
+"{% include "
+"\"getting_started/installation/without_ascend_docker_runtime.inc.md\" %}"

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+# SOME DESCRIPTIVE TITLE.
+# Copyright (C) 2026, vllm-ascend team
+# This file is distributed under the same license as the vllm-ascend package.
+# FIRST AUTHOR <EMAIL@ADDRESS>, 2026.
+#
+msgid ""
+msgstr ""
+"Project-Id-Version: vllm-ascend\n"
+"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: \n"
+"POT-Creation-Date: 2026-11-25 08:12+0000\n"
+"PO-Revision-Date: 2026-11-25 08:12+0000\n"
+"Last-Translator: \n"
+"Language-Team: zh_CN <LL@li.org>\n"
+"Language: zh_CN\n"
+"MIME-Version: 1.0\n"
+"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8\n"
+"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\n"
+"Plural-Forms: nplurals=1; plural=0;\n"
+"Generated-By: detect_po_changes.py\n"
+
+msgid ""
+"These are the `docker run` commands the tutorials used before Ascend Docker "
+"Runtime, kept for hosts that cannot install it or choose not to. The runtime"
+" reads `ASCEND_VISIBLE_DEVICES` and binds the NPU nodes and driver paths at "
+"container start; these commands pass the same nodes with `--device` and the "
+"same paths with `-v`, so they also start on a host without the runtime."
+msgstr ""
+"以下是教程在 Ascend Docker Runtime 之前使用的 `docker run` "
+"命令，保留给无法安装该运行时或选择不安装的主机。该运行时会读取 `ASCEND_VISIBLE_DEVICES`，并在容器启动时绑定 NPU "
+"节点和驱动路径；而这些命令则通过 `--device` 传入相同的节点、通过 `-v` 传入相同的路径，因此它们也能在没有该运行时的主机上启动。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For example, [Quick Start](quick_start.md#quick-start-installation) starts "
+"its container with one device: `/dev/davinci0`, or `/dev/davinci0` and "
+"`/dev/davinci1` on Atlas A3, where an NPU is two DIE devices. The tabs below"
+" do the same, and add one `--device /dev/davinciN` line for each further "
+"device."
+msgstr ""
+"例如，[快速开始](quick_start.md#quick-start-installation) "
+"启动容器时使用一个设备：`/dev/davinci0`；在 Atlas A3 上则是 `/dev/davinci0` 和 "
+"`/dev/davinci1`，因为在那里一个 NPU 由两个 DIE 设备组成。下面的标签页做了同样的事情，并为每个额外的设备增加一行 "
+"`--device /dev/davinciN`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Everything else stays as the tutorial you are adapting writes it: the weight"
+" and cache mounts, the ports, the HCCL and network settings, and any extra "
+"devices."
+msgstr "其余部分保持你所改编的教程中的写法不变：权重与缓存挂载、端口、HCCL 与网络设置，以及任何额外的设备。"
+
+msgid "=== \"Atlas A2 inference products\""
+msgstr "=== \"Atlas A2 推理产品\""
+
+msgid "=== \"Atlas A3 inference products\""
+msgstr "=== \"Atlas A3 推理产品\""
+
+msgid "=== \"950DT products\""
+msgstr "=== \"Ascend 950DT系列产品\""
+
+msgid ""
+"The UB device nodes `/dev/ummu` and `/dev/uburma` are not part of the driver"
+" library set, so pass them explicitly as well."
+msgstr "UB 设备节点 `/dev/ummu` 和 `/dev/uburma` 不属于驱动库集合的一部分，因此也需要显式传入。"
+
+msgid "=== \"Atlas 300I Duo\""
+msgstr "=== \"Atlas 300I Duo\""
+
+msgid "=== \"Atlas 200I Pro\""
+msgstr "=== \"Atlas 200I Pro\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Atlas 200I Pro needs the device nodes and host files below. Make sure the "
+"container user can access the mapped devices."
+msgstr "Atlas 200I Pro 需要下面这些设备节点和主机文件。请确保容器用户能够访问映射的设备。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On an openEuler host, use the `-310p-openeuler` image, mount `-v "
+"/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2:/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2`, and replace the "
+"`libyaml` source with `-v "
+"/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9:/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2`."
+msgstr ""

-msgid ""
-"- The A2 layout is 1P1D on two servers: the Prefill server runs\n"
-"      DP2/TP1/PCP4 and the Decode server runs DP8/TP1. On each server,\n"
-"      local DP ranks multiplied by `tp_size * pcp_size` consume all 8\n"
-"      devices: 2 × 4 on Prefill and 8 × 1 on Decode.\n"
-"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` is a per-DP-rank budget, not a per-node\n"
-"      budget. Because PCP4 leaves only two Prefill ranks, `4096` keeps the\n"
-"      node-level chunk size comparable to a four-rank layout. `4096` is also\n"
-"      the largest value that preserves the 1M-token context: it leaves about\n"
-"      6.0 GiB of KV cache per device, while a 1M-token request needs about\n"
-"      4.9 GiB. Lowering the value to `2048` roughly halves Prefill\n"
-"      throughput, and `8192` leaves too little KV cache for the 1M context.\n"
-"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` gives every Prefill and Decode\n"

+msgid ""
+"On a low-memory server, for example a 1 TB machine, free the host from\n"
+"    long-lived large memory consumers before deploying, so that enough\n"
+"    contiguous 2 MB host pages are available. Otherwise a pinned host\n"
+"    allocation can fail with `207001` or `EL0018 ... Insufficient_Host_Memory`\n"
+"    during startup or serving, even though the host has free memory. See\n"
+"    [FAQ 26](../../faqs.md#faq-host-pinned-memory-207001) for checks and\n"
+"    recovery commands."
+msgstr ""
+"在内存较小的服务器上（例如 1 TB 内存的机器），部署前请先释放主机上\n"
+"    长期占用大量内存的进程，以确保有足够的\n"
+"    连续 2 MB 主机页可用。否则在启动或服务过程中，\n"
+"    锁页主机内存分配可能会失败，并报出 `207001` 或 `EL0018 ... Insufficient_Host_Memory`，\n"
+"    即使主机仍有空闲内存。检查方法和\n"
+"    恢复命令请参见 [FAQ 26](../../faqs.md#faq-host-pinned-memory-207001)。"
