+"      本地 DP rank 之间共享。这要求容器以 `--ipc=host` 运行，\n"
+"      或使用至少 320 GiB 的 `/dev/shm`。\n"
+"    - Decode 角色使用 `--kv-cache-memory-bytes 4600000000`（约\n"
+"      4.28 GiB）来固定 KV cache 预算。在 A2 上使用 DP8/TP1 时，单个设备\n"
+"      约承载 53.6 GiB 的权重，因此在 `0.97` 利用率下，KV cache\n"
+"      几乎会占满所有剩余的 HBM，使空闲 DP rank 在其他 rank 执行时\n"
+"      运行的 eager dummy batch 没有空间。\n"
+"      一个 1M token 的请求每个设备需要约 4.18 GiB 的 KV cache，因此\n"
+"      该固定预算可在保留 1M 支持的同时留出约 2% 的余量。设置该选项后，\n"
+"      vLLM 会跳过 KV 内存 profiling，\n"
+"      `--gpu-memory-utilization` 不再决定 KV cache 大小；\n"
+"      但它仍适用于其他内存预算逻辑。\n"
+"    - 前缀缓存仅在 Prefill 上启用。Decode 将其禁用，并\n"
+"      启用 `recompute_scheduler_enable`，以便在\n"
+"      Prefill 侧 KV cache 不可用时重新计算请求。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--enforce-eager` 和 `--swa-bounded-replay`。Decode 使用\n"
+"      `--async-scheduling`，通过 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 捕获 Decode 路径，\n"
+"      并设置 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`，因为其\n"
+"      `recompute_scheduler_enable` 路径无法执行有界重放。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都将 `enable_flashcomm1` 设为 `false`；在 Prefill 上这是\n"
+"      兼容 SWA 有界重放所必需的。Prefill 启用\n"
+"      `enable_fused_mc2` 和 `enable_shared_expert_dp`；Decode 则改为启用\n"
+"      `multistream_overlap_shared_expert`。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口相关变量必须选择与所配置的节点 IP\n"
+"      相同的高速服务网络。\n"
+"      `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` 在 A2 上为节点内 HCCL 启用 RoCE 传输。\n"
+"      `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `1024`，在 Decode 上为 `1800`；\n"
+"      除非已验证其他设置，否则请保留这些角色特定的值。\n"
+"      `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` 仅在 Prefill 上设置。\n"
+"    等待每个引擎完成权重加载，并等待 Decode 完成图\n"
+"    捕获。成功启动时会输出类似以下内容："
+
+msgid ""
+"This two-node colocated configuration uses two Atlas 800 A2 servers with one\n"
+"    local DP rank per server and a global DP2/TP8/EP16 topology. It uses the\n"
+"    W4A8 checkpoint and model runner V2 with DSpark speculative decoding and\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph. This configuration has been validated for\n"
+"    startup, text and image smoke requests, and 16k-input serving; long-context\n"
+"    and high-concurrency performance has not been qualified."
+msgstr ""
+"该双节点共置配置使用两台 Atlas 800 A2 服务器，每台服务器一个\n"
+"    本地 DP rank，采用全局 DP2/TP8/EP16 拓扑。它使用\n"
+"    W4A8 检查点和 model runner V2，并启用 DSpark 投机解码和\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph。该配置已验证\n"
+"    启动、文本与图像冒烟请求以及 16k 输入服务；长上下文\n"
+"    和高并发性能尚未验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- The documented A3 deployments use either one server in colocated mode or two\n"
+"  servers in 1P1D mode, with an Ascend W4A8 checkpoint and INT8 Engram storage.\n"
+"- The documented A2 deployments use two servers: one Prefill and one Decode\n"
+"  server in 1P1D mode with an Ascend W4A8 checkpoint, or two servers in\n"
+"  DP2/TP8/EP16 colocated mode. The A2 two-node colocated configuration has been\n"
+"  validated with W4A8 weights for startup, smoke requests, and 16k-input\n"
+"  serving only; long-context and high-concurrency performance remain\n"
+"  unqualified. The A2 Mooncake KV Cache Pool variant has been validated with\n"
+"  W4A8 weights for startup, smoke requests, 16k-input saturation, and 128K\n"
+"  multi-prefix serving; other workloads are not qualified.\n"
+"- In the A2 PD example, the Decode KV cache is fixed with\n"
+"  `--kv-cache-memory-bytes`, so `--gpu-memory-utilization` does not determine\n"
+"  the KV cache size there.\n"
+"- In the A3 PD example, Prefill runs in eager mode. Decode uses\n"
+"  `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph with DSpark draft graph execution enabled.\n"
+"- Production performance qualification and task-level accuracy evaluation are\n"
+"  not complete.\n"
+"- The 950DT pooling example uses Memcache for storage and\n"
+"  `MooncakeHybridConnector` for P-to-D KV transfer. Verify external pool\n"
+"  hits as described in [Section 5.3.1.4](#5314-start-the-proxy-and-verify-pooling)."
+msgstr ""
+"- 文档中记录的 A3 部署使用一台采用混部模式的服务器，或两台采用\n"
+"  1P1D 模式的服务器，并使用昇腾 W4A8 检查点和 INT8 Engram 存储。\n"
+"- 文档中记录的 A2 部署使用两台服务器：一台 Prefill 服务器和一台 Decode\n"
+"  服务器，采用 1P1D 模式并使用昇腾 W4A8 检查点；或者两台服务器采用\n"
+"  DP2/TP8/EP16 混部模式。A2 双节点混部配置已使用 W4A8 权重进行验证，\n"
+"  仅涵盖启动、冒烟请求和 16k 输入服务；长上下文和高并发性能仍未\n"
+"  通过验证。A2 Mooncake KV Cache Pool 变体已使用 W4A8 权重进行验证，\n"
+"  涵盖启动、冒烟请求、16k 输入饱和以及 128K 多前缀服务；其他工作负载\n"
+"  尚未通过验证。\n"
+"- 在 A2 PD 示例中，Decode 的 KV cache 通过\n"
+"  `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` 固定，因此 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 在该场景下不决定\n"
+"  KV cache 大小。\n"
+"- 在 A3 PD 示例中，Prefill 以 eager 模式运行。Decode 使用\n"
+"  `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph，并启用 DSpark draft graph 执行。\n"
+"- 生产性能验证和任务级精度评估尚未完成。\n"
+"- 950DT 池化示例使用 Memcache 作为存储，并使用\n"

+"  [第 5.3.1.4 节](#5314-start-the-proxy-and-verify-pooling) 所述验证外部池\n"
+"  命中。"

-"    - 两种角色均启用前缀缓存以及 FP8 注意力和索引器 KV 缓存。MTP 使用 eager 草稿，Prefill 上一个投机 token，Decode 上五个。Prefill 以 eager 模式运行；Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
-"    - `MultiConnector` 将用于 P 到 D 传输的 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 与用于 KV 池化的 `AscendStoreConnector` 结合使用。两种角色均声明 Prefill DP1/PP2/TP8 和 Decode DP16/TP2，并设置 `use_layerwise: true`。Mooncake 基础 KV 端口在 Prefill 上为 `30000`，在 Decode 上为 `30300`。\n"
-"    - `MMC_LOCAL_CONFIG_PATH` 选择每个节点的 MemCache 配置。在启动引擎之前准备后端，并通过其命中/加载指标验证共享池复用。\n"
-"    - Prefill 启用 FlashComm1 和 `enable_fused_mc2: 1`。Decode 启用 MLAPO 和共享专家多流重叠。两种角色均启用重计算调度。"
-
-msgid ""
-"This uses four nodes with TP16/PP2 Prefill and `MultiConnector`:\n"

-"    the launcher, PP placement, and proxy routing from the A3 tab of [Section 5.1.3](#513-prefill-decode-disaggregation).\n"

-"    HCCS fabric, and static-kernel compatibility checks apply. Pool-specific\n"
-"    `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, `ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1`, and MemCache paths are set below."
-msgstr ""
-"此方案使用四个节点，采用 TP16/PP2 Prefill 和 `MultiConnector`：`MooncakeConnectorV2` 将 KV "
-"缓存从 Prefill 传输到 Decode，`AscendStoreConnector` 提供非分层 MemCache 池化。保留 [第 5.1.3 "
-"节](#513-prefill-decode-disaggregation) A3 选项卡中的启动器、PP 布局和代理路由。这是提供的 198k "
-"池化变体，设置 `--max-model-len 200000`。两种角色均启用前缀缓存；与非池化变体不同，Decode 不得使用 `--no-"
-"enable-prefix-caching`。Prefill 保留融合 MC2 模式 2 和共享专家 DP，而 Decode 使用 NPU "
-"图/静态内核编译和共享专家多流重叠，不使用融合 MC2。同样适用构建、HCCS 结构和静态内核兼容性检查。池化专用的 "
-"`PYTHONHASHSEED=0`、`ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1` 和 MemCache 路径在下方设置。"

-msgid ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size 2` and `--tensor-parallel-size 8` define both\n"
-"      roles. Each role spans two nodes, with one TP8 engine per node and\n"
-"      a separate DP group. Each node exposes API port `8000`.\n"
-"    - Prefill sets `enable_kvpp: true` in `--additional-config`;\n"
-"      Decode sets `--decode-context-parallel-size 8` to shard KV cache\n"
-"      across its TP group.\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len` is `1046576` on Prefill and `1048576` on Decode.\n"
-"      Prefill sets `--max-num-seqs 64` and\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768`; Decode sets `32` and `192`,\n"
-"      respectively. Tune concurrency for the available KV cache capacity.\n"
-"    - MTP uses `deepseek_mtp` with an eager draft: one speculative token\n"
-"      on Prefill and five on Decode. Prefill uses `--enforce-eager`;\n"
-"      Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer`\n"
-"      on Decode, with base KV ports `30000` and `30200`, respectively.\n"
-"      Both roles declare Prefill DP2/TP8 and Decode DP2/TP8.\n"
-"    - Both roles use FP8 attention and indexer KV caches and\n"
-"      `enable_fused_mc2: 1`. Prefill also enables FlashComm1 and\n"
-"      prefix caching."
-msgstr ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size 2` 和 `--tensor-parallel-size 8` 定义两种角色。每种角色跨两个节点，每个节点一个 TP8 引擎，并具有独立的 DP 组。每个节点暴露 API 端口 `8000`。\n"
-"    - Prefill 在 `--additional-config` 中设置 `enable_kvpp: true`；Decode 设置 `--decode-context-parallel-size 8`，以在其 TP 组内分片 KV 缓存。\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len` 在 Prefill 上为 `1046576`，在 Decode 上为 `1048576`。Prefill 设置 `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768`；Decode 分别设置 `32` 和 `192`。根据可用的 KV 缓存容量调整并发数。\n"
-"    - MTP 使用 `deepseek_mtp` 和 eager 草稿：Prefill 上一个投机 token，Decode 上五个。Prefill 使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer`，基础 KV 端口分别为 `30000` 和 `30200`。两种角色均声明 Prefill DP2/TP8 和 Decode DP2/TP8。\n"
-"    - 两种角色均使用 FP8 注意力和索引器 KV 缓存以及 `enable_fused_mc2: 1`。Prefill 还启用 FlashComm1 和前缀缓存。"
-
-msgid ""
-"- Prefill uses DP1/PP2/TP16/DCP16 with the layer partition `42,36`.\n"
-"      P0 hosts the API; P1 joins through `--headless --node-rank 1`.\n"
-"      Decode uses DP8/TP4/DCP4, four local DP ranks per node.\n"
-"    - The launcher passes `$1` = visible devices, `$2` = API port, `$3` = global\n"
-"      DP size, `$4` = DP rank, `$5` = DP master IP, `$6` = DP RPC port, and\n"
-"      `$7` = TP size to `run_dp_template.sh`.\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len` is `1048576` on both roles. Prefill uses\n"
-"      `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`; Decode uses\n"
-"      `8` and `48`, respectively, per engine. Tune concurrency to available\n"
-"      KV cache capacity and reserve output tokens within the context limit.\n"
-"    - PCP remains 1, while DCP is 16 on Prefill and 4 on Decode.\n"
-"      `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 128` and int8 attention/indexer KV caches\n"
-"      are configured on both roles.\n"
-"    - Prefill enables chunked prefill, prefix caching, async scheduling,\n"
-"      FlashComm1, fused MC2 mode 2 and shared-expert DP. Decode explicitly disables\n"
-"      prefix caching, enables recomputation scheduling and shared-expert\n"
-"      multistream overlap, and selects NpuGraphEx/StaticKernel through\n"
-"      `ascend_compilation_config`.\n"
-"    - MTP uses an eager draft with one speculative token on Prefill and five\n"
-"      on Decode. Prefill uses `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`.\n"
-"      Both roles set `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`, HCCL execution/connection timeouts\n"
-"      to 1800 seconds, and `ASCEND_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT=10000`.\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer`\n"
-"      on Decode, with base KV ports 30000 and 30100. Both declare the same\n"
-"      Prefill DP1/PP2/TP16 partition `42,36` and Decode DP8/TP4 topology.\n"
-"      This example does not enable MemCache pooling.\n"
-"    - TurboQuant cannot be combined with DCP or the int8 C8 cache and therefore\n"
-"      does not apply to this 1M example. See [Performance Tuning](#9-performance-tuning)."
-msgstr ""
-"- Prefill 使用 DP1/PP2/TP16/DCP16，层划分为 `42,36`。\n"
-"      P0 承载 API；P1 通过 `--headless --node-rank 1` 加入。\n"
-"      Decode 使用 DP8/TP4/DCP4，每个节点四个本地 DP rank。\n"
-"    - 启动脚本向 `run_dp_template.sh` 传入 `$1` = 可见设备、`$2` = API 端口、`$3` = 全局\n"
-"      DP 大小、`$4` = DP rank、`$5` = DP 主节点 IP、`$6` = DP RPC 端口，以及\n"
-"      `$7` = TP 大小。\n"
-"    - 两个角色的 `--max-model-len` 均为 `1048576`。Prefill 使用\n"
-"      `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`；Decode 每个引擎分别使用\n"
-"      `8` 和 `48`。请根据可用的\n"
-"      KV cache 容量调整并发度，并在上下文限制内预留输出 token。\n"
-"    - PCP 保持为 1，而 DCP 在 Prefill 上为 16、在 Decode 上为 4。\n"
-"      两个角色均配置了 `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 128` 以及 int8 attention/indexer KV cache。\n"
-"    - Prefill 启用 chunked prefill、prefix caching、异步调度、\n"
-"      FlashComm1、融合 MC2 模式 2 和 shared-expert DP。Decode 显式禁用\n"
-"      prefix caching，启用重计算调度和 shared-expert\n"
-"      多流重叠，并通过\n"
-"      `ascend_compilation_config` 选择 NpuGraphEx/StaticKernel。\n"
-"    - MTP 使用 eager draft，Prefill 上使用一个投机 token，Decode 上使用五个。\n"
-"      Prefill 使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`。\n"
-"      两个角色均设置 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`、HCCL 执行/连接超时\n"
-"      为 1800 秒，以及 `ASCEND_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT=10000`。\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer`，\n"
-"      基础 KV 端口分别为 30000 和 30100。两者声明相同的\n"
-"      Prefill DP1/PP2/TP16 划分 `42,36` 和 Decode DP8/TP4 拓扑。\n"
-"      本示例未启用 MemCache 池化。\n"
-"    - TurboQuant 不能与 DCP 或 int8 C8 cache 组合使用，因此\n"
-"      不适用于此 1M 示例。参见[性能调优](#9-performance-tuning)。"

+msgid ""
+"- `--pipeline-parallel-size 2`, `--tensor-parallel-size 1`, and\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size 8` define\n"
+"      each Prefill instance, with `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=\"42,36\"` across\n"
+"      two nodes. Two instances use four Prefill nodes in total.\n"
+"      `PP_MASTER_IP` is P0 for the first instance and P2 for the second;\n"
+"      only PP rank 0 in each instance exposes its Prefill API.\n"
+"    - The Decode launcher uses `--dp-size 16`, `--tp-size 1`, and\n"
+"      `--dp-size-local 8`: eight local ranks on each of two nodes.\n"
+"      `--dp-address` and `--dp-rpc-port` must match across Decode nodes;\n"
+"      `--dp-rank-start` assigns their disjoint global rank ranges.\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` assigns Decode API ports `8000-8007` on\n"
+"      each node. Register all 16 endpoints with the proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use `--max-model-len 135000`. Prefill sets\n"
+"      `--max-num-seqs 500` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`;\n"
+"      Decode sets `60` and `360`, respectively, per engine.\n"
+"    - Both roles use FP8 attention and indexer KV caches. Prefill uses\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp` with one speculative token and `--enforce-eager`.\n"
+"      Decode uses `deepseek_mtp` with five speculative tokens and an eager\n"
+"      draft, with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` target graph mode.\n"

+"      on Decode, with base KV ports `29100` and `29200`, respectively.\n"

+"      the shared Decode group as DP16/TP1.\n"

+"      utilization 0.95. Prefill enables FlashComm1 and fused MC2 mode 2,\n"

+"      communication path. Keep the draft model's `enforce_eager: true`."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--pipeline-parallel-size 2`、`--tensor-parallel-size 1` 和\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size 8` 共同定义\n"
+"      每个 Prefill 实例，并通过 `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=\"42,36\"` 跨\n"

+"    - Decode 启动脚本使用 `--dp-size 16`、`--tp-size 1` 和\n"

+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` 在每个节点上分配 Decode API 端口\n"
+"      `8000-8007`。需将全部 16 个端点注册到 proxy。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均使用 `--max-model-len 135000`。Prefill 设置\n"
+"      `--max-num-seqs 500` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`；\n"
+"      Decode 每个引擎分别设置为 `60` 和 `360`。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均使用 FP8 attention 和 indexer KV cache。Prefill 使用\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp`，1 个投机 token，并开启 `--enforce-eager`。\n"
+"      Decode 使用 `deepseek_mtp`，5 个投机 token 和 eager\n"

+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上使用\n"
+"      `kv_consumer`，基础 KV 端口分别为 `29100` 和 `29200`。\n"
+"      该连接器将每个 Prefill 实例描述为 DP1/PP2/TP1/PCP8，\n"
+"      将共享的 Decode 组描述为 DP16/TP1。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均启用共享专家 DP 和前缀缓存，并设置显存\n"
+"      利用率为 0.95。Prefill 启用 FlashComm1 和融合 MC2 模式 2，\n"
+"      并关闭共享专家多流重叠。Decode 启用 MLAPO、\n"
+"      `weight_nz_mode: 1`、LM-head TP8、共享专家多流重叠，\n"
+"      以及通过 `scheduler_config` 控制的重计算调度。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均使用 `VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=HND`。Prefill 设置\n"
+"      `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1200`；Decode 设置 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1800`。\n"
+"    - 在已安装 `cann_ops_transformer` 时，`enable_fused_mc2: 2`\n"
+"      会选择 MegaMoE。在所选维护分支中，量化布局不受支持的 MTP draft MoE\n"
+"      层将使用非融合的通信路径。请保持 draft 模型的 `enforce_eager: true`。"

+msgid ""

+"      Set `PP_RANK=0` on P0 and `PP_RANK=1` on P1; the shared script adds\n"

+"      Prefill enables fused MC2 mode 2 and FlashComm1; Decode enables\n"
+"      MLAPO, shared-expert overlap and NPU graph execution."

+"- Prefill 在 P0/P1 上使用 PP2/TP1/PCP8，分区为 `42,36`。\n"

-msgid ""
-"- A2 series uses global DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, with each\n"
-"      role spread across two nodes with eight devices per node. A3 ordinary PD uses\n"
-"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, each on one node with 16 logical devices.\n"
-"    - P0 and P1 use the shared launcher with one local DP rank each. P0\n"
-"      exposes the Prefill API with `--api-server-count 1`; P1 is headless.\n"
-"      D0 and D1 each run four API-serving TP2 engines(total DP8) through their\n"
-"      node-specific wrapper scripts.\n"
-"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` enables `use_ascend_direct` for direct\n"
-"      NPU-to-NPU KV transfer and declares the actual Prefill and Decode\n"
-"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` topology. The declared values must match the\n"
-"      real deployment.\n"
-"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`\n"
-"      without `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `--max-num-seqs 40` and\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240` with `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` and\n"
-"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
-"      Both roles run with `--async-scheduling`.\n"
-"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2 via `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
-"      Prefill uses PCP8 and TP1; Decode keeps PCP1.\n"
-"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each engine to the launcher-assigned devices.\n"
-"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` advertises the IP that peers use to reach each\n"
-"      engine for KV transfer. Prefill enables FlashComm1 and shared-expert DP;\n"
-"      Decode enables the recompute scheduler and NPU graph extension while\n"
-"      keeping FlashComm1 disabled and static/super kernels disabled.\n"
-"    - MTP speculative decoding uses three speculative tokens on A2 series.\n"
-"      Prefill uses `enforce_eager: true`; Decode uses `enforce_eager: false`\n"
-"      with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
-"    - `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` and `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` on\n"
-"      Decode reserve a disjoint 100-port window per DP rank (starting at\n"
-"      `60000 + rank * 100`). When several engines share one node, these\n"
-"      ranges prevent the HCCL host-side sockets from silently sharing\n"
-"      ports across ranks, which can block engine startup.\n"
-"    - The remaining timeout and runtime variables\n"
-"      (`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`,\n"
-"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, `OMP_PROC_BIND`,\n"
-"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`) are the validated A2 series startup defaults for this\n"
-"      model size; keep them unless your environment requires different\n"
-"      values.\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and all socket interface variables must select the\n"
-"      service network used by the configured node IPs. The DP RPC,\n"
-"      engine, Mooncake, and proxy ports must be allowed by the host\n"
-"      firewall."
-msgstr ""
-"- A2 系列使用全局 DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，每个\n"
-"      角色分布在两个节点上，每个节点八个设备。A3 普通 PD 使用\n"
-"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，各自位于一个节点上，使用 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
-"    - P0 和 P1 使用共享启动器，各自拥有一个本地 DP rank。P0\n"
-"      通过 `--api-server-count 1` 暴露 Prefill API；P1 为无头模式。\n"
-"      D0 和 D1 各自通过其节点专属的包装脚本运行四个提供 API 服务的 TP2 引擎（总计 DP8）。\n"
-"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` 启用 `use_ascend_direct` 以实现\n"
-"      NPU 到 NPU 的直接 KV 传输，并声明实际的 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
-"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` 拓扑。声明的值必须与\n"
-"      实际部署一致。\n"
-"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`，\n"
-"      不使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `--max-num-seqs 40` 和\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240`，并设置 `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` 和\n"
-"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
-"      两个角色都使用 `--async-scheduling` 运行。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都通过 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 使用 Model Runner V2。\n"
-"      Prefill 使用 PCP8 和 TP1；Decode 保持 PCP1。\n"
-"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到启动器分配的设备。\n"
-"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` 通告对等节点用于访问每个引擎以进行 KV 传输的 IP。\n"
-"      Prefill 启用 FlashComm1 和共享专家 DP；\n"
-"      Decode 启用重计算调度器和 NPU 图扩展，同时\n"
-"      保持 FlashComm1 禁用以及静态/超级内核禁用。\n"
-"    - MTP 投机解码在 A2 系列上使用三个投机 token。\n"
-"      Prefill 使用 `enforce_eager: true`；Decode 使用 `enforce_eager: false`\n"
-"      并采用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
-"    - Decode 上的 `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` 和 `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE`\n"
-"      为每个 DP rank 预留一个互不重叠的 100 端口窗口（从\n"
-"      `60000 + rank * 100` 开始）。当多个引擎共享一个节点时，这些\n"
-"      范围可防止 HCCL 主机侧套接字在不同 rank 之间静默共享\n"
-"      端口，从而避免阻塞引擎启动。\n"
-"    - 其余超时和运行时变量\n"
-"      （`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`、`HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`、\n"
-"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`、`VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`、`OMP_PROC_BIND`、\n"
-"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`）是针对此模型大小经过验证的 A2 系列启动默认值；\n"
-"      除非你的环境需要不同的值，否则请保持这些设置。\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和所有套接字接口变量必须选择\n"
-"      配置的节点 IP 所使用的服务网络。DP RPC、\n"
-"      引擎、Mooncake 和代理端口必须被主机\n"
-"      防火墙允许。"

+msgid ""
+"This example uses two A3 series servers. The Prefill node runs one\n"
+"    DP rank with TP1/PCP16 (DP1/TP1/PCP16), and the Decode node runs 16 DP ranks\n"

+"    respective servers. `MooncakeConnectorV2` transfers KV cache from the\n"
+"    Prefill engines to the Decode engines."

+"本示例使用两台 A3 系列服务器。Prefill 节点运行一个\n"
+"    DP rank，配置为 TP1/PCP16（DP1/TP1/PCP16）；Decode 节点运行 16 个 DP rank，\n"
+"    配置为 TP1（DP16/TP1）。两种布局都会用满各自服务器上的全部 16 个逻辑\n"
+"    设备。`MooncakeConnectorV2` 将 KV cache 从\n"
+"    Prefill 引擎传输到 Decode 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start Decode first, then Prefill. In another terminal, check "

+"After all Prefill and Decode engines are ready, open another terminal in\n"

+"    该代理监听端口 `8081`，将 Prefill 请求发送到\n"

+"    `9900-9915`。"

+msgid ""
+"- Prefill uses DP1/TP1/PCP16: its engine receives 16\n"
+"      devices from `launch_online_dp.py`. Decode uses DP16/TP1: each of its\n"
+"      16 engines receives one device. Both roles use all 16 logical devices\n"
+"      on their respective A3 series nodes.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate DP\n"
+"      ranks within one role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node IPs.\n"
+"      The default RPC port `12325` can be reused on the separate hosts.\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` selects the launcher-assigned devices\n"
+"      for each engine.\n"
+"    - The Prefill API port is `9081`; Decode API ports are `9900-9915`.\n"
+"      All 17 endpoints must be reachable from the proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2, INT8 main KV cache,\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`, MTP5, and\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`. Both roles explicitly enable ReplaySSM and prefix caching.\n"
+"    - Prefill runs the target eagerly and enables draft graph execution.\n"
+"      It enables asynchronous EPLB with the `stair` policy and `hixl`\n"
+"      communicator, a window and step interval of 300, and 16 redundant experts. The Prefill configuration sets `enable_fused_mc2` to `2`\n"
+"      and `enable_shared_expert_dp` to `true`.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 32` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`. Decode uses `40` and `240`, respectively.\n"
+"    - Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with default capture sizes, NpuGraphEx,\n"
+"      StaticKernel, shared-expert DP and fused MC2 mode 2. FlashComm1,\n"
+"      shared-expert multistream overlap and SuperKernel are disabled.\n"
+"      QKV input-projection TP is 8 and output-projection TP is 1.\n"
+"      Recompute scheduling is enabled through `scheduler_config`.\n"
+"    - Both roles allow up to seven images per prompt and disable video input.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` and engine ID `0` on Prefill,\n"
+"      and `kv_consumer` and engine ID `1` on Decode. These IDs identify the\n"
+"      roles in this deployment. Base KV ports are `36680` and `36580`.\n"
+"    - The HCCS resource settings select device communication; `HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      and the socket interface variables select the host network. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be available on the respective hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 采用 DP1/TP1/PCP16：其引擎从 `launch_online_dp.py` 接收 16\n"
+"      个设备。Decode 采用 DP16/TP1：其 16 个引擎各自接收一个设备。两种角色都使用\n"
+"      各自 A3 系列节点上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 用于协调同一角色内的 DP\n"
+"      rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自节点的 IP。\n"
+"      默认 RPC 端口 `12325` 可以在不同主机上复用。\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` 为每个引擎选择启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"    - Prefill API 端口为 `9081`；Decode API 端口为 `9900-9915`。\n"
+"      代理必须能够访问全部 17 个端点。\n"
+"    - 两种角色都使用 Model Runner V2、INT8 主 KV cache、\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`、MTP5 以及\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`。两种角色都显式启用 ReplaySSM 和前缀缓存。\n"

+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 32` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`。Decode 分别使用 `40` 和 `240`。\n"
+"    - Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 及默认 capture size、NpuGraphEx、\n"
+"      StaticKernel、shared-expert DP 和 fused MC2 模式 2。FlashComm1、\n"
+"      shared-expert 多流重叠和 SuperKernel 均被禁用。\n"

+"      通过 `scheduler_config` 启用重计算调度。\n"
+"    - 两种角色都允许每个 prompt 最多七张图像，并禁用视频输入。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer` 和引擎 ID `0`，\n"
+"      在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer` 和引擎 ID `1`。这些 ID 用于标识本部署中的\n"
+"      各个角色。基础 KV 端口为 `36680` 和 `36580`。\n"
+"    - HCCS 资源配置用于选择设备通信；`HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      和 socket 接口变量用于选择主机网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在相应主机上可用。"
+
+msgid ""

+"      D0 and D1 each run four API-serving TP2 engines(total DP8) through their\n"
+"      node-specific wrapper scripts.\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` enables `use_ascend_direct` for direct\n"
+"      NPU-to-NPU KV transfer and declares the actual Prefill and Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` topology. The declared values must match the\n"
+"      real deployment.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`\n"
+"      without `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `--max-num-seqs 40` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240` with `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` and\n"
+"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"      Both roles run with `--async-scheduling`.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2 via `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
+"      Prefill uses PCP8 and TP1; Decode keeps PCP1.\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each engine to the launcher-assigned devices.\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` advertises the IP that peers use to reach each\n"
+"      engine for KV transfer. Prefill enables FlashComm1 and shared-expert DP;\n"
+"      Decode enables the recompute scheduler and NPU graph extension while\n"
+"      keeping FlashComm1 disabled and static/super kernels disabled.\n"
+"    - MTP speculative decoding uses three speculative tokens on A2 series.\n"
+"      Prefill uses `enforce_eager: true`; Decode uses `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` and `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` on\n"
+"      Decode reserve a disjoint 100-port window per DP rank (starting at\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100`). When several engines share one node, these\n"
+"      ranges prevent the HCCL host-side sockets from silently sharing\n"
+"      ports across ranks, which can block engine startup.\n"
+"    - The remaining timeout and runtime variables\n"
+"      (`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`,\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, `OMP_PROC_BIND`,\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`) are the validated A2 series startup defaults for this\n"
+"      model size; keep them unless your environment requires different\n"
+"      values.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and all socket interface variables must select the\n"
+"      service network used by the configured node IPs. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      engine, Mooncake, and proxy ports must be allowed by the host\n"
+"      firewall."
+msgstr ""
+"- A2 系列采用全局 DP2/TP1/PCP8 的 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 的 Decode，每种\n"
+"      角色分布在两个节点上，每节点八个设备。A3 普通 PD 采用\n"
+"      DP1/TP1/PCP16 的 Prefill 和 DP16/TP1 的 Decode，各自位于一个具有 16 个逻辑设备的节点上。\n"
+"    - P0 和 P1 使用共享启动器，各自有一个本地 DP rank。P0\n"
+"      通过 `--api-server-count 1` 暴露 Prefill API；P1 为 headless 模式。\n"
+"      D0 和 D1 各自通过其节点专用的封装脚本运行四个提供 API 服务的 TP2 引擎（总 DP8）。\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` 为直接的\n"
+"      NPU 到 NPU KV 传输启用 `use_ascend_direct`，并声明实际的 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` 拓扑。声明的值必须与\n"
+"      实际部署一致。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`，\n"
+"      不使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `--max-num-seqs 40` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240`，并设置 `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` 和\n"
+"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"      两种角色都以 `--async-scheduling` 运行。\n"
+"    - 两种角色都通过 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 使用 Model Runner V2。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 PCP8 和 TP1；Decode 保持 PCP1。\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` 通告对端用于访问各\n"
+"      引擎进行 KV 传输的 IP。Prefill 启用 FlashComm1 和 shared-expert DP；\n"
+"      Decode 启用重计算调度器和 NPU 图扩展，同时\n"
+"      保持 FlashComm1 禁用以及静态/超级 kernel 禁用。\n"
+"    - MTP 投机推理在 A2 系列上使用三个投机 token。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 `enforce_eager: true`；Decode 使用 `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      并采用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"    - Decode 上的 `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` 和 `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE`\n"
+"      为每个 DP rank 预留互不重叠的 100 个端口窗口（从\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100` 开始）。当多个引擎共享一个节点时，这些\n"
+"      范围可防止 HCCL 主机侧 socket 在各 rank 之间静默共用\n"
+"      端口，从而避免阻塞引擎启动。\n"
+"    - 其余超时和运行时变量\n"
+"      （`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`、`HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`、\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`、`VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`、`OMP_PROC_BIND`、\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`）是针对该模型规模经验证的 A2 系列启动默认值；\n"
+"      除非你的环境需要不同的值，否则请保持这些默认值。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和所有 socket 接口变量必须选择\n"
+"      已配置节点 IP 所使用的服务网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      引擎、Mooncake 和代理端口必须被主机\n"
+"      防火墙放行。"
 
 msgid ""
 "Reuse the Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8 topology,\n"
 "    launcher and proxy from [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-950dt).\n"
 "    Both roles use EP8, FP8 main KV cache and an FP8 indexer.\n"
-"    For this pool example, keep `--max-model-len 133120`,\n"
-"    `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\": 1, \"video\": 0}'` and explicit\n"
-"    `--enable-chunked-prefill` on both roles. Prefill uses\n"
-"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=3072`, `--max-num-seqs 256`,\n"
-"    `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`, `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` and\n"
-"    `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true`; keep `enable_flashcomm1: false`,\n"
-"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` and `enable_shared_expert_dp: false` on Prefill.\n"
-"    Retain `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`, `ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`\n"
-"    and `--allowed-local-media-path /` on both roles. Decode uses\n"
-"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`,\n"
-"    `--max-num-seqs 30`, `--max-num-batched-tokens 120`,\n"
-"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` and `enable_npugraph_ex: false`."
+"    Keep the ordinary PD serving parameters on both roles, including the\n"
+"    context length, multimodal limits, scheduling limits, HCCL buffer sizes,\n"
+"    memory utilization, MTP and role-specific tuning options. Apply only the\n"
+"    pooling changes below.\n"
+"    Add `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` and `ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`\n"
+"    on both roles for the Memcache backend."
 msgstr ""
 "复用 [第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-950dt) 中的 Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 和 Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8 拓扑、\n"
 "    启动器和代理。\n"
-"    两个角色均使用 EP8、FP8 主 KV 缓存和 FP8 indexer。\n"
-"    对于此池示例，在两个角色上保持 `--max-model-len 133120`、\n"
-"    `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\": 1, \"video\": 0}'` 和显式\n"
-"    `--enable-chunked-prefill`。Prefill 使用\n"
-"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=3072`、`--max-num-seqs 256`、\n"
-"    `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` 和\n"
-"    `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true`；在 Prefill 上保持 `enable_flashcomm1: false`、\n"
-"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` 和 `enable_shared_expert_dp: false`。\n"
-"    在两个角色上保留 `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`、`ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`\n"
-"    和 `--allowed-local-media-path /`。Decode 使用\n"
-"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`、\n"
-"    `--max-num-seqs 30`、`--max-num-batched-tokens 120`、\n"
-"    `enable_fused_mc2: 0` 和 `enable_npugraph_ex: false`。"
-
-msgid ""
-"Keep prefix caching, chunked prefill and the hybrid KV cache manager\n"
-"    enabled. With prefix caching enabled, the model configuration selects\n"
-"    `mamba_cache_mode=align`, which is required by `AscendStoreConnector`.\n"
-"    Remove `--use-replayssm` from both role scripts for this pooling scenario.\n"
-"    Keep `use_layerwise=false` and PP=DCP=1. Do not enable\n"
-"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)\n"
-"    for this deployment: its KV-transfer path does not accept `MultiConnector`."
-msgstr ""
-"保持前缀缓存、分块 prefill 和混合 KV 缓存管理器\n"
-"    启用。启用前缀缓存后，模型配置会选择\n"
-"    `mamba_cache_mode=align`，这是 `AscendStoreConnector` 所要求的。\n"
-"    对于此池化场景，从两个角色脚本中移除 `--use-replayssm`。\n"
-"    保持 `use_layerwise=false` 和 PP=DCP=1。不要为此部署启用\n"
-"    [RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)：\n"
-"    其 KV 传输路径不接受 `MultiConnector`。"
+"    两种角色都使用 EP8、FP8 主 KV cache 和 FP8 indexer。\n"
+"    在两种角色上保留普通 PD 的服务参数，包括\n"
+"    上下文长度、多模态限制、调度限制、HCCL 缓冲区大小、\n"
+"    内存利用率、MTP 以及角色特定的调优选项。仅应用下面的\n"
+"    池化相关变更。\n"
+"    在两种角色上为 Memcache 后端添加 `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` 和\n"
+"    `ASCEND_LOCAL_COMM_RES='{\"version\":\"1.3\"}'`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep `--use-replayssm` and `--enable-prefix-caching` on both roles,\n"
+"    as in ordinary PD. The pool connector uses `use_layerwise=false`."
+msgstr ""
+"与普通 PD 一样，在两种角色上都保留 `--use-replayssm` 和\n"
+"    `--enable-prefix-caching`。池连接器使用 `use_layerwise=false`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. On the Decode node, replace the final `--kv-transfer-config`\n"
+"       argument in `run_dp_template.sh` with the following fragment.\n"
+"       Keep the remaining Decode flags from Section 5.3, including\n"
+"       `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`, the FP8 indexer, MTP5 and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`."
+msgstr ""
+"2. 在 Decode 节点上，将 `run_dp_template.sh` 中最后的\n"
+"`--kv-transfer-config` 参数替换为以下片段。\n"
+"保留 5.3 节中其余的 Decode 标志，包括\n"
+"`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`、FP8 indexer、MTP5 和 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`$4` is the DP rank passed by the launcher. The Prefill lookup value\n"
+"    is `37000`; the Decode values are `37100-37107`. `lookup_rpc_port`\n"
+"    identifies the local IPC endpoint between the pooling scheduler and\n"
+"    worker. Prefill loads and saves pooled prefixes; Decode receives KV\n"
+"    cache through `MooncakeConnectorV2` and contributes DRAM pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"`$4` 是由启动器传入的 DP rank。Prefill 的 lookup 值为\n"
+"`37000`；Decode 的值为 `37100-37107`。`lookup_rpc_port`\n"
+"用于标识池化调度器与 worker 之间的本地 IPC 端点。\n"
+"Prefill 加载并保存池化后的 prefix；Decode 通过 `MooncakeConnectorV2`\n"
+"接收 KV cache，并提供 DRAM 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This KV Cache Pool example uses DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode,\n"
+"    using Model Runner V2 and native KDA. Prepare separate `run_p.sh` and\n"
+"    `run_d.sh` files for this scenario from the [A3 series PD example](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3).\n"
+"    Before adding the pool connectors, restore these pool-specific settings:"
+msgstr ""
+"此 KV Cache Pool 示例使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8 的 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 的 Decode，\n"
+"并采用 Model Runner V2 和原生 KDA。请基于 [A3系列 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)\n"
+"为该场景准备独立的 `run_p.sh` 和 `run_d.sh` 文件。\n"
+"在添加 pool 连接器之前，请先恢复以下 pool 专属设置："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Use Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP8 and Decode DP8/TP2 with the startup commands below.\n"
+"    - Set `num_speculative_tokens` to `3` on both roles, remove `--use-replayssm`,\n"
+"      and set `--limit-mm-per-prompt` to `'{\"image\":1}'`.\n"
+"    - On Prefill, set EPLB `window_size` and `step_interval` to `3000`,\n"
+"      and `num_redundant_experts` to `0`; remove `--api-server-count 1`.\n"
+"    - On Decode, set `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`; set `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` and `enable_flashcomm1`\n"
+"      to `true`. Remove `enable_fused_mc2`, `finegrained_tp_config`, and\n"
+"      `ascend_compilation_config` from `--additional-config`."
+msgstr ""
+"- 使用下文的启动命令，采用 Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP8 和 Decode DP8/TP2。\n"
+"    - 在两个角色上都将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设为 `3`，移除 `--use-replayssm`，\n"
+"      并将 `--limit-mm-per-prompt` 设为 `'{\"image\":1}'`。\n"
+"    - 在 Prefill 上，将 EPLB 的 `window_size` 和 `step_interval` 设为 `3000`，\n"
+"      并将 `num_redundant_experts` 设为 `0`；移除 `--api-server-count 1`。\n"
+"    - 在 Decode 上，设置 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024`；将 `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` 和 `enable_flashcomm1`\n"
+"      设为 `true`。从 `--additional-config` 中移除 `enable_fused_mc2`、`finegrained_tp_config` 和\n"
+"      `ascend_compilation_config`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`, INT8 main KV cache,\n"
+"    BF16 SSM state, and the role-specific scheduling limits.\n"
+"    Prefill uses 32 sequences and 16384 batched tokens; Decode uses 40\n"
+"    sequences and 240 batched tokens. Both roles limit image input to one image.\n"
+"    Add `--enable-prefix-caching` for this pooling example.\n"
+"    Add the Memcache environment settings and replace the connectors as\n"
+"    described below. Use the pool launch commands below and override the proxy\n"
+"    engine counts for this topology."
+msgstr ""
+"保留 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"`、INT8 主 KV cache、\n"
+"BF16 SSM 状态以及各角色专属的调度限制。\n"
+"Prefill 使用 32 个序列和 16384 个批处理 token；Decode 使用 40\n"
+"个序列和 240 个批处理 token。两个角色均将图像输入限制为一张图像。\n"
+"为此 pooling 示例添加 `--enable-prefix-caching`。\n"
+"添加 Memcache 环境设置，并按下文说明替换连接器。使用下文的\n"
+"pool 启动命令，并为此拓扑覆盖 proxy 引擎数量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This example stores pooled KV cache in DRAM memory on both the Prefill\n"
+"    and Decode nodes. The Memcache LocalService initializes within each vLLM\n"
+"    worker, and each worker contributes `20GB` of DRAM memory to the pool.\n"
+"    Decode receives KV cache through `MooncakeConnectorV2`."
+msgstr ""
+"此示例将池化后的 KV cache 存储在 Prefill 和 Decode 节点的\n"
+"DRAM 内存中。Memcache LocalService 在每个 vLLM\n"
+"worker 内初始化，每个 worker 向池贡献 `20GB` 的 DRAM 内存。\n"
+"Decode 通过 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 接收 KV cache。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`dram.size` specifies the DRAM capacity allocated per worker. Prefill\n"
+"    (DP2/TP1/PCP8) and Decode (DP8/TP2) each start 16 workers. At `20GB` per worker,\n"
+"    each node contributes `320GB`, for a total DRAM pool capacity of `640GB`.\n"
+"    Reserve sufficient DRAM memory for the operating system and vLLM. For\n"
+"    `device_sdma`, keep each non-zero size aligned to `1GB`."
+msgstr ""
+"`dram.size` 指定为每个 worker 分配的 DRAM 容量。Prefill\n"
+"（DP2/TP1/PCP8）和 Decode（DP8/TP2）各自启动 16 个 worker。按每个 worker `20GB` 计算，\n"
+"每个节点贡献 `320GB`，DRAM 池总容量为 `640GB`。\n"
+"请为操作系统和 vLLM 预留充足的 DRAM 内存。对于\n"
+"`device_sdma`，每个非零大小都应保持为 `1GB` 的整数倍。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace the final `--kv-transfer-config` argument in `run_p.sh` with the\n"
+"    following fragment. Keep the pool-specific overrides above and\n"
+"    the remaining A3 series Prefill flags, including\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 32`."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `run_p.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config` 参数替换为以下片段。\n"
+"保留上述 pool 专属覆盖设置，以及\n"
+"其余的 A3系列 Prefill 标志，包括\n"
+"`--max-num-seqs 32`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace the final `--kv-transfer-config` argument in `run_d.sh` with the\n"
+"    following fragment. Keep the pool-specific overrides above, including\n"
+"    MTP3 without ReplaySSM, and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode."
+msgstr ""
+"将 `run_d.sh` 中最后的 `--kv-transfer-config` 参数替换为以下片段。\n"
+"保留上述 pool 专属覆盖设置，包括\n"
+"不使用 ReplaySSM 的 MTP3，以及 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。"
+
+msgid ""
+"2. Start Decode with DP8/TP2. Wait until all eight engines on ports\n"
+"       `9900-9907` are ready and their Memcache LocalServices have reserved\n"
+"       the configured DRAM pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"2. 以 DP8/TP2 启动 Decode。等待端口\n"
+"       `9900-9907` 上的全部八个引擎就绪，且其 Memcache LocalService 已预留\n"
+"       配置的 DRAM 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"3. Start Prefill with DP2/TP1/PCP8. Wait until both engines on ports\n"
+"       `9081-9082` are ready and their Memcache LocalServices have reserved\n"
+"       the configured DRAM pool memory."
+msgstr ""
+"3. 以 DP2/TP1/PCP8 启动 Prefill。等待端口\n"
+"       `9081-9082` 上的两个引擎就绪，且其 Memcache LocalService 已预留\n"
+"       配置的 DRAM 池内存。"
+
+msgid ""
+"4. In a separate terminal, set `export P_N=2 D_N=8`, then run the\n"
+"       [A3 series proxy script](#glm53-flash-a3-proxy). It uses Prefill ports\n"
+"       `9081-9082` and Decode ports `9900-9907` for this pooling scenario.\n"
+"       Send requests to `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:8081` using\n"
+"       [Functional Verification](#6-functional-verification)."
+msgstr ""
+"4. 在另一个终端中设置 `export P_N=2 D_N=8`，然后运行\n"
+"       [A3系列 proxy 脚本](#glm53-flash-a3-proxy)。此池化场景中，它使用 Prefill 端口\n"
+"       `9081-9082` 和 Decode 端口 `9900-9907`。\n"
+"       使用[功能验证](#6-functional-verification)向 `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:8081`\n"
+"       发送请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The following settings are used in the A3 series reference\n"
+"configuration in [A3 series PD example](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3). Use the same W8A8 weights\n"
+"and role-specific settings when reproducing the deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"以下设置用于 [A3系列 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) 中的\n"
+"A3系列参考配置。复现该部署时，请使用相同的 W8A8 权重\n"
+"和各角色专属设置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| FlashComm1 | Decode | `enable_flashcomm1: false` | Disabled in this TP1 "
+"Decode layout. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| FlashComm1 | Decode | `enable_flashcomm1: false` | 在此 TP1 Decode 布局中禁用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Prefill context parallelism | Prefill | `--prefill-context-parallel-size "
+"16` | The TP1 Prefill engine uses all 16 devices. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Prefill 上下文并行 | Prefill | `--prefill-context-parallel-size 16` | TP1 "
+"Prefill 引擎使用全部 16 个设备。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Shared-expert overlap | Decode | `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: "
+"false`, `enable_fused_mc2: 2` | Disables shared-expert overlap and enables "
+"fused MC2 mode 2. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 共享专家重叠 | Decode | `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: "
+"false`、`enable_fused_mc2: 2` | 禁用共享专家重叠，并启用 fused MC2 模式 2。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Decode execution | Decode | `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, NpuGraphEx, StaticKernel |"
+" Uses graph execution; SuperKernel is disabled. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Decode 执行 | Decode | `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`、NpuGraphEx、StaticKernel | "
+"使用图执行；SuperKernel 已禁用。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MTP | Prefill and Decode | `num_speculative_tokens: 5` | Uses draft graph "
+"execution on both roles; the Prefill target is eager. |"

+msgid ""
+"- `HCCL_IF_IP`, `GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`, `HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`: Network interface configuration for multi-node communication. Set `nic_name` to the network interface name (obtained via `ifconfig`) and `local_ip` to the current node's IP address. These must be correctly configured on each node for successful multi-node communication.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size`: Total number of data parallel ranks across all nodes. Use `2` for the A2 two-node deployment and `8` for the A3 two-node deployment.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size-local`: Number of data parallel ranks on the current node. Use `1` for the A2 DP2 deployment and `4` for the A3 DP8 deployment.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address`: IP address of the data parallel master node (node 0). Must match the `local_ip` of the master node.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-rpc-port`: RPC port for data parallel master communication. Must be the same across all nodes.\n"
+"- `--headless`: Indicates this is a non-master node. Do not use on node 0.\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank`: Starting rank offset for data parallel ranks on this node. Node 0 uses `0`; node 1 uses the number of DP ranks on node 0 (e.g., `1` for DP2, `4` for DP8)."
+msgstr ""
+"- `HCCL_IF_IP`、`GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME`、`HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME`：用于多节点通信的网卡配置。将 `nic_name` 设置为网卡名称（可通过 `ifconfig` 获取），将 `local_ip` 设置为当前节点的 IP 地址。必须在每个节点上正确配置这些参数，才能成功进行多节点通信。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size`：所有节点上的数据并行 rank 总数。A2 双节点部署使用 `2`，A3 双节点部署使用 `8`。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size-local`：当前节点上的数据并行 rank 数量。A2 DP2 部署使用 `1`，A3 DP8 部署使用 `4`。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-address`：数据并行主节点（节点 0）的 IP 地址。必须与主节点的 `local_ip` 保持一致。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-rpc-port`：用于数据并行主节点通信的 RPC 端口。所有节点必须保持一致。\n"
+"- `--headless`：表示当前节点为非主节点。不要在节点 0 上使用。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-start-rank`：当前节点上数据并行 rank 的起始偏移量。节点 0 使用 `0`；节点 1 使用节点 0 上的 DP rank 数量（例如 DP2 使用 `1`，DP8 使用 `4`）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Keep `--data-parallel-size-local` consistent with the selected topology; changing it also changes the number of engines and device allocation per node.\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs` should be tuned based on available KV cache memory after model loading. For the w8a8c8 198K scenarios on A3, `6` is a starting point for the high-throughput layout and `16` for the low-latency layout. These layouts use different parallelism and have different per-engine KV cache capacity; their sequence counts are not directly comparable. For w4a8 on A2 multi-node with long context, start with `2` and increase if memory permits.\n"
+"- All nodes in a multi-node deployment must use identical `--tensor-parallel-size`, `--enable-expert-parallel`, and model weight path configurations."
+msgstr ""
+"- 请保持 `--data-parallel-size-local` 与所选拓扑一致；修改它也会改变每个节点上的引擎数量和设备分配。\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs` 应根据模型加载后可用的 KV cache 内存进行调优。对于 A3 上的 w8a8c8 198K 场景，高吞吐布局可从 `6` 开始，低时延布局可从 `16` 开始。这些布局采用不同的并行方式，每个引擎的 KV cache 容量也不同，因此它们的序列数不能直接比较。对于 A2 多节点长上下文场景下的 w4a8，可从 `2` 开始，若内存允许再逐步增大。\n"

+msgid ""
+"The examples enable graph execution for the target model on both platforms. "

+msgid "### 5.3 PD Disaggregation (1P1D) {: #53-pd-disaggregation-1p1d }"
+msgstr "### 5.3 PD 分离（1P1D） {: #53-pd-disaggregation-1p1d }"
+
+msgid ""
+"The scripts keep Prefill and its DSpark draft eager, and enable target graph"
+" execution on Decode. A3 Decode also enables draft graphs; 950DT Decode "
+"keeps the draft eager on both Decode nodes. See [DSpark and KV Cache "
+"Configuration](#921-dspark-and-kv-cache-configuration)."
+msgstr ""
+"这些脚本将 Prefill 及其 DSpark draft 保持为 eager 模式，并在 Decode 上启用目标模型图执行。Atlas "
+"A3系列产品的 Decode 还会启用 draft 图；Ascend 950DT系列产品的 Decode 则在两个 Decode 节点上都保持 "
+"draft 为 eager 模式。参见 [DSpark 与 KV Cache 配置](#921-dspark-and-kv-cache-"
+"configuration)。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the following as `run_prefill.sh` on the Prefill node. The script "
+"selects CANN MegaMoE (`enable_fused_mc2=2`) and requires "
+"`cann_ops_transformer` in the Prefill environment."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 节点上将以下内容保存为 `run_prefill.sh`。该脚本选用 CANN "
+"MegaMoE（`enable_fused_mc2=2`），并要求 Prefill 环境中已安装 `cann_ops_transformer`。"
+
+msgid "**A3 Prefill with 4K inputs**"
+msgstr "**A3 Prefill（4K 输入）**"
+
+msgid ""
+"For 4K inputs, set `MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS`, `MAX_SCHEDULED_TOKENS`, and "
+"`LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` to `2048`. Replace the standalone `--enforce-"
+"eager` flag in `run_prefill.sh` with the following option to enable "
+"piecewise graph capture."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 4K 输入，请将 `MAX_BATCHED_TOKENS`、`MAX_SCHEDULED_TOKENS` 和 "
+"`LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD` 设置为 `2048`。将 `run_prefill.sh` 中单独使用的 "
+"`--enforce-eager` 参数替换为以下选项，以启用分段图捕获（piecewise graph capture）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Startup order | Start Prefill and Decode simultaneously, then start the "
+"Proxy | **Mooncake Master → Start Decode and Prefill simultaneously → "
+"Proxy** |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 启动顺序 | 同时启动 Prefill 和 Decode，然后启动 Proxy | **Mooncake Master → 同时启动 Decode "
+"和 Prefill → Proxy** |"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT_BYTES` sets the per-worker SSD capacity reported to Mooncake Master. Its default is `2TiB` per worker; this is advertised capacity, not an immediate disk allocation.\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_BUCKET_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE` sets the local bucket size limit. Its default is `0`, meaning 90% of the physical disk capacity. Set it explicitly alongside the reported capacity.\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_BUCKET_EVICTION_POLICY=lru` enables least-recently-used eviction, removing old SSD cache entries to make room for new writes within the configured bucket limit."
+msgstr ""
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT_BYTES` 设置每个 worker 上报给 Mooncake Master 的 SSD 容量。其默认值为每个 worker `2TiB`；这是对外声明的容量，并非立即分配的磁盘空间。\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_BUCKET_MAX_TOTAL_SIZE` 设置本地 bucket 的大小上限。其默认值为 `0`，表示物理磁盘容量的 90%。请将其与上报容量一起显式设置。\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_BUCKET_EVICTION_POLICY=lru` 启用最近最少使用（LRU）淘汰策略，在配置的 bucket 上限内移除旧的 SSD 缓存条目，为新的写入腾出空间。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save as `run_prefill.sh` alongside `mooncake.json`. Like the A3 Prefill "
+"script in [Section 5.3](#53-pd-disaggregation-1p1d), this script selects "
+"CANN MegaMoE (`enable_fused_mc2=2`) and requires `cann_ops_transformer` in "
+"the Prefill environment. Apply the same 4K-input overrides from that section"
+" when serving 4K inputs."
+msgstr ""
+"保存为 `run_prefill.sh`，并与 `mooncake.json` 放在同一目录。与 [第 5.3 节](#53-pd-"
+"disaggregation-1p1d)中的 A3 Prefill 脚本一样，该脚本选用 CANN "
+"MegaMoE（`enable_fused_mc2=2`），并要求 Prefill 环境中已安装 `cann_ops_transformer`。在服务 "
+"4K 输入时，请应用该节中相同的 4K 输入覆盖配置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"### 5.5 1M-Token Context Deployment {: #55-1m-token-context-deployment }"
+msgstr "### 5.5 1M Token 上下文部署 {: #55-1m-token-context-deployment }"
+
+msgid ""
+"Both platforms use a text-only 1P1D topology: one Prefill service on one "
+"host and one distributed Decode service spanning two hosts. Here, 1M means "
+"**1,048,576 input tokens**. Both profiles set `--max-model-len 1050624`, "
+"reserving 2048 positions for generation, and disable local prefix caching on"
+" all roles. Select the hardware tab for its topology, scripts, launch "
+"commands, and verification workload."
+msgstr ""
+"两个平台均采用纯文本 1P1D 拓扑：一台主机上运行一个 Prefill 服务，一个分布式 Decode 服务跨两台主机部署。此处的 1M 指 "
+"**1,048,576 个输入 token**。两个配置都设置 `--max-model-len 1050624`，为生成预留 2048 "
+"个位置，并在所有角色上禁用本地前缀缓存。请选择对应的硬件标签页，查看其拓扑、脚本、启动命令和验证负载。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Decode reserves about 45.1 GiB of KV cache per worker. To retain workspace "
+"for the attention operators, it prefetches router and attention-projection "
+"weights from CPU using `gate.weight`, `qkv_proj.weight`, and "
+"`o_proj.weight`. Other weights remain on NPU. Decode uses `weight_nz_mode=0`"
+" so the selected projection weights use ordinary layouts for prefetching. "
+"Allow for these CPU-to-NPU transfers when evaluating latency; tune "
+"performance separately."
+msgstr ""
+"Decode 为每个 worker 预留约 45.1 GiB 的 KV cache。为给注意力算子保留工作空间，它使用 "
+"`gate.weight`、`qkv_proj.weight` 和 `o_proj.weight` 从 CPU 预取 router "
+"权重和注意力投影权重。其余权重仍保留在 NPU 上。Decode 使用 "
+"`weight_nz_mode=0`，使所选的投影权重采用普通布局以便预取。评估时延时请考虑这些 CPU 到 NPU 的传输开销；性能需单独调优。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This text-only W8A8-MXFP8 profile uses three 950DT products hosts, each with"
+" eight 96 GB NPUs (24 NPUs in total). One Prefill service uses DP1 × TP4 × "
+"PP2 on the first host. One distributed Decode service uses a global DP4 × "
+"TP4 × PP1 / EP16 group across the other two hosts: D1 serves ranks 0–1 and "
+"D2 serves ranks 2–3. Each Decode host exposes one HTTP API for its two local"
+" ranks; D2 also serves HTTP and must not use `--headless`."
+msgstr ""
+"这个纯文本 W8A8-MXFP8 配置使用三台 Ascend 950DT系列产品主机，每台配备 8 个 96 GB NPU（共 24 个 NPU）。一个"
+" Prefill 服务在第一台主机上使用 DP1 × TP4 × PP2。一个分布式 Decode 服务在另外两台主机上组成全局 DP4 × TP4 ×"
+" PP1 / EP16 组：D1 服务 rank 0–1，D2 服务 rank 2–3。每台 Decode 主机为其本地的两个 rank 暴露一个 "
+"HTTP API；D2 同样提供 HTTP 服务，且不得使用 `--headless`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Host | Global DP / TP / PP | Local DP ranks | API port | Batched-token "
+"budget |"
+msgstr "| 主机 | 全局 DP / TP / PP | 本地 DP rank | API 端口 | 批处理 token 预算 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"All roles use Model Runner V2, FP8 main-model KV cache, "
+"`MAX_MODEL_LEN=1050624`, `MAX_NUM_SEQS=1`, and disabled local prefix "
+"caching. DSpark uses seven draft tokens with BF16 draft KV cache and "
+"`enforce_eager=true` on all three hosts. Prefill is eager; Decode keeps "
+"target graph mode `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with capture size 1024 and "
+"`fuse_qknorm_rope=true`. These are the settings used in the recorded 1M run;"
+" the draft graph settings in Section 5.3 were validated separately on "
+"shorter contexts."
+msgstr ""
+"所有角色均使用 Model Runner V2、FP8 主模型 KV "
+"cache、`MAX_MODEL_LEN=1050624`、`MAX_NUM_SEQS=1`，并禁用本地前缀缓存。DSpark 在三台主机上均使用 7 "
+"个 draft token、BF16 draft KV cache 和 `enforce_eager=true`。Prefill 为 eager "
+"模式；Decode 保持目标图模式 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`，捕获大小为 1024，并启用 "
+"`fuse_qknorm_rope=true`。以上为已记录的 1M 运行所使用的设置；第 5.3 节中的 draft "
+"图设置是在较短的上下文上单独验证的。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prefill uses `gpu-memory-utilization=0.85` and `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`; both "
+"Decode hosts use `0.92` and `1024`, respectively. KV memory is allocated "
+"from that budget, without an explicit `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` or CPU "
+"weight offload. The recorded run reported at least 1,306,880 KV tokens on "
+"Prefill and 1,957,760 on each Decode replica, enough for one `1050624`-token"
+" context per replica. Recheck capacity and operator workspace on a different"
+" build before sending a 1M request."
+msgstr ""
+"Prefill 使用 `gpu-memory-utilization=0.85` 和 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=512`；两台 Decode "
+"主机分别使用 `0.92` 和 `1024`。KV 内存从该预算中分配，未显式指定 `--kv-cache-memory-bytes`，也未进行 CPU"
+" 权重卸载。已记录的运行显示，Prefill 上至少有 1,306,880 个 KV token，每个 Decode 副本上有 1,957,760 "
+"个，足以支撑每个副本一个 `1050624` token 的上下文。在不同构建上发送 1M 请求之前，请重新检查容量和算子工作空间。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The recorded runtime used vLLM `5df63a720` (0.32.0), vLLM Ascend "
+"`b04f258fa`, torch_npu `2.10.0.post7`, CANN `9.2.1`, and Mooncake `0.3.13`, "
+"with the native DSpark checkpoint included in the W8A8-MXFP8 weights. Use a "
+"compatible image and the same checkpoint on all three hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"已记录的运行时使用 vLLM `5df63a720`（0.32.0）、vLLM Ascend `b04f258fa`、torch_npu "
+"`2.10.0.post7`、CANN `9.2.1` 和 Mooncake `0.3.13`，W8A8-MXFP8 权重中已包含原生 DSpark "
+"checkpoint。请在三台主机上使用兼容的镜像和相同的 checkpoint。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Complete the communication checks in [Section 3.2](#32-verify-multi-node-"
+"communication), and prepare the containers, platform-specific weights, and "
+"Mooncake dependencies from Sections 4 and 5.3. Replace the IP/NIC "
+"placeholders with each host's communication-network IP and matching "
+"interface. Adjust the CANN environment-script path if needed. Both profiles "
+"use `MooncakeConnectorV1` for direct P→D KV transfer, without a KV cache "
+"pool."
+msgstr ""
+"完成[第 3.2 节](#32-verify-multi-node-communication)中的通信检查，并准备第 4 节和第 5.3 "
+"节中的容器、平台专用权重以及 Mooncake 依赖项。将 IP/NIC 占位符替换为各主机的通信网络 IP 和与之匹配的网卡接口。如有需要，调整 "
+"CANN 环境脚本路径。两种配置均使用 `MooncakeConnectorV1` 进行直接的 P→D KV 传输，不使用 KV 缓存池。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use W8A8 weights. The templates set `VLLM_HOST_IP` as well as the HCCL/GLOO "
+"interfaces so KV-transfer endpoints advertise the intended network."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 W8A8 权重。这些模板会设置 `VLLM_HOST_IP` 以及 HCCL/GLOO 接口，以便 KV 传输端点对外通告预期的网络。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the W8A8-MXFP8 weights and the 950DT container from Section 4. For this "
+"profile, keep the host's `/etc/hixlep` mount and omit the "
+"`/etc/hccl_rootinfo.json` bind mount. The recorded direct-transfer run used "
+"the installed communication SDK's resource discovery, with no rootinfo file "
+"mounted and no `ascend_local_comm_res_path` set in the connector. Keep each "
+"host's own fabric configuration; do not copy another host's identity files. "
+"Verify NPU-buffer transfer among all three hosts as well as the cross-host "
+"Decode HCCL group before loading the model. TCP reachability alone does not "
+"verify the NPU data path."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 W8A8-MXFP8 权重和第 4 节中的 950DT 容器。对于此配置，保留主机的 `/etc/hixlep` 挂载，并省略 "
+"`/etc/hccl_rootinfo.json` 绑定挂载。已记录的直接传输运行使用了所安装通信 SDK 的资源发现机制，未挂载 rootinfo "
+"文件，也未在连接器中设置 `ascend_local_comm_res_path`。保留各主机自身的 fabric "
+"配置；不要复制其他主机的身份文件。在加载模型之前，验证全部三台主机之间的 NPU 缓冲区传输以及跨主机的 Decode HCCL 组。仅凭 TCP "
+"可达性无法验证 NPU 数据通路。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the following role scripts in that directory on their respective hosts."
+" This profile uses native local-DP launch: one `vllm serve` command per "
+"host, with two local DP ranks on each Decode host. It does not use the A3 "
+"`launch_online_dp.py` launcher. Keep `DECODE_HEAD_IP` set to D1's "
+"communication IP on both Decode hosts, with DP RPC port `6885` and KV port "
+"`26900`."
+msgstr ""
+"将以下角色脚本分别保存到各自主机上的该目录中。此配置使用原生本地 DP 启动方式：每台主机执行一条 `vllm serve` 命令，每台 Decode "
+"主机上有两个本地 DP rank。它不使用 A3 的 `launch_online_dp.py` 启动器。在全部两台 Decode 主机上都将 "
+"`DECODE_HEAD_IP` 设置为 D1 的通信 IP，DP RPC 端口为 `6885`，KV 端口为 `26900`。"
+
+msgid "**1. Prefill node: `run_prefill.sh`**"
+msgstr "**1. Prefill 节点：`run_prefill.sh`**"
+
+msgid "**2. First Decode node: `run_decode_head.sh` (DP ranks 0–1)**"
+msgstr "**2. 第一台 Decode 节点：`run_decode_head.sh`（DP rank 0–1）**"
+
+msgid "**3. Second Decode node: `run_decode_worker.sh` (DP ranks 2–3)**"
+msgstr "**3. 第二台 Decode 节点：`run_decode_worker.sh`（DP rank 2–3）**"
+

+"Keep the topology declarations identical in all three connectors. Prefill "
+"uses DP RPC port `6884` and KV port `30000`; Decode uses `6885` and `26900`."

+"P and both D hosts, including when repeating an identical prompt."
+msgstr ""
+"在三个连接器中保持拓扑声明完全一致。Prefill 使用 DP RPC 端口 `6884` 和 KV 端口 `30000`；Decode 使用 "
+"`6885` 和 `26900`。这些端口与 HTTP 端口相互独立。P 节点和两台 D 主机上的前缀缓存保持禁用，即使是重复相同的提示词也是如此。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run the following in `/workspace/m31-1m` on each respective host, from "
+"separate shells. Start all three roles within a few seconds of each other; "
+"both Decode hosts must join the global DP group before initialization can "
+"complete."
+msgstr ""
+"在各自主机上的 `/workspace/m31-1m` 目录中，从不同的 shell 运行以下命令。请在几秒内依次启动全部三个角色；两台 Decode "
+"主机必须都加入全局 DP 组，初始化才能完成。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Wait for all three APIs to print `Application startup complete` and return "
+"HTTP 200 from `/health`: P on `31050`, D1 and D2 on `31060`. Check KV-token "
+"capacity on P and every Decode replica before sending the long prompt."
+msgstr ""
+"等待全部三个 API 输出 `Application startup complete` 并从 `/health` 返回 HTTP 200：P 在 "
+"`31050`，D1 和 D2 在 `31060`。在发送长提示词之前，检查 P 和每个 Decode 副本上的 KV token 容量。"
+
+msgid "**4. Proxy: one Prefill endpoint and two Decode endpoints**"
+msgstr "**4. 代理：一个 Prefill 端点与两个 Decode 端点**"
+
+msgid ""
+"Reuse the proxy prepared in Section 5.3. Start it inside the Prefill "
+"container after setting the host IPs:"
+msgstr "复用第 5.3 节中准备好的代理。设置主机 IP 后，在 Prefill 容器内启动它："
+
+msgid ""
+"The two Decode endpoints front four DP ranks in one distributed service. "
+"Register each host once, keeping the API enabled on D2. Send requests to the"
+" proxy on port `19080` with model name `minimax-m3.1-flash`."
+msgstr ""
+"两个 Decode 端点在一个分布式服务中前端接入四个 DP rank。每台主机只注册一次，并保持 D2 上的 API 处于启用状态。将请求发送到端口 "
+"`19080` 上的代理，模型名称为 `minimax-m3.1-flash`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"First check a short request through the proxy as in Section 6.1. Then "
+"generate the same exact-token retrieval input with the W8A8-MXFP8 tokenizer."
+" The streaming request below uses the recorded workload: 1,048,576 input "
+"tokens and 1024 generated tokens at concurrency one, with `ignore_eos=true`."
+msgstr ""
+"首先按第 6.1 节的方式通过代理检查一个短请求。然后使用 W8A8-MXFP8 分词器生成 token "
+"数量完全相同的检索输入。下面的流式请求使用已记录的工作负载：1,048,576 个输入 token 和 1024 个生成 token，并发度为 "
+"1，并设置 `ignore_eos=true`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Compare `/metrics` snapshots around each request: Prefill "
+"`vllm:prompt_tokens_total` and the receiving Decode rank's "
+"`vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total` must each increase by `1048576`; "
+"local `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total` must have zero increment on all three "
+"hosts. The external-prefix hit measures this request's live P→D KV transfer,"
+" not reuse from an earlier request. Check that `vllm:num_preemptions_total` "
+"does not increase. Repeat validation through the other Decode host when "
+"reproducing the deployment."
+msgstr ""
+"比较每个请求前后的 `/metrics` 快照：Prefill 的 `vllm:prompt_tokens_total` 和接收方 Decode "
+"rank 的 `vllm:external_prefix_cache_hits_total` 都必须增加 `1048576`；全部三台主机上本地 "
+"`vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total` 的增量必须为零。外部前缀命中衡量的是本次请求实时的 P→D KV "
+"传输，而非对先前请求的复用。检查 `vllm:num_preemptions_total` 未增加。复现该部署时，可通过另一台 Decode "
+"主机重复验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The recorded run completed three serial streaming curl requests with these "
+"token counts, all three retrieval values present, zero local prefix-cache "
+"hits, and no preemption. This validates the serving configuration with an "
+"eager DSpark draft; 1M draft graph execution and concurrent 1M requests were"
+" not tested. The responses contained a thinking block before the correct "
+"JSON and trailing newlines after it: `ignore_eos=true` forces 1024 generated"
+" tokens, so this is not a strict JSON-format or natural-stopping check."
+msgstr ""
+"已记录的运行完成了三次串行流式 curl 请求，token 数量如上，三次检索值均存在，本地前缀缓存命中为零，且未发生抢占。这验证了带有 eager "
+"DSpark draft 的服务配置；1M draft 图执行以及并发的 1M 请求均未经过测试。响应在正确的 JSON "
+"之前包含一个思考块，之后带有尾随换行符：`ignore_eos=true` 会强制生成 1024 个 token，因此这并不是严格的 JSON "
+"格式或自然停止检查。"

 msgid ""
 "- `--tensor-parallel-size 2` maps the model across two Atlas inference devices. Adjust it together with `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` according to the available devices and memory.\n"
-"    - `--dtype float16` is used for Atlas 300I DUO to match the Atlas inference execution path.\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len 16384` is intentionally conservative. On Atlas 300I DUO, large context lengths allocate large attention masks, so do not rely on automatic max-model-len detection.\n"
-"    - `--max-num-seqs 32` limits concurrent active requests to reduce KV cache and graph capture pressure on Atlas 300I DUO.\n"
+"    - `--dtype float16` is used for Atlas 300I Duo to match the Atlas inference execution path.\n"
+"    - `--max-model-len 16384` is intentionally conservative. On Atlas 300I Duo, large context lengths allocate large attention masks, so do not rely on automatic max-model-len detection.\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs 32` limits concurrent active requests to reduce KV cache and graph capture pressure on Atlas 300I Duo.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` controls KV cache capacity. Reduce it if startup or runtime requests report OOM.\n"
-"    - `--additional-config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"fuse_norm_quant\": false, \"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}}'` disables norm-quant fusion and the `npugraph_ex` graph path, which are not used on the Atlas 300I DUO serving path.\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\", \"cudagraph_capture_sizes\": [1,32]}'` enables decode ACLGraph replay and explicitly limits capture sizes to the two batch sizes used by the Atlas 300I DUO example.\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` is the default recommendation for this Atlas 300I DUO example to reduce memory pressure.\n"
+"    - `--additional-config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"fuse_norm_quant\": false, \"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}}'` disables norm-quant fusion and the `npugraph_ex` graph path, which are not used on the Atlas 300I Duo serving path.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\", \"cudagraph_capture_sizes\": [1,32]}'` enables decode ACLGraph replay and explicitly limits capture sizes to the two batch sizes used by the Atlas 300I Duo example.\n"
+"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` is the default recommendation for this Atlas 300I Duo example to reduce memory pressure.\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` enables Ascend quantization for the W8A8 model. Remove this option when deploying the BF16 model.\n"
 "    - To enable MTP speculative decoding, use `--speculative-config '{\"method\": \"mtp\", \"num_speculative_tokens\": 1}'`. We recommend setting `num_speculative_tokens` to 1."
 msgstr ""
-"- `--tensor-parallel-size 2` 将模型分布到两个 Atlas 推理设备上。请根据可用的设备和内存，配合 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 一起调整。\n"
-"    - `--dtype float16` 用于 Atlas 300I DUO，以匹配 Atlas 推理执行路径。\n"
-"    - `--max-model-len 16384` 是有意设置的保守值。在 Atlas 300I DUO 上，较大的上下文长度会分配较大的注意力掩码，因此不要依赖自动检测 max-model-len。\n"
-"    - `--max-num-seqs 32` 限制并发活跃请求数，以减轻 Atlas 300I DUO 上的 KV cache 和图捕获压力。\n"
-"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 控制 KV cache 容量。如果启动或运行时请求报告 OOM，请降低该值。\n"
-"    - `--additional-config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"fuse_norm_quant\": false, \"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}}'` 禁用 norm-quant 融合和 `npugraph_ex` 图路径，这些在 Atlas 300I DUO 服务路径上不会使用。\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\", \"cudagraph_capture_sizes\": [1,32]}'` 启用 decode ACLGraph 重放，并显式将捕获大小限制为 Atlas 300I DUO 示例使用的两个批大小。\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` 是该 Atlas 300I DUO 示例的默认推荐设置，用于减轻内存压力。\n"
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size 2` 将模型分布到两个 Atlas 推理设备上。请根据可用设备和显存，配合 `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` 一同调整。\n"
+"    - `--dtype float16` 在 Atlas 300I Duo 上使用，以匹配 Atlas 推理执行路径。\n"
+"    - `--max-model-len 16384` 是刻意设置的保守值。在 Atlas 300I Duo 上，长上下文会分配很大的 attention mask，因此不要依赖自动检测 max-model-len。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs 32` 限制并发活跃请求数，以降低 Atlas 300I Duo 上的 KV cache 和图捕获压力。\n"
+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 控制 KV cache 容量。如果启动或运行时的请求报告 OOM，请调低该值。\n"
+"    - `--additional-config '{\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"fuse_norm_quant\": false, \"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}}'` 关闭 norm-quant 融合和 `npugraph_ex` 图路径，这两者在 Atlas 300I Duo 的推理服务路径上不会被使用。\n"

+"The runtime mounts the driver libraries, but its default mount list looks "

+"`ascend_manager` 和 `user_config` 设备以及 Atlas 300I Duo 的主机库。请确保它们挂载的每个主机路径都存在。"

+msgid ""
+"Single-node deployment completes both Prefill and Decode within the same "
+"node. `Qwen3.5-2B`, `Qwen3.5-4B`, and `Qwen3.5-9B` can be deployed on Atlas "
+"300I Duo or Atlas 200I Pro."
+msgstr ""
+"单机部署在同一节点内同时完成 Prefill 和 Decode。`Qwen3.5-2B`、`Qwen3.5-4B` 和 `Qwen3.5-9B` "
+"可部署在 Atlas 300I Duo 或 Atlas 200I Pro 上。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size` sets the tensor parallel size. Prefer **TP=1** on Atlas 200I Pro. On Atlas 300I Duo, **TP=1** and **TP=2** are both supported; choose according to the available devices.\n"
+"- `--max-model-len` represents the context length (input plus output for a single request). On Atlas 300I Duo and Atlas 200I Pro, configure this value according to the actual device memory; setting it too high may cause OOM.\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs` indicates the maximum number of requests that can be processed concurrently. On Atlas 300I Duo and Atlas 200I Pro, configure this value according to the actual device memory; setting it too high may cause OOM.\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. On Atlas 300I Duo and Atlas 200I Pro, configure this value according to the actual device memory; setting it too high may cause OOM. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
+"- `--dtype float16` must be set on Atlas 300I Duo and Atlas 200I Pro. These devices only support the FP16 data type.\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` sets the data type of the Mamba SSM cache. On Atlas 300I Duo and Atlas 200I Pro, only `float16` is supported.\n"
 "- `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for Qwen3.5 Dense models that include an MTP head. It is recommended to set `num_speculative_tokens` to `1`.\n"
 "- `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode:\n"
 "    - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`: `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` is recommended.\n"
 "    - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`: when tensor parallelism (TP) is enabled, hardware event-id constraints allow at most two capture sizes (for example, `[1, 8]`). With MTP, calculate each capture size as `n * (num_speculative_tokens + 1)`, where `n` is a capture size for the deployment without MTP. For example, when `num_speculative_tokens` is `1`, the non-MTP sizes `[1,2,4,8]` become `[2,4,8,16]`.\n"
 "- `--additional-config` with `\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}` is required because `enable_npugraph_ex` is not supported on these platforms."
 msgstr ""
-"- `--tensor-parallel-size` 用于设置张量并行大小。在 Atlas 200I Pro 上建议使用 **TP=1**。在 Atlas 300I DUO 上，**TP=1** 和 **TP=2** 均受支持；请根据可用设备进行选择。\n"
-"- `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度（单个请求的输入加输出）。在 Atlas 300I DUO 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过大可能导致 OOM。\n"
-"- `--max-num-seqs` 表示可并发处理的最大请求数。在 Atlas 300I DUO 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过大可能导致 OOM。\n"
-"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。在 Atlas 300I DUO 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过大可能导致 OOM。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
-"- 在 Atlas 300I DUO 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上必须设置 `--dtype float16`。这些设备仅支持 FP16 数据类型。\n"
-"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` 用于设置 Mamba SSM 缓存的数据类型。在 Atlas 300I DUO 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，仅支持 `float16`。\n"
-"- 对于包含 MTP 头的 Qwen3.5 Dense 模型，`--speculative-config` 使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`。建议将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设置为 `1`。\n"
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size` 设置张量并行大小。在 Atlas 200I Pro 上建议优先使用 **TP=1**。在 Atlas 300I Duo 上 **TP=1** 和 **TP=2** 均受支持，可根据可用设备选择。\n"
+"- `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度（单个请求的输入加输出）。在 Atlas 300I Duo 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过高可能导致 OOM。\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs` 表示可并发处理的最大请求数。在 Atlas 300I Duo 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过高可能导致 OOM。\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。在 Atlas 300I Duo 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上，请根据实际设备内存配置该值；设置过高可能导致 OOM。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
+"- 在 Atlas 300I Duo 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上必须设置 `--dtype float16`。这些设备仅支持 FP16 数据类型。\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` 设置 Mamba SSM 缓存的数据类型。在 Atlas 300I Duo 和 Atlas 200I Pro 上仅支持 `float16`。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config` 对包含 MTP 头的 Qwen3.5 Dense 模型使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`。建议将 `num_speculative_tokens` 设置为 `1`。\n"
 "- `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置：\n"
 "    - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：建议使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"
-"    - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：启用张量并行（TP）时，受硬件 event-id 约束，最多允许两个捕获大小（例如 `[1, 8]`）。使用 MTP 时，每个捕获大小按 `n * (num_speculative_tokens + 1)` 计算，其中 `n` 为未使用 MTP 部署时的捕获大小。例如，当 `num_speculative_tokens` 为 `1` 时，非 MTP 的捕获大小 `[1,2,4,8]` 将变为 `[2,4,8,16]`。\n"
+"    - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：启用张量并行（TP）时，受硬件 event-id 约束，最多允许两个捕获大小（例如 `[1, 8]`）。使用 MTP 时，每个捕获大小按 `n * (num_speculative_tokens + 1)` 计算，其中 `n` 为未启用 MTP 部署时的捕获大小。例如，当 `num_speculative_tokens` 为 `1` 时，非 MTP 的大小 `[1,2,4,8]` 将变为 `[2,4,8,16]`。\n"

 msgid ""
 "- `--tensor-parallel-size 2` maps the model across two Atlas inference devices. Adjust it together with `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` according to the available devices and memory.\n"
-"    - `--dtype float16` is used for Atlas 300I DUO to match the Atlas inference execution path.\n"
-"    - `--max-num-seqs 16` limits concurrent active requests to reduce KV cache and graph capture pressure on Atlas 300I DUO.\n"
+"    - `--dtype float16` is used for Atlas 300I Duo to match the Atlas inference execution path.\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs 16` limits concurrent active requests to reduce KV cache and graph capture pressure on Atlas 300I Duo.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` controls KV cache capacity. Reduce it if startup or runtime requests report OOM.\n"
-"    - `--additional-config` with `\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}` is required because `enable_npugraph_ex` is not supported on Atlas 300I DUO.\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\", \"cudagraph_capture_sizes\": [1,8]}'` enables decode ACLGraph replay and explicitly limits capture sizes for Atlas 300I DUO.\n"
-"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` is the default recommendation for this Atlas 300I DUO example to reduce memory pressure.\n"
+"    - `--additional-config` with `\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}` is required because `enable_npugraph_ex` is not supported on Atlas 300I Duo.\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\", \"cudagraph_capture_sizes\": [1,8]}'` enables decode ACLGraph replay and explicitly limits capture sizes for Atlas 300I Duo.\n"
+"    - `--no-enable-prefix-caching` is the default recommendation for this Atlas 300I Duo example to reduce memory pressure.\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` enables Ascend quantization for the W8A8 model. Remove this option when deploying the BF16 model.\n"

@@ -464,8 +411,6 @@ msgid ""
 "        - Generally, if `--max-num-batched-tokens` is set to a larger value, the overall latency will be lower, but the pressure on HBM memory (activation value usage) will be greater.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` indicates that quantization is used. To disable quantization, remove this option.\n"
-"    - `--kv-cache-dtype mxfp8` enables the C8 (MXFP8 KV cache) and is required by the `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8c8-mxfp8` weights. It stores the KV cache of the full-attention layers as FP8 (E4M3) with E8M0 scales, and runs the full-attention layers on the dedicated QFA (quant flash attention) kernel. The W8A8C8 weights bring performance gains in long-sequence scenarios. With this option, `--block-size` must be a multiple of `512` (it defaults to `512` if unset).\n"
-"    - For short-sequence scenarios (e.g., 16K input length), the W8A8 weights (e.g., `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8-mxfp8`) are recommended instead. When serving a W8A8 weight, remove `--kv-cache-dtype mxfp8` from the startup command. Note that C8 quantization is only supported on 950PR&950DT Products.\n"
 "    - `--enable-prefix-caching` enables prefix caching, which is the default behavior. To disable it, use `--no-enable-prefix-caching`. For workloads with long shared prefixes, finer-grained hybrid prefix matching can be enabled with `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16`. The match unit must divide every KV cache group's block size. A smaller unit can reuse more of a partial physical page, at the cost of additional hash metadata, copy-on-write operations, and an extra prefill split at the final matching boundary.\n"
 "    - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for `Qwen3.8-27B` because it shares the same MTP head design as `Qwen3.5-27B`.\n"
 "    - `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode. The most significant configurations are `\"cudagraph_mode\"` and `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`, which have the following meanings:\n"
@@ -479,30 +424,141 @@ msgid ""
 "        - `\"enable_cpu_binding\": true` enables Ascend-native CPU binding, which pins the worker process, key runtime threads, memory pages, and NPU IRQs to CPU ranges close to the driven NPU, reducing cross-NUMA traffic and thread preemption and improving latency stability. It is enabled by default starting from vllm-ascend v0.18.0rc1.\n"
 "        - `\"enable_flashcomm1\": true` enables the FlashComm communication optimization, which splits the tensor-parallel AllReduce into Reduce-Scatter and All-Gather to reduce communication overhead and improve prefill throughput."
 msgstr ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size 1` 和 `--tensor-parallel-size 1` 是数据并行（DP）和张量并行（TP）大小的常用设置。\n"
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1` 和 `--tensor-parallel-size 1` 是数据并行（DP）和张量并行（TP）规模的常见设置。\n"
 "    - `--max-model-len` 表示上下文长度，即单个请求的输入加输出的最大值。\n"
-"    - `--max-num-seqs` 表示每个 DP 组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，超出的请求将保持在等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态所花费的时间也会计入 TTFT 和 TPOT 等指标。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议 `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n"
-"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 表示模型在单步中可处理的最大 token 数。目前，vLLM v1 调度默认启用 ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n"
-"        - (1) 如果请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，将按照 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 分成多轮计算。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-seqs` 表示每个 DP 组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，多余的请求将保持等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态所花费的时间也会计入 TTFT 和 TPOT 等指标。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议 `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 表示模型在单步中能够处理的最大 token 数。目前，vLLM v1 调度默认启用 ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n"
+"        - (1) 如果某个请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，则会按照 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 分为多轮计算。\n"
 "        - (2) Decode 请求优先调度，只有在有可用容量时才会调度 prefill 请求。\n"
-"        - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体延迟会更低，但对 HBM 内存（激活值使用量）的压力会更大。\n"
-"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其本质作用是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 的一次推理过程中的 HBM 内存峰值使用量。然后按如下公式计算可用的 kv_cache 大小：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - HBM 内存峰值使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存使用量可能与实际推理时不同（例如，由于 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理时出现 OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
-"    - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除此选项。\n"
-"    - `--kv-cache-dtype mxfp8` 启用 C8（MXFP8 KV cache），是 `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8c8-mxfp8` 权重所必需的。它将全注意力层的 KV cache 存储为带 E8M0 缩放因子的 FP8（E4M3），并在专用的 QFA（quant flash attention）内核上运行全注意力层。W8A8C8 权重在长序列场景中带来性能提升。使用此选项时，`--block-size` 必须是 `512` 的倍数（如果未设置，默认为 `512`）。\n"
-"    - 对于短序列场景（例如 16K 输入长度），建议改用 W8A8 权重（例如 `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8-mxfp8`）。在服务 W8A8 权重时，请从启动命令中移除 `--kv-cache-dtype mxfp8`。请注意，C8 量化仅在 Ascend 950PR&950DT系列产品上支持。\n"
-"    - `--enable-prefix-caching` 启用前缀缓存，这是默认行为。要禁用它，请使用 `--no-enable-prefix-caching`。对于具有长共享前缀的工作负载，可以通过 `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16` 启用更细粒度的混合前缀匹配。匹配单元必须能整除每个 KV cache 组的块大小。较小的单元可以复用更多部分物理页，代价是额外的哈希元数据、写时复制操作，以及在最终匹配边界处额外的 prefill 拆分。\n"
+"        - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体时延会更低，但对 HBM 内存（激活值使用量）的压力会更大。\n"
+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其本质作用是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 时一次推理过程中的 HBM 内存峰值使用量。可用 kv_cache 大小随后计算为：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - HBM 内存峰值使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存使用量可能与实际推理时不同（例如由于 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理时出现 OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
+"    - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。如需禁用量化，请移除该选项。\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching` 启用前缀缓存，这是默认行为。如需禁用，请使用 `--no-enable-prefix-caching`。对于具有长共享前缀的工作负载，可以通过 `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16` 启用更细粒度的混合前缀匹配。匹配单元必须能整除每个 KV cache 组的块大小。更小的单元可以复用更多部分物理页，代价是额外的哈希元数据、写时复制操作以及在最终匹配边界处额外的 prefill 拆分。\n"
 "    - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.8-27B` 使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它与 `Qwen3.5-27B` 共享相同的 MTP head 设计。\n"
 "    - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n"
-"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子调度的开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"
-"        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：指定捕获图的 batch size 档位。默认值为 `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，每个捕获图的 batch size 是固定的，介于两个相邻捕获大小之间的实际 batch size 会自动向上填充到下一个捕获大小。目前推荐使用默认设置。只有在某些场景下才需要单独设置此参数以达到最佳性能。\n"
-"    - `--allowed-local-media-path` 允许 API 服务器在处理多模态输入时从指定目录读取本地图像或视频。在此示例中，`/` 将整个文件系统列入白名单。这涉及安全敏感性，应仅在可信环境中启用。\n"
-"    - `--mm-processor-cache-gb` 设置多模态处理器缓存的大小（以 GiB 为单位），用于避免重复处理过去的多模态输入。该缓存在每个 API 服务器进程和引擎核心进程中都会复制一份，因此主机内存总使用量为缓存大小乘以这些进程的数量。值为 `0` 将完全禁用此缓存。\n"

+"    - `--mm-processor-cache-gb` 设置多模态处理器缓存的大小（单位为 GiB），用于避免重复处理过去的多模态输入。该缓存在每个 API 服务器进程和引擎核心进程中都会复制一份，因此主机内存总使用量为缓存大小乘以这些进程的数量。值为 `0` 将完全禁用此缓存。\n"

 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Its essential function is to calculate the available kv_cache size. During the warm-up phase (referred to as profile run in vLLM), vLLM records the peak HBM memory usage during an inference process with an input size of `--max-num-batched-tokens`. The available kv_cache size is then calculated as: `--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM size - peak HBM memory usage. Therefore, the larger the value of `--gpu-memory-utilization`, the more kv_cache can be used. However, since the HBM memory usage during the warm-up phase may differ from that during actual inference (e.g., due to uneven EP load), setting `--gpu-memory-utilization` too high may lead to OOM (Out of Memory) issues during actual inference.
