 "    - `--max-num-seqs` 表示每个 DP 组允许处理的最大请求数。如果发送到服务的请求数超过此限制，超出的请求将保持等待状态，不会被调度。请注意，等待状态所花费的时间也会计入 TTFT 和 TPOT 等指标。因此，在测试性能时，通常建议 `--max-num-seqs` * `--data-parallel-size` >= 实际总并发数。\n"
 "    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 表示模型在单步中可处理的最大 token 数。目前，vLLM v1 调度默认启用 ChunkPrefill/SplitFuse，这意味着：\n"
-"        - (1) 如果某个请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，则会按照 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 分成多轮计算。\n"
+"        - (1) 如果某个请求的输入长度大于 `--max-num-batched-tokens`，它将根据 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 被分成多轮计算。\n"
 "        - (2) Decode 请求优先调度，只有在有可用容量时才会调度 prefill 请求。\n"
-"        - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体延迟会更低，但对 HBM 内存（激活值使用量）的压力会更大。\n"
-"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其核心作用是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 时一次推理过程中的 HBM 内存峰值使用量。然后可用 kv_cache 大小计算为：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - HBM 内存峰值使用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存使用量可能与实际推理时不同（例如由于 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理时出现 OOM（内存不足）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
+"        - 通常，如果将 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 设置为较大的值，整体时延会更低，但对 HBM 内存（激活值用量）的压力会更大。\n"
+"    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` 表示 vLLM 将用于实际推理的 HBM 比例。其核心作用是计算可用的 kv_cache 大小。在预热阶段（在 vLLM 中称为 profile run），vLLM 会记录输入大小为 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 的一次推理过程中的 HBM 内存峰值用量。然后可用 kv_cache 大小按如下方式计算：`--gpu-memory-utilization` * HBM 大小 - HBM 内存峰值用量。因此，`--gpu-memory-utilization` 的值越大，可使用的 kv_cache 就越多。然而，由于预热阶段的 HBM 内存用量可能与实际推理期间不同（例如 EP 负载不均衡），将 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 设置得过高可能会导致实际推理期间出现 OOM（Out of Memory）问题。默认值为 `0.9`。\n"
 "    - `--quantization ascend` 表示使用量化。要禁用量化，请移除此选项。\n"
-"    - `--enable-prefix-caching` 启用前缀缓存，这是默认行为。要禁用它，请使用 `--no-enable-prefix-caching`。对于具有长共享前缀的工作负载，可以通过 `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16` 启用更细粒度的混合前缀匹配。匹配单元必须能整除每个 KV 缓存组的块大小。较小的单元可以更多地复用部分物理页，代价是额外的哈希元数据、写时复制操作以及最终匹配边界处额外的 prefill 拆分。\n"
-"    - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.8-27B` 使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它与 `Qwen3.5-27B` 共享相同的 MTP 头设计。\n"
-"    - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，其含义如下：\n"
-"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子调度开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"
-"        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：指定捕获图的批大小档位。默认值为 `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，每个捕获图的批大小是固定的，介于两个相邻捕获大小之间的实际批大小会自动向上填充到下一个捕获大小。目前推荐使用默认设置。仅在部分场景下需要单独设置此参数以达到最优性能。\n"
-"    - `--allowed-local-media-path` 允许 API 服务器在处理多模态输入时从指定目录读取本地图像或视频。在此示例中，`/` 将整个文件系统列入白名单。这涉及安全敏感性，应仅在可信环境中启用。\n"
-"    - `--dtype bfloat16` 设置模型权重和激活值的数据类型。在 Atlas 800I A3 / Atlas 800I A2 上使用 `bfloat16`；而在 Atlas 300I DUO 上则需要使用 `float16`。\n"
-"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` 为 OpenAI 兼容 API 启用推理输出解析器。它将模型的思考内容与最终答案分离，并在 `chat.completions` 响应的 `reasoning_content` 字段中返回。\n"
-"    - `--mm-processor-cache-gb` 设置多模态处理器缓存的大小（以 GiB 为单位），用于避免重复处理过去的多模态输入。该缓存在每个 API 服务器进程和引擎核心进程中都会复制一份，因此主机内存总使用量为缓存大小乘以这些进程的数量。值为 `0` 将完全禁用此缓存。\n"
-"    - `--mm-encoder-tp-mode` 表示如何使用张量并行（TP）优化多模态编码器推理。`data` 将批处理的编码器输入数据拆分到各 TP rank 上，而每个 rank 持有完整的编码器权重，在使用多模态输入时推荐使用。默认模式 `weights` 则将编码器权重拆分到各 TP rank 上。\n"
+"    - `--enable-prefix-caching` 启用前缀缓存，这是默认行为。要禁用它，请使用 `--no-enable-prefix-caching`。对于具有长共享前缀的工作负载，可以通过 `--enable-prefix-caching --prefix-match-unit 16` 启用更细粒度的混合前缀匹配。匹配单元必须能整除每个 KV cache 组的块大小。较小的单元可以更多地复用部分物理页，但代价是额外的哈希元数据、写时复制操作，以及在最终匹配边界处额外的 prefill 拆分。\n"
+"    - `--speculative-config` 对 `Qwen3.8-27B` 使用 `qwen3_5_mtp`，因为它与 `Qwen3.5-27B` 共享相同的 MTP head 设计。\n"
+"    - `--compilation-config` 包含与 aclgraph 图模式相关的配置。最重要的配置是 `\"cudagraph_mode\"` 和 `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`，它们的含义如下：\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`：表示具体的图模式。目前支持 `\"PIECEWISE\"` 和 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。图模式主要用于降低算子下发开销。目前推荐使用 `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"`。\n"
+"        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`：指定捕获图时的 batch size 档位。默认值为 `[1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40,..., --max-num-seqs]`。在图模式下，每个捕获图的 batch size 是固定的，介于两个相邻捕获大小之间的实际 batch size 会自动向上填充到下一个捕获大小。目前推荐使用默认设置。只有在某些场景下才需要单独设置此项以达到最佳性能。\n"
+"    - `--allowed-local-media-path` 允许 API 服务器在处理多模态输入时从指定目录读取本地图像或视频。在本示例中，`/` 将整个文件系统加入白名单。这具有安全敏感性，只应在可信环境中启用。\n"
+"    - `--dtype bfloat16` 设置模型权重和激活值的数据类型。Atlas 800I A3 / Atlas 800I A2 使用 `bfloat16`；而 Atlas 300I Duo 则需要使用 `float16`。\n"
+"    - `--reasoning-parser qwen3` 为 OpenAI 兼容 API 启用推理输出解析器。它会将模型的思考内容与最终答案分离，并在 `chat.completions` 响应的 `reasoning_content` 字段中返回。\n"
+"    - `--mm-processor-cache-gb` 设置多模态处理器缓存的大小（单位为 GiB），该缓存用于避免重复处理过去的多模态输入。该缓存会在每个 API 服务器进程和引擎核心进程中各复制一份，因此主机内存总用量为缓存大小乘以这些进程的数量。值为 `0` 会完全禁用此缓存。\n"
+"    - `--mm-encoder-tp-mode` 表示如何使用张量并行（TP）优化多模态编码器推理。`data` 会将批处理的编码器输入数据拆分到各个 TP rank 上，同时每个 rank 持有完整的编码器权重，在使用多模态输入时推荐使用该模式。默认模式 `weights` 则会将编码器权重拆分到各个 TP rank 上。\n"
 "    - `--mm-processor-cache-type` 设置多模态预处理器和映射器使用的缓存类型。`shm` 使用共享内存 FIFO 缓存，而默认的 `lru` 使用镜像 LRU 缓存。\n"
 "    - `--additional-config` 包含昇腾特有的优化选项：\n"
-"        - `\"enable_cpu_binding\": true` 启用昇腾原生 CPU 绑定，将 worker 进程、关键运行时线程、内存页和 NPU 中断固定到靠近所驱动 NPU 的 CPU 范围，减少跨 NUMA 流量和线程抢占，提高延迟稳定性。从 vllm-ascend v0.18.0rc1 开始默认启用。"
+"        - `\"enable_cpu_binding\": true` 启用昇腾原生 CPU 绑定，它会将 worker 进程、关键运行时线程、内存页和 NPU 中断绑定到靠近所驱动 NPU 的 CPU 范围，从而减少跨 NUMA 流量和线程抢占，并提高时延稳定性。从 vllm-ascend v0.18.0rc1 开始，该选项默认启用。"
 
 msgid ""
 "- `--tensor-parallel-size` sets the tensor parallel size. Choose **TP=2** or **TP=4** according to the available devices.\n"
 "    - `--max-model-len` represents the context length, which is the maximum value of the input plus output for a single request. Configure it based on the actual workload and available memory; `Qwen3.8-27B` supports up to 262144.\n"
 "    - `--max-num-seqs` indicates the maximum number of concurrent requests.\n"
 "    - `--gpu-memory-utilization` represents the proportion of HBM that vLLM will use for actual inference. Configure this value according to the actual device memory; setting it too high may cause OOM. The default value is `0.9`.\n"
-"    - `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` sets the data type of the Mamba SSM cache. On Atlas 300I DUO, only `float16` is supported.\n"
-"    - `--dtype float16` must be set on Atlas 300I DUO. These devices only support the FP16 data type.\n"
-"    - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for `Qwen3.8-27B` because it shares the same MTP head design as `Qwen3.5-27B`. On Atlas 300I DUO, it is recommended to set `num_speculative_tokens` to `1`.\n"
+"    - `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype` sets the data type of the Mamba SSM cache. On Atlas 300I Duo, only `float16` is supported.\n"
+"    - `--dtype float16` must be set on Atlas 300I Duo. These devices only support the FP16 data type.\n"
+"    - `--speculative-config` uses `qwen3_5_mtp` for `Qwen3.8-27B` because it shares the same MTP head design as `Qwen3.5-27B`. On Atlas 300I Duo, it is recommended to set `num_speculative_tokens` to `1`.\n"
 "    - `--compilation-config` contains configurations related to the aclgraph graph mode. The most significant configurations are `\"cudagraph_mode\"` and `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`, which have the following meanings:\n"
 "        - `\"cudagraph_mode\"`: represents the specific graph mode. Currently, `\"PIECEWISE\"` and `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` are supported. The graph mode is mainly used to reduce the cost of operator dispatch. Currently, `\"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"` is recommended.\n"
 "        - `\"cudagraph_capture_sizes\"`: specifies the batch size tiers at which graphs are captured. When tensor parallelism (TP) is enabled, hardware event-id constraints allow at most two capture sizes (for example, `[1, 8]`).\n"
 "        With MTP enabled, calculate each capture size as `n * (num_speculative_tokens + 1)`, where `n` is a capture size for the deployment without MTP. For example, when `num_speculative_tokens` is `1`, the non-MTP sizes `[1,2,4,8]` become `[2,4,8,16]`.\n"
-"    - `--additional-config` with `\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}` is required on Atlas 300I DUO because `enable_npugraph_ex` is not supported on this platform."
+"    - `--additional-config` with `\"ascend_compilation_config\": {\"enable_npugraph_ex\": false}` is required on Atlas 300I Duo because `enable_npugraph_ex` is not supported on this platform."

 msgid ""
-"Set `reasoning_effort` in the top-level Chat Completions request body to adjust\n"
-"the model's reasoning depth. The example above uses `xhigh`; omit the field to\n"
-"use the default `xhigh`. The model officially supports these levels:"
+"PD disaggregation separates Prefill and Decode into different service "
+"groups. Prefill groups process large prompt chunks with a large `--max-num-"
+"batched-tokens` in eager mode; Decode groups serve token generation with a "
+"small `--max-num-batched-tokens`, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` aclgraph, and the "
+"recompute scheduler. A Pull proxy forwards each request to Prefill first and"
+" then to Decode, and Decode pulls the KV cache from Prefill through "
+"Mooncake."
 msgstr ""
-"在 Chat Completions 请求体的顶层设置 `reasoning_effort` 以调整\n"
-"模型的推理深度。上述示例使用 `xhigh`；省略该字段则\n"
-"使用默认值 `xhigh`。模型官方支持以下级别："
+"PD 分离将 Prefill 和 Decode 拆分到不同的服务组中。Prefill 组以 eager 模式和较大的 `--max-num-"
+"batched-tokens` 处理大块 prompt；Decode 组以较小的 `--max-num-batched-"
+"tokens`、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` aclgraph 以及 recompute 调度器完成 token 生成。Pull "
+"代理先将每个请求转发给 Prefill，再转发给 Decode，Decode 通过 Mooncake 从 Prefill 拉取 KV cache。"

 msgid ""
-"2. After execution, you can get the result. Here are the results of "
-"`Qwen3.8-27B`, `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8` and `Qwen3.8-27B-w8a8-mxfp8` in `vllm-"

+msgid "**Key Parameter Descriptions:**"
+msgstr "**关键参数说明：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"The P:D group ratio and the parameter values in the two scripts should be "
+"adapted to the workload:"
+msgstr "P:D 组比例以及两个脚本中的参数取值应根据业务负载进行调整："
+
+msgid ""
+"- The P:D group ratio follows the workload. Workloads dominated by long, uncached inputs (e.g., long-context summarization over unique documents) need more Prefill groups; workloads with a high prefix-cache hit rate spend most wall time in decode and shift capacity toward Decode (e.g., 1P2D).\n"
+"- On Prefill, `--max-num-batched-tokens` should be no smaller than the effective uncached input length (within the HBM activation budget), so a prompt is prefilled in a single chunk instead of being split into multiple rounds. The example uses `66000` for a 64K-token 0%-cache-hit input budget; scale it down when prefix caching absorbs most of the input, because a cold request of the full length can transiently exceed the activation budget and cause OOM.\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs` on Prefill bounds concurrent prefill batches per group. Keep it small for long-input workloads so each chunk gets the full HBM activation budget; larger values are reasonable for short inputs.\n"
+"- Qwen3.8-27B is a hybrid-attention model: only 16 of 64 layers use full attention, and the other 48 Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state. To enable prefix caching in PD mode, replace `--no-enable-prefix-caching` with `--enable-prefix-caching` on P and D, and keep the choice identical on both roles; the recurrent-state cache is aligned with the KV blocks automatically, no extra flag is needed.\n"
+"- The FLA AscendC prefill kernel for the linear-attention layers is enabled automatically on hardware profiles that support it, so no extra configuration is needed for prefill throughput.\n"
+"- `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` is set only on Decode. Do not export it (directly or through a shared terminal) when launching Prefill; long-input prefill slows down with AIV.\n"
+"- Keep `--served-model-name`, the checkpoint, and the MTP `method`/`num_speculative_tokens` identical on P and D; change them only together.\n"
+"- On Decode, the `cudagraph_capture_sizes` are coupled to MTP: with `num_speculative_tokens = N`, each capture size must be a multiple of `N + 1` (the example uses `4`-multiples for `num_speculative_tokens = 3`). If you change `num_speculative_tokens` or disable MTP, regenerate the list accordingly (e.g., `N = 4` → `5, 10, 15, ...`); otherwise the actual decode batch size cannot hit a captured graph, aclgraph silently falls back to eager, and TPOT degrades.\n"
+"- `engine_id` must be unique across all services in the same PD cluster. Each service must also use its own HTTP port and Mooncake KV port.\n"
+"- If multiple PD deployments run on the same host, stagger their HTTP and Mooncake KV ports."
+msgstr ""
+"- P:D 组比例取决于业务负载。以长且未命中缓存的输入为主的负载（例如对唯一文档进行长上下文摘要）需要更多 Prefill 组；前缀缓存命中率高的负载大部分实际耗时在 decode 阶段，应将容量向 Decode 倾斜（例如 1P2D）。\n"
+"- 在 Prefill 上，`--max-num-batched-tokens` 不应小于实际未命中缓存的输入长度（在 HBM 激活内存预算之内），以便一个 prompt 在一次分块中完成预填充，而不是被拆成多轮。示例针对 64K token、缓存命中率 0% 的输入预算使用 `66000`；当前缀缓存吸收了大部分输入时应调小该值，因为一个全长的冷请求可能瞬时超出激活内存预算并导致 OOM。\n"
+"- Prefill 上的 `--max-num-seqs` 限制每个组的并发预填充批次。对于长输入负载应保持较小，以便每个分块都能获得完整的 HBM 激活内存预算；短输入则可以取较大值。\n"
+"- Qwen3.8-27B 是混合注意力模型：64 层中只有 16 层使用全注意力，其余 48 层 Gated DeltaNet 层携带循环状态。要在 PD 模式下启用前缀缓存，请在 P 和 D 上都将 `--no-enable-prefix-caching` 替换为 `--enable-prefix-caching`，并在两个角色上保持一致；循环状态缓存会自动与 KV 块对齐，无需额外标志。\n"
+"- 线性注意力层所用的 FLA AscendC 预填充 kernel 会在支持的硬件配置上自动启用，因此预填充吞吐无需额外配置。\n"
+"- `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` 仅在 Decode 上设置。启动 Prefill 时不要导出它（无论是直接导出还是通过共享终端导出）；长输入预填充在 AIV 下会变慢。\n"
+"- P 和 D 上的 `--served-model-name`、checkpoint 以及 MTP 的 `method`/`num_speculative_tokens` 必须保持一致；只能同时修改它们。\n"
+"- 在 Decode 上，`cudagraph_capture_sizes` 与 MTP 耦合：当 `num_speculative_tokens = N` 时，每个 capture size 必须是 `N + 1` 的倍数（示例中 `num_speculative_tokens = 3` 时使用 `4` 的倍数）。如果修改 `num_speculative_tokens` 或禁用 MTP，请相应地重新生成该列表（例如 `N = 4` → `5, 10, 15, ...`）；否则实际 decode 批大小无法命中已捕获的图，aclgraph 会静默回退到 eager 模式，导致 TPOT 变差。\n"
+"- `engine_id` 在同一 PD 集群的所有服务中必须唯一。每个服务还必须使用自己的 HTTP 端口和 Mooncake KV 端口。\n"
+"- 如果同一主机上运行多个 PD 部署，请错开它们的 HTTP 端口和 Mooncake KV 端口。"
+

+msgid "## Device probing in the engine core"
+msgstr "## 引擎核心中的设备探测"
+
+msgid ""
+"vLLM resolves the model architecture while it builds the engine configuration,\n"
+"before any worker binds an NPU. That import path probes every *visible* device,\n"
+"and the NPU runtime creates a context for each probed chip. A launch that reaches\n"
+"vLLM through its command line is normalized by vLLM Ascend: the visible set is\n"
+"narrowed to the chips named by `--device-ids` before the model is imported, so no\n"
+"other chip is initialized."
+msgstr ""
+"vLLM 在构建引擎配置的过程中解析模型架构，此时尚未有任何 worker 绑定 NPU。\n"
+"该导入路径会探测每一个*可见*设备，NPU 运行时为每个被探测的芯片创建一个上下文。\n"
+"通过命令行启动 vLLM 的方式会由 vLLM Ascend 进行归一化处理：在导入模型之前，\n"
+"可见设备集合会被收窄为 `--device-ids` 所指定的芯片，因此不会初始化其他芯片。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Python API has no equivalent hook. When you construct `LLM(...)` or\n"
+"`EngineArgs(...)` yourself, express the selection through the visible set instead\n"
+"of a wider set plus `device_ids`. Set the variable before importing `vllm` or\n"
+"`torch_npu`; `device_ids` can then be omitted, or set to the contiguous indices\n"
+"`0..N-1`:"
+msgstr ""
+"Python API 没有等价的钩子。当你自行构造 `LLM(...)` 或\n"
+"`EngineArgs(...)` 时，请通过可见设备集合来表达选择，而不是使用更大的集合再加上\n"
+"`device_ids`。请在导入 `vllm` 或 `torch_npu` 之前设置该变量；随后可以省略\n"
+"`device_ids`，或将其设置为连续的索引 `0..N-1`："

+
+msgid "# Unified Output Directory"
+msgstr "# 统一输出目录"
+
+msgid ""
+"vLLM Ascend and its supporting components generate logs, caches, and "
+"diagnostic files in different locations. Organizing these files under a "
+"common directory simplifies troubleshooting and operational maintenance by "
+"making them easier to locate, collect, and manage."
+msgstr ""
+"vLLM Ascend "
+"及其配套组件会在不同位置生成日志、缓存和诊断文件。将这些文件统一组织到同一个公共目录下，可以更轻松地定位、收集和管理它们，从而简化故障排查与运维工作。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This section explains how to configure these paths in an existing "
+"deployment, using `/root/ascend/log` as the common root directory inside the"
+" inference container. Before starting the service, create the required "
+"directories or parent directories for target files, and ensure that each "
+"process has write access to its output location."
+msgstr ""
+"本节介绍如何在现有部署中配置这些路径，并以推理容器内的 `/root/ascend/log` "
+"作为公共根目录。在启动服务之前，请创建所需的目录或目标文件的父目录，并确保每个进程对其输出位置具有写权限。"
+
+msgid "## Environment variables"
+msgstr "## 环境变量"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set these variables in the existing launcher before it starts the relevant "
+"process. For example, add `export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/root/ascend/log/cache` "
+"before `vllm serve`. For a deployment that already defines the service "
+"environment, set the same name and value there."
+msgstr ""
+"请在现有启动器中、启动相关进程之前设置这些变量。例如，在 `vllm serve` 之前添加 `export "
+"XDG_CACHE_HOME=/root/ascend/log/cache`。对于已定义服务环境的部署，请在该处设置相同的变量名和值。"
+
+msgid "| Component | Output | Environment variable | Example path |"
+msgstr "| 组件 | 输出 | 环境变量 | 示例路径 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| **vLLM** | Disk cache | `XDG_CACHE_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/cache` |"
+msgstr "| **vLLM** | 磁盘缓存 | `XDG_CACHE_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/cache` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| | Configuration root | `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/config` |"
+msgstr "| | 配置根目录 | `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/config` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| | FX graph dump directory override | `VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/debug/fx` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| | FX 图转储目录覆盖 | `VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH` | `/root/ascend/log/debug/fx` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| **Ascend / CANN** | [Working "
+"directory](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/CANNCommunityEdition/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0007.html),"
+" including logs | `ASCEND_WORK_PATH` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/work` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| **昇腾 / CANN** | "
+"[工作目录](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/CANNCommunityEdition/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0007.html)，包含日志"
+" | `ASCEND_WORK_PATH` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/work` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| | [Cache "
+"directory](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/CANNCommunityEdition/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0006.html)"
+" | `ASCEND_CACHE_PATH` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/cache` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| | "
+"[缓存目录](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/en/CANNCommunityEdition/910/maintenref/envvar/envref_07_0006.html)"
+" | `ASCEND_CACHE_PATH` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/cache` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| **PyTorch / torch_npu** | [Inductor compilation "
+"cache](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/recipes/torch_compile_caching_configuration_tutorial.html)"
+" | `TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/torchinductor` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| **PyTorch / torch_npu** | [Inductor "
+"编译缓存](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/recipes/torch_compile_caching_configuration_tutorial.html)"
+" | `TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR` | `/root/ascend/log/cann/torchinductor` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| **Triton Ascend** | [Base directory](https://github.com/triton-"
+"lang/triton-"
+"ascend/blob/main/docs/en/environment_variable_and_compiler_options_reference.md)"
+" | `TRITON_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/triton` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| **Triton Ascend** | [基础目录](https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-"
+"ascend/blob/main/docs/en/environment_variable_and_compiler_options_reference.md)"
+" | `TRITON_HOME` | `/root/ascend/log/triton` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| | Compilation cache override | `TRITON_CACHE_DIR` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/cache/triton` |"
+msgstr "| | 编译缓存覆盖 | `TRITON_CACHE_DIR` | `/root/ascend/log/cache/triton` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"With the XDG settings above, vLLM uses `/root/ascend/log/cache/vllm` and "
+"`/root/ascend/log/config/vllm`. If your deployment already sets "
+"`VLLM_CACHE_ROOT` or `VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT`, update those values to the "
+"corresponding paths. Explicit feature cache paths such as "
+"`VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE` also need to point under the common root if you use "
+"them. See [vLLM environment "
+"variables](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/env_vars/)."
+msgstr ""
+"使用上述 XDG 设置后，vLLM 将使用 `/root/ascend/log/cache/vllm` 和 "
+"`/root/ascend/log/config/vllm`。如果你的部署已设置 `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT` 或 "
+"`VLLM_CONFIG_ROOT`，请将这些值更新为对应的路径。如果你使用了 `VLLM_ASSETS_CACHE` "
+"这类显式的特性缓存路径，也需要将其指向公共根目录之下。请参阅 [vLLM "
+"环境变量](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/env_vars/)。"
+
+msgid "## vLLM configuration"
+msgstr "## vLLM 配置"
+
+msgid ""
+"Add the fields below to the JSON objects passed to the listed flags in your "
+"existing `vllm serve` command. Merge fields that share a flag into one "
+"object and keep the other fields already in that object. If you use a YAML "
+"file with `--config`, omit the leading `--` from the flag name and put the "
+"fields under that YAML key. For example, put `ascend_log_path` and "
+"`runtime_config_path` under `additional-config`."
+msgstr ""
+"请将下列字段添加到现有 `vllm serve` 命令中传给所列参数的 JSON "
+"对象中。将共用同一参数的字段合并到一个对象中，同时保留该对象中已有的其他字段。如果你通过 `--config` 使用 YAML 文件，请去掉参数名开头的"
+" `--`，并将字段放在对应的 YAML 键下。例如，将 `ascend_log_path` 和 `runtime_config_path` 放在 "
+"`additional-config` 下。"
+
+msgid "| Output | vLLM flag | Field | Set it to |"
+msgstr "| 输出 | vLLM 参数 | 字段 | 设置为 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Service log files | `--additional-config` | `ascend_log_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/vllm_ascend` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 服务日志文件 | `--additional-config` | `ascend_log_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/vllm_ascend` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Watchdog stack dumps | `--watchdog-config` | `dump_dir` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/watchdog` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Watchdog 堆栈转储 | `--watchdog-config` | `dump_dir` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/watchdog` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Runtime Guard configuration file | `--additional-config` | "
+"`runtime_config_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/runtime/config/runtime_config.json` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| Runtime Guard 配置文件 | `--additional-config` | `runtime_config_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/runtime/config/runtime_config.json` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| [Runtime Guard incident reports](../feature_guide/runtime_guard.md) | "
+"`--additional-config` | `runtime_report_dir` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/runtime/report` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| [Runtime Guard 事件报告](../feature_guide/runtime_guard.md) | `--additional-"
+"config` | `runtime_report_dir` | `/root/ascend/log/runtime/report` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| [Runtime Guard KV cache dumps](../feature_guide/runtime_guard.md) | "
+"`--additional-config` | `runtime_dump_dir` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/runtime/kv_cache` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| [Runtime Guard KV 缓存转储](../feature_guide/runtime_guard.md) | "
+"`--additional-config` | `runtime_dump_dir` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/runtime/kv_cache` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| [msprobe capture configuration "
+"file](../../developer_guide/performance_and_debug/msprobe_guide.md) | "
+"`--additional-config` | `dump_config_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/msprobe/config.json` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| [msprobe "
+"采集配置文件](../../developer_guide/performance_and_debug/msprobe_guide.md) | "
+"`--additional-config` | `dump_config_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/msprobe/config.json` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| FX graph dumps | `--compilation-config` | `debug_dump_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/debug/fx` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| FX 图转储 | `--compilation-config` | `debug_dump_path` | "
+"`/root/ascend/log/debug/fx` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| [Ascend PyTorch profiler "
+"traces](../../developer_guide/performance_and_debug/service_profiling_guide.md#ascend-"
+"pytorch-profiler) | `--profiler-config` | `profiler`, `torch_profiler_dir` |"
+" `\"torch\"`, `\"/root/ascend/log/profiler/torch\"`, respectively |"
+msgstr ""
+"| [昇腾 PyTorch profiler "
+"跟踪数据](../../developer_guide/performance_and_debug/service_profiling_guide.md#ascend-"
+"pytorch-profiler) | `--profiler-config` | `profiler`、`torch_profiler_dir` | "
+"分别为 `\"torch\"`、`\"/root/ascend/log/profiler/torch\"` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"- **Watchdog** works on builds that list `--watchdog-config` in `vllm serve --help=all`. Setting `dump_dir` enables stack dumps on timeout. See the [vLLM CLI reference](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/serve/#watchdog-config).\n"
+"- **msprobe** writes capture results to `dump_path` in the msprobe JSON file. Set that field to `/root/ascend/log/msprobe/dump`.\n"
+"- **FX graph dumps** follow `VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH` if that environment variable is set.\n"
+"- **Runtime Guard** derives its report and KV dump directories from the configuration file location. With the base settings above, reports go under `/root/ascend/log/runtime/report` and KV dumps under its `kv_cache` subdirectory when capture is enabled. Omit both directory overrides unless you need a different layout."
+msgstr ""
+"- **Watchdog** 仅在 `vllm serve --help=all` 中列出了 `--watchdog-config` 的版本上可用。设置 `dump_dir` 可在超时时生成堆栈转储。请参阅 [vLLM CLI 参考](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/cli/serve/#watchdog-config)。\n"
+"- **msprobe** 将采集结果写入 msprobe JSON 文件中的 `dump_path`。请将该字段设置为 `/root/ascend/log/msprobe/dump`。\n"
+"- 如果设置了 `VLLM_DEBUG_DUMP_PATH` 环境变量，**FX 图转储**将遵循该变量的路径。\n"
+"- **Runtime Guard** 会根据配置文件所在位置推导其报告目录和 KV 转储目录。在采用上述基础设置的情况下，报告写入 `/root/ascend/log/runtime/report`，启用采集时 KV 转储写入其下的 `kv_cache` 子目录。除非你需要不同的目录布局，否则请省略这两个目录覆盖项。"
+
+msgid ""
+"After starting with the recommended settings, look for `vllm_ascend_*.log` "
+"in the service log directory and for the Runtime Guard JSON file. Diagnostic"
+" files appear when the corresponding feature produces them, for example "
+"after a Watchdog timeout, a Runtime Guard report action, or the end of a "
+"profiling capture."
+msgstr ""
+"使用推荐设置启动后，请在服务日志目录中查找 `vllm_ascend_*.log`，以及 Runtime Guard 的 JSON "
+"文件。诊断文件会在相应功能产生它们时出现，例如 Watchdog 超时后、执行 Runtime Guard 报告操作后，或一次性能分析采集结束时。"
+
+msgid "## External component logs"
+msgstr "## 外部组件日志"
+
+msgid ""
+"This section covers logging for components used in disaggregated serving and"
+" KV pooling."
+msgstr "本节介绍分离式推理（disaggregated serving）和 KV 池化（KV pooling）中所使用组件的日志记录。"
+
+msgid "### MemCache and MemFabric logs"
+msgstr "### MemCache 和 MemFabric 日志"
+
+msgid "| Output | Default location |"
+msgstr "| 输出 | 默认位置 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MemCache MetaService | `/var/log/memcache_hybrid/logs/mmc-meta.log` "
+"(service) and `/var/log/memcache_hybrid/logs/mmc-meta-audit.log` (audit). "
+"[MemCache "
+"configuration](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memcache/blob/master/docs/zh/memcache_config.md)"
+" |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MemCache MetaService | `/var/log/memcache_hybrid/logs/mmc-meta.log`（服务日志）和"
+" `/var/log/memcache_hybrid/logs/mmc-meta-audit.log`（审计日志）。[MemCache "
+"配置](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memcache/blob/master/docs/zh/memcache_config.md)"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MemFabric runtime messages | Standard output of the process using "
+"MemFabric. [MemFabric "
+"logger](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/src/util/csrc/mf_out_logger.h)"
+" |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MemFabric 运行时消息 | 使用 MemFabric 的进程的标准输出。[MemFabric "
+"日志模块](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/src/util/csrc/mf_out_logger.h)"
+" |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MemFabric ptracer (when enabled) | "
+"`/var/log/memfabric_hybrid/ptracer_<pid>.dat`. [Ptracer "
+"guide](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/docs/zh/wiki/developer_guide/debugging/ptracer.md)"
+" |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MemFabric ptracer（启用时） | "
+"`/var/log/memfabric_hybrid/ptracer_<pid>.dat`。[Ptracer "
+"指南](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/memfabric_hybrid/blob/master/docs/zh/wiki/developer_guide/debugging/ptracer.md)"
+" |"
+
+msgid "### Mooncake logs"
+msgstr "### Mooncake 日志"
+
+msgid "| Process | Where to set the log directory |"
+msgstr "| 进程 | 日志目录的设置位置 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Transfer Engine for P/D disaggregation or KV pooling | Before `vllm "
+"serve`, export `MC_LOG_DIR=/root/ascend/log/mooncake/transfer` in each "
+"worker launcher (both P and D for disaggregation). The directory must "
+"already exist and be writable by the worker, or the engine logs to stderr. "
+"[Transfer Engine source](https://github.com/kvcache-"
+"ai/Mooncake/blob/main/mooncake-transfer-engine/src/config.cpp) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 用于 P/D 分离或 KV 池化的 Transfer Engine | 在执行 `vllm serve` 之前，在每个 worker 启动脚本中导出"
+" `MC_LOG_DIR=/root/ascend/log/mooncake/transfer`（P/D 分离场景下 P 和 D "
+"均需设置）。该目录必须已存在且 worker 可写，否则引擎会将日志输出到 stderr。[Transfer Engine "
+"源码](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/Mooncake/blob/main/mooncake-transfer-"
+"engine/src/config.cpp) |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| Mooncake Store master for KV pooling | Create "
+"`/root/ascend/log/mooncake/master` in the master container and add "
+"`--log_dir=/root/ascend/log/mooncake/master` to the existing "
+"`mooncake_master` command. [Store master "
+"logging](https://github.com/kvcache-"
+"ai/Mooncake/blob/main/docs/source/deployment/mooncake-store-deployment-"
+"guide.md#logging) |"
+msgstr ""
+"| 用于 KV 池化的 Mooncake Store master | 在 master 容器中创建 "
+"`/root/ascend/log/mooncake/master`，并在现有的 `mooncake_master` 命令中添加 "
+"`--log_dir=/root/ascend/log/mooncake/master`。[Store master "
+"日志](https://github.com/kvcache-"
+"ai/Mooncake/blob/main/docs/source/deployment/mooncake-store-deployment-"
+"guide.md#logging) |"
+
+msgid "## Minimal example"
+msgstr "## 最小示例"
+
+msgid ""
+"Replace `/path/to/model` with your model directory. When updating an "
+"existing launcher, merge the two fields below into its `--additional-config`"
+" object. Include the Watchdog argument if your build supports it and you "
+"want timeout stack dumps."

+"对象中。如果你的构建支持 Watchdog 参数，且你希望在超时时获取堆栈转储，可以加入该参数。"

+msgid ""

+"consecutive pipeline stages. Each stage is executed by one Tensor Parallelism (TP)\n"
+"group, or by one worker when the TP size is `1`, and sends intermediate\n"
+"activations to the next stage. For example, `--pipeline-parallel-size 2`\n"
+"divides the hidden layers between two pipeline stages."
+msgstr ""

-msgid ""
-"- RFork requires `YuanRong TransferEngine` at runtime. If the package is missing, RFork cannot initialize the transfer backend.\n"
-"- A worker that is advertised as an RFork seed binds a seed HTTP listening port. With the default\n"
-"  `rfork_seed_port_base=0`, the OS assigns the port. A nonzero base reserves adjacent main and draft slots for each\n"
-"  worker; an occupied slot or a resolved port above `65535` falls back to OS assignment. Keep seed HTTP ports\n"
-"  separate from the vLLM serving port, TransferEngine RPC port, and HIXL endpoint range. RFork is supported on\n"
-"  Linux, and this port-conflict fallback follows Linux `EADDRINUSE` semantics.\n"
-"- RFork transfer is bypassed entirely — the model loads through the default loader and no seed is advertised — under any of the configurations below. RFork registers live NPU weight memory and serves it to other instances, so it cannot be used when that memory may later be released or rewritten. The bypass is decided before any session or TransferEngine setup and is logged as `RFork transfer is disabled when <reason> is enabled; using the default model loader.`\n"
-"    - **Sleep mode** (`enable_sleep_mode` on either the model config or `vllm_config.model_config`), because sleeping discards and reallocates weight storage.\n"
-"    - **Online weight transfer** (`weight_transfer_config` is set), because weights can be replaced after loading.\n"
-"    - **EPLB** (`--enable-eplb`), because asynchronous expert rearrangement rewrites expert weights and placement maps in place after the seed service starts.\n"
-"- The static, recording, and legacy dynamic EPLB modes configured through `additional_config.eplb_config` (`expert_map_path`, `expert_map_record_path`, `dynamic_eplb`) belonged to Model Runner V1 and have been removed. They no longer take effect, so they neither enable EPLB nor bypass RFork.\n"
-"- Falling back to the default loader requires releasing the RFork seed service and registered memory first. RFork makes at most two cleanup attempts (`FALLBACK_CLEANUP_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, currently 2), with a short backoff before the second attempt, and only then reclaims memory and reruns the default loader. A pending legacy `/put_seed` for an unpublished receiver does not block native finalization, but if required local cleanup still fails, tensor owners remain pinned and RFork raises rather than allocating a second copy of the model; a session that already reached the finalized state raises as well. Both cases abort startup instead of degrading to a slow load.\n"
-"- The example [`rfork_planner.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rfork/rfork_planner.py) is only a simple mock implementation. If you need stronger scheduling, capacity management, or production-grade availability behavior, implement your own planner based on the RFork seed protocol. Its unauthenticated `GET /debug/snapshot` endpoint lists every registered `seed_key` and every active lease `USER_ID`; those IDs authorize lease renewal and release, so anything that can reach the mock planner can learn cluster keys and disrupt active allocations. Keep it reachable only inside the trusted network segment (see the [FAQ](#faq)).\n"
-"- The planner protocol headers `SEED_REFCNT` and `SEED_RANK` carry no scheduling meaning, but they are not optional on the wire today:\n"
-"    - `SEED_REFCNT` is always sent as `0` on advertisement and is ignored for capacity decisions (seed capacity is controlled by planner configuration). A planner must still accept the header.\n"
-"    - `SEED_RANK` remains a **required** field. RFork rejects a `/get_seed` response that omits it or carries a negative value, and sends it on every seed advertisement, lease renewal, lease release, and seed removal request. A planner must echo it back on `/get_seed` and accept it on the other routes. What is deprecated is using it for compatibility decisions: it duplicates the `tp_rank` already encoded in the seed key, so a planner must match on the seed key alone and treat `SEED_RANK` as an opaque part of the seed's identity tuple.\n"
-"- Each heartbeat checks that the seed service thread is still running; it does not send a keyed HTTP health probe on every\n"
-"  interval. A keyed `/health_check_with_key` request is issued only while the service starts, so a thread that stays alive\n"
-"  while its HTTP listener is unresponsive can still keep heartbeating. Monitor the advertised seed port at the network\n"
-"  level if that distinction matters. If the thread exits, RFork stops sending heartbeats and\n"
-"  attempts to withdraw the advertisement when the planner supports removal. A heartbeat failure alone does not stop\n"
-"  the metadata service; shutdown or fallback cleanup handles that teardown. If removal is unsupported or unknown, RFork\n"
-"  retains the published seed's registered memory and storage owner until a later withdrawal is confirmed and native\n"
-"  cleanup succeeds, or the process exits, while keeping the loaded model available for inference.\n"
-"- Temporary planner outages do not stop inference. Retryable initial advertisements and lease releases continue in the\n"
-"  background. Supported removal retries are bounded or happen during later cleanup; other removal failures keep the HTTP\n"
-"  service and registered memory available for retry. Permanent planner rejections prevent seed promotion. Outage logs are\n"
-"  limited to the first failure, periodic summaries, and recovery events.\n"
-"- Validate transfer accuracy and the logical-payload contract for newly supported NPU formats on the intended NPU and\n"
-"  model combination; CPU tests cannot establish NPU storage correctness. This qualification is required when adding a\n"
-"  format, but it is not a runtime requirement to copy allocator or descriptor padding outside a tensor's declared payload."
-msgstr ""
-"- RFork 运行时需要 `YuanRong TransferEngine`。如果缺少该软件包，RFork 无法初始化传输后端。\n"
-"- 被发布为 RFork seed 的 worker 会绑定一个 seed HTTP 监听端口。默认 `rfork_seed_port_base=0` 时由操作系统分配端口。设置非零基端口时，每个 worker 会为主模型和 draft 模型预留相邻槽位；如果端口已被占用，或计算出的端口超过 `65535`，则回退到操作系统分配的端口。seed HTTP 端口应与 vLLM 服务端口、TransferEngine RPC 端口和 HIXL 端点范围分开。RFork 仅在 Linux 上受支持，端口冲突回退遵循 Linux `EADDRINUSE` 语义。\n"
-"- 在以下任一配置下，RFork 传输都会被完全旁路：模型通过默认加载器加载，也不会发布 seed。RFork 会注册正在使用的 NPU 权重内存并为其他实例提供服务，因此当这部分内存之后可能被释放或改写时，不能使用 RFork。旁路判断发生在创建 session 或 TransferEngine 之前，日志为 `RFork transfer is disabled when <reason> is enabled; using the default model loader.`\n"
-"    - **睡眠模式**（模型配置或 `vllm_config.model_config` 中的 `enable_sleep_mode`），因为睡眠会丢弃并重新分配权重存储。\n"
-"    - **在线权重传输**（设置了 `weight_transfer_config`），因为权重可能在加载后被替换。\n"
-"    - **EPLB**（`--enable-eplb`），因为异步专家重排会在 seed 服务启动后原地改写专家权重和放置映射。\n"
-"- 通过 `additional_config.eplb_config` 配置的静态、录制和旧版动态 EPLB 模式（`expert_map_path`、`expert_map_record_path`、`dynamic_eplb`）属于 Model Runner V1，已被移除。这些字段不再生效，既不会启用 EPLB，也不会触发 RFork 旁路。\n"
-"- 回退到默认加载器前，必须先释放 RFork seed 服务和已注册的内存。RFork 最多执行两次清理尝试（`FALLBACK_CLEANUP_MAX_ATTEMPTS`，当前为 2），两次尝试之间会短暂退避，然后才回收内存并重新运行默认加载器。对于尚未发布 seed 的接收端，待处理的旧版 `/put_seed` 不会阻止原生 finalize；但如果必要的本地清理仍然失败，张量所有者仍被保留，RFork 会抛出异常，拒绝在旧权重仍被固定时分配第二份模型；已经进入 finalized 状态的 session 也会抛出异常。这两种情况都会中止启动，而不会降级为较慢的加载。\n"
-"- [`rfork_planner.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rfork/rfork_planner.py) 只是一个简单的模拟实现。如果需要更强的调度、容量管理或生产级可用性行为，请根据 RFork seed 协议实现自己的规划器。其无鉴权的 `GET /debug/snapshot` 端点会列出所有已注册的 `seed_key` 和所有活动租约的 `USER_ID`；这些 ID 可用于续租和释放租约，因此任何能访问该 mock planner 的对象都能获取集群 key 并干扰活动分配。请确保它仅在可信网络段内可达（详见 FAQ）。\n"
-"- 规划器协议头 `SEED_REFCNT` 和 `SEED_RANK` 不承载调度语义，但目前在协议线上都不是可选字段：\n"
-"    - 发布 seed 时 `SEED_REFCNT` 始终发送为 `0`，不会用于容量决策（seed 容量由规划器配置控制）。规划器仍必须接受此请求头。\n"
-"    - `SEED_RANK` 仍是**必需**字段。如果 `/get_seed` 响应缺少该字段或其值为负数，RFork 会拒绝该响应；在发布 seed、续租、释放租约和删除 seed 的请求中都会发送该字段。规划器必须在 `/get_seed` 响应中原样返回，并在其他路由中接受它。已弃用的是将其用于兼容性决策：它重复了 seed key 中已经编码的 `tp_rank`，因此规划器应仅按 seed key 匹配，并将 `SEED_RANK` 视为 seed 身份元组中的不透明字段。\n"
-"- 每次心跳只检查 seed 服务线程是否仍在运行，不会在每个间隔发送带 key 的 HTTP 健康探测。带 key 的 `/health_check_with_key` 请求仅在服务启动期间发送，因此线程仍存活但 HTTP 监听无响应时，心跳仍可能成功。若需要区分这两种情况，请在网络层面监控已发布的 seed 端口。如果线程退出，RFork 会停止发送心跳，并在规划器支持删除时尝试撤销该 seed 广告。单次心跳故障本身不会停止元数据服务；该服务由关闭或回退清理流程处理。如果删除不受支持或状态未知，RFork 会保留已发布 seed 的已注册内存和存储所有者，直到之后确认撤销且原生清理成功，或进程退出，同时保持已加载模型可继续推理。\n"
-"- 临时的规划器故障不会停止推理。可重试的初始发布和租约释放会在后台继续。受支持的删除只会在有界重试或后续清理中重试；其他删除失败会保留 HTTP 服务和已注册内存，以便重试。永久性的规划器拒绝则会阻止 seed 晋升。故障日志仅记录首次失败、周期性摘要和恢复事件。\n"
-"- 对于新支持的 NPU 格式，应在目标 NPU 和模型组合上验证传输准确性及逻辑负载契约；CPU 测试无法证明 NPU 存储的正确性。新增格式时必须进行这项验证，但这不表示运行时需要复制张量声明负载之外的分配器或描述符填充。"

+"    - **Sleep mode** (`enable_sleep_mode` on either the model config or `vllm_config.model_config`), because sleeping discards and reallocates weight storage.\n"
+"    - **Online weight transfer** (`weight_transfer_config` is set), because weights can be replaced after loading.\n"
+"    - **EPLB** (`--enable-eplb`), because asynchronous expert rearrangement rewrites expert weights and placement maps in place after the seed service starts.\n"
+"- The static, recording, and legacy dynamic EPLB modes configured through `additional_config.eplb_config` (`expert_map_path`, `expert_map_record_path`, `dynamic_eplb`) belonged to Model Runner V1 and have been removed. They no longer take effect, so they neither enable EPLB nor bypass RFork.\n"
+"- Falling back to the default loader requires releasing the RFork seed service and registered memory first. RFork makes at most two cleanup attempts (`FALLBACK_CLEANUP_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, currently 2), with a short backoff before the second attempt, and only then reclaims memory and reruns the default loader. A pending legacy `/put_seed` for an unpublished receiver does not block native finalization, but if required local cleanup still fails, tensor owners remain pinned and RFork raises rather than allocating a second copy of the model; a session that already reached the finalized state raises as well. Both cases abort startup instead of degrading to a slow load.\n"
+"- The example [`rfork_planner.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rfork/rfork_planner.py) is only a simple mock implementation. If you need stronger scheduling, capacity management, or production-grade availability behavior, implement your own planner based on the RFork seed protocol. Its unauthenticated `GET /debug/snapshot` endpoint lists every registered `seed_key` and every active lease `USER_ID`; those IDs authorize lease renewal and release, so anything that can reach the mock planner can learn cluster keys and disrupt active allocations. Keep it reachable only inside the trusted network segment (see the [FAQ](#faq)).\n"
+"- The planner protocol headers `SEED_REFCNT` and `SEED_RANK` carry no scheduling meaning, but they are not optional on the wire today:\n"
+"    - `SEED_REFCNT` is always sent as `0` on advertisement and is ignored for capacity decisions (seed capacity is controlled by planner configuration). A planner must still accept the header.\n"
+"    - `SEED_RANK` remains a **required** field. RFork rejects a `/get_seed` response that omits it or carries a negative value, and sends it on every seed advertisement, lease renewal, lease release, and seed removal request. A planner must echo it back on `/get_seed` and accept it on the other routes. What is deprecated is using it for compatibility decisions: it duplicates the `tp_rank` already encoded in the seed key, so a planner must match on the seed key alone and treat `SEED_RANK` as an opaque part of the seed's identity tuple.\n"
+"- Each heartbeat checks that the seed service thread is still running; it does not send a keyed HTTP health probe on every\n"
+"  interval. A keyed `/health_check_with_key` request is issued only while the service starts, so a thread that stays alive\n"
+"  while its HTTP listener is unresponsive can still keep heartbeating. Monitor the advertised seed port at the network\n"
+"  level if that distinction matters. If the thread exits, RFork stops sending heartbeats and\n"
+"  attempts to withdraw the advertisement when the planner supports removal. A heartbeat failure alone does not stop\n"
+"  the seed HTTP service; shutdown or fallback cleanup handles that teardown. If removal is unsupported or unknown, RFork\n"
+"  retains the published seed's registered memory and storage owner until a later withdrawal is confirmed and native\n"
+"  cleanup succeeds, or the process exits, while keeping the loaded model available for inference.\n"
+"- Temporary planner outages do not stop inference. Retryable initial advertisements and lease releases continue in the\n"
+"  background. Supported removal retries are bounded or happen during later cleanup; other removal failures keep the HTTP\n"
+"  service and registered memory available for retry. Permanent planner rejections prevent seed promotion. Outage logs are\n"
+"  limited to the first failure, periodic summaries, and recovery events.\n"
+"- Validate transfer accuracy and the logical-payload contract for newly supported NPU formats on the intended NPU and\n"
+"  model combination; CPU tests cannot establish NPU storage correctness. This qualification is required when adding a\n"
+"  format, but it is not a runtime requirement to copy allocator or descriptor padding outside a tensor's declared payload."
+msgstr ""

-msgid ""
-"- Qwen3 and Qwen3MOE is supported now. Please follow the [official doc](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.8.4rc2/docs/source/tutorials/single_npu.md) to run the quick demo. [#709](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/709)\n"
-"- Ascend W8A8 quantization method is supported now. Please take the [official doc](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.8.4rc2/docs/source/tutorials/multi_npu_quantization.md) for example. Any [feedback](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/619) is welcome. [#580](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/580)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V3/R1 works with DP, TP and MTP now. Please note that it's still in experimental status. Let us know if you hit any problem. [#429](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/429) [#585](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/585)  [#626](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/626) [#636](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/636) [#671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/671)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 现已支持 Qwen3 和 Qwen3MOE。请参考[官方文档](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.8.4rc2/docs/source/tutorials/single_npu.md)运行快速演示。[#709](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/709)\n"
-"- 现已支持 Ascend W8A8 量化方法。请参考[官方文档](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.8.4rc2/docs/source/tutorials/multi_npu_quantization.md)示例。欢迎提供任何[反馈](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/619)。[#580](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/580)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V3/R1 现已支持 DP、TP 和 MTP。请注意，此功能仍处于实验阶段。如果遇到任何问题，请告知我们。[#429](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/429) [#585](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/585)  [#626](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/626) [#636](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/636) [#671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/671)"

 msgid "## v0.8.4rc1 - 2025.04.18"
 msgstr "## v0.8.4rc1 - 2025.04.18"
 
-msgid ""
-"- vLLM V1 engine experimental support is included in this version. You can visit [official guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.8.4/getting_started/v1_user_guide.html) to get more detail. By default, vLLM will fallback to V0 if V1 doesn't work, please set `VLLM_USE_V1=1` environment if you want to use V1 forcibly.\n"
-"- LoRA、Multi-LoRA And Dynamic Serving is supported now. The performance will be improved in the next release. Please follow the [official doc](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.8.4/features/lora.html) for more usage information. Thanks for the contribution from China Merchants Bank. [#521](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/521).\n"
-"- Sleep Mode feature is supported. Currently it only works on V0 engine. V1 engine support will come soon. [#513](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/513)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 本版本包含对 vLLM V1 引擎的实验性支持。您可以访问[官方指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.8.4/getting_started/v1_user_guide.html)获取更多详情。默认情况下，如果 V1 无法工作，vLLM 将回退到 V0，如果您想强制使用 V1，请设置 `VLLM_USE_V1=1` 环境变量。\n"
-"- 现已支持 LoRA、Multi-LoRA 和动态服务。性能将在下一个版本中提升。请参考[官方文档](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/v0.8.4/features/lora.html)了解更多使用信息。感谢招商银行的贡献。[#521](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/521)。\n"
-"- 支持休眠模式功能。目前该功能仅适用于 V0 引擎。V1 引擎的支持即将推出。[#513](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/513)"
-
 msgid ""
 "- The Ascend scheduler is added for V1 engine. This scheduler is more affinity with Ascend hardware. More scheduler policy will be added in the future. [#543](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/543)\n"
 "- Disaggregated Prefill feature is supported. Currently only 1P1D works. NPND is under design by vllm team. vllm-ascend will support it once it's ready from vLLM. -msgid ""
-"- This release relies on an unreleased torch_npu version. It has been installed within official container image already. Please [install](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.7.1rc1/docs/source/installation.md) it manually if you are using non-container environment.\n"
-"- There are logs like `No platform detected, vLLM is running on UnspecifiedPlatform` or `Failed to import from vllm._C with ModuleNotFoundError(\"No module named 'vllm._C'\")` shown when running vllm-ascend. It actually doesn't affect any functionality and performance. You can just ignore it. And it has been fixed in this [PR](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/12432) which will be included in v0.7.3 soon.\n"
-"- There are logs like `# CPU blocks: 35064, # CPU blocks: 2730` shown when running vllm-ascend which should be `# NPU blocks:` . It actually doesn't affect any functionality and performance. You can just ignore it. And it has been fixed in this [PR](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/13378) which will be included in v0.7.3 soon."
-msgstr ""
-"- 此版本依赖于一个未发布的torch_npu版本。官方容器镜像中已预装该版本。如果您使用非容器环境，请手动[安装](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/v0.7.1rc1/docs/source/installation.md)。\n"
-"- 运行vllm-ascend时，可能会出现类似`No platform detected, vLLM is running on UnspecifiedPlatform`或`Failed to import from vllm._C with ModuleNotFoundError(\"No module named 'vllm._C'\")`的日志。这实际上不影响任何功能和性能，您可以忽略。此问题已在此[PR](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/12432)中修复，该修复将很快包含在v0.7.3中。\n"
-"- 运行vllm-ascend时，可能会出现类似`# CPU blocks: 35064, # CPU blocks: 2730`的日志，而正确的应为`# NPU blocks:`。这实际上不影响任何功能和性能，您可以忽略。此问题已在此[PR](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/13378)中修复，该修复将很快包含在v0.7.3中。"

-msgid ""
-"- **Ascend 950 and DeepSeek V4**: Added end-to-end DeepSeek V4 support on Ascend 950, including DSA attention, MTP, piecewise graph execution, distributed inference, sparse attention, CPU binding, and MXFP quantization and communication paths. [#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935) [#10236](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10236) [#11014](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11014)\n"
-"- **Model and hardware coverage**: Expanded support and deployment guidance for GLM-5.2, GLM-4.7-Flash, Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6, Qwen3-ASR, Qwen3-Omni, Bailing MoE, Gemma4, Step3, and MiniMax 2.x models across A2, A3, Ascend 950, and Atlas 300I DUO. GLM-5.2 supports long-sequence inference up to 1M tokens on Atlas 800 A3. [#8657](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8657) [#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560) [#10441](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10441) [#10697](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10697) [#11091](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11091) [#11264](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11264) [#12115](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12115)\n"
-"- **Context parallelism and sparse attention**: Added SFA DCP with a replicated indexer, compact KV gather, C8 support, and device-side metadata paths for long-context and P/D-disaggregated deployments. [#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638) [#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809) [#11819](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11819) [#11871](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11871) [#11981](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11981)\n"
-"- **KV-cache lifecycle and offload**: Added hybrid/Mamba attention prefix caching; CPU and SSD offload in AscendStore that covers all backends. [#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743) [#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533) [#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731) [#10393](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10393)\n"
-"- **Graph and speculative execution**: Added `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` graph mode, which is enabled by default and requires no manual configuration; DFlash `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`; zero-bubble async scheduling; P-Eagle and PARD; and expanded MTP/Eagle3 support. [#7640](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7640) [#8118](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8118) [#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#10042](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10042) [#10566](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10566)"
-msgstr ""
-"- **Ascend 950与DeepSeek V4**：在Ascend 950上新增了端到端的DeepSeek V4支持，包括DSA注意力、MTP、分段图执行、分布式推理、稀疏注意力、CPU绑定以及MXFP量化和通信路径。[#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935) [#10236](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10236) [#11014](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11014)\n"
-"- **模型与硬件覆盖**：扩展了对GLM-5.2、GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6、Qwen3-ASR、Qwen3-Omni、百灵MoE、Gemma4、Step3和MiniMax 2.x等模型在A2、A3、Ascend 950和Atlas 300I DUO上的支持与部署指南。GLM-5.2在Atlas 800 A3上支持长达100万token的长序列推理。[#8657](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8657) [#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560) [#10441](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10441) [#10697](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10697) [#11091](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11091) [#11264](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11264) [#12115](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12115)\n"
-"- **上下文并行与稀疏注意力**：新增了带复制索引器的SFA DCP、紧凑KV收集、C8支持以及面向长上下文和P/D分离部署的设备端元数据路径。[#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638) [#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809) [#11819](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11819) [#11871](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11871) [#11981](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11981)\n"
-"- **KV缓存生命周期与卸载**：新增了混合/Mamba注意力前缀缓存；AscendStore中的CPU和SSD卸载覆盖所有后端。[#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743) [#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533) [#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731) [#10393](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10393)\n"
-"- **图执行与投机执行**：新增了`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`图模式，该模式默认启用且无需手动配置；DFlash `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`；零气泡异步调度；P-Eagle和PARD；以及扩展的MTP/Eagle3支持。[#7640](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7640) [#8118](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8118) [#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#10042](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10042) [#10566](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10566)"

-"- Fixed GLM-5.1 IndexCache weight loading and a GLM-4.7-Flash first-request `IndexError` with MTP and layerwise Memcache. [#11363](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11363) [#11829](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11829)\n"
-"- Fixed Qwen MoE routing overflow and shared-expert gate failures, Qwen3-Omni ModelSlim W8A8 checkpoint loading, and Qwen3-VL rotary-embedding copy races on Atlas 300I DUO. -"- Fixed the DeepSeek-R1-0528 W8A8 shared-expert no-clamp accuracy path and malformed streamed tool calls or TP8+EP startup for MiniMax-M2/M2.5. [#11775](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11775) [#11505](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11505)\n"
-"- Fixed DeepSeek V4 MXFP routing precision, W4A16MXFP communication accuracy, and eager draft compilation configuration isolation. [#11663](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11663) [#11718](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11718) [#12587](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12587)† [#12722](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12722)†\n"
-"- Fixed KV-transfer ordering and TP-shard consistency, Mooncake grouping, AscendStore hash/lease/lookup handling, and layerwise KV Pool failures. [#11887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11887) [#12252](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12252) [#12371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12371)† [#12797](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12797)† [#12819](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12819)†\n"
-"- Fixed DCP/DP service hangs, limited the recompute scheduler to decode nodes, and delayed AscendStore initialization until the first real decode request. [#12034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12034) [#11490](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11490) [#11673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11673)\n"
-"- Disabled unsupported shared-expert multistream overlap with fused MC2 and fixed low MTP acceptance for SFA with DSA-CP and multiple speculative tokens. [#12245](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12245) [#10878](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10878)\n"
-"- Fixed AscendStore compatibility with pipeline parallelism and surfaced backend failures. [#12762](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12762)†\n"
-"- Fixed invalid-GVA handling for layerwise KV Pool transfers. [#12643](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12643)†\n"
-"- Fixed A5 BF16 `mm_reduce_scatter` communication-mode selection and restricted FP8 quantization detection to A5 devices. [#12826](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12826)† [#12895](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12895)†\n"
-"- Packed SFA DSA-CP KV tensors into one all-gather to correct and streamline the communication path. [#12867](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12867)†\n"
-"- Disabled unsupported `npugraph_ex` compilation automatically on Atlas 300I DUO and fixed low-level rotary and sparse-attention tiling/metadata issues. [#12366](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12366)† [#12446](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12446)† [#12841](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12841)†\n"
-"- Fixed `npu_dequant_swiglu_quant` precision for small token shapes and propagated `return_lse` to QuantSFA operators. [#12913](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12913)† [#13197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13197)†\n"
-"- Removed unnecessary Memcache lazy initialization and hardened AscendStore transfers by restoring synchronous saves, reporting asynchronous load failures to the scheduler, and using grouped block sizes in transfer threads. [#13028](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13028)† [#13024](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13024)† [#13099](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13099)† [#13110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13110)†\n"
-"- Removed `-Werror` from custom-operator CMake builds so compiler warnings do not fail release builds. [#13095](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13095)†"

-"- 修复了P/D、PCP、MTP和DCP中GDN状态和图调度精度的回归问题，包括单token有状态预填充处理。[#11195](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11195) [#11893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11893) [#12027](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12027) [#12255](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12255)†\n"
-"- 修复了Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6投机解码精度、Mamba前缀缓存损坏、块表溢出以及Atlas 300I DUO图失败问题。[#11337](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11337) [#11408](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11408) [#11353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11353) [#11659](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11659) [#11920](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11920) [#12038](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12038)\n"
-"- 修复了GLM-5.1 IndexCache权重加载以及GLM-4.7-Flash在MTP和逐层Memcache下首次请求的`IndexError`问题。[#11363](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11363) [#11829](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11829)\n"
-"- 修复了Qwen MoE路由溢出和共享专家门控失败、Qwen3-Omni ModelSlim W8A8检查点加载以及Atlas 300I DUO上Qwen3-VL旋转嵌入复制竞争问题。[#11391](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11391) [#11730](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11730) [#12321](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12321) [#11679](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11679) [#12132](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12132)\n"
-"- 修复了DeepSeek-R1-0528 W8A8共享专家无钳位精度路径以及MiniMax-M2/M2.5的畸形流式工具调用或TP8+EP启动问题。[#11775](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11775) [#11505](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11505)\n"
-"- 修复了DeepSeek V4 MXFP路由精度、W4A16MXFP通信精度以及eager draft编译配置隔离问题。[#11663](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11663) [#11718](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11718) [#12587](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12587)† [#12722](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12722)†\n"
-"- 修复了KV传输顺序和TP分片一致性、Mooncake分组、AscendStore哈希/租约/查找处理以及逐层KV Pool失败问题。[#11887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11887) [#12252](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12252) [#12371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12371)† [#12797](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12797)† [#12819](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12819)†\n"
-"- 修复了DCP/DP服务挂起问题，将重计算调度器限制为仅解码节点，并将AscendStore初始化延迟到首次真实解码请求。[#12034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12034) [#11490](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11490) [#11673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11673)\n"

-"- 修复了AscendStore与流水线并行的兼容性并暴露了后端失败。[#12762](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12762)†\n"
-"- 修复了逐层KV Pool传输中无效GVA的处理。[#12643](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12643)†\n"
-"- 修复了A5 BF16 `mm_reduce_scatter`通信模式选择，并将FP8量化检测限制为仅A5设备。[#12826](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12826)† [#12895](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12895)†\n"
-"- 将SFA DSA-CP KV张量打包为一次all-gather，以纠正并简化通信路径。[#12867](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12867)†\n"
-"- 在Atlas 300I DUO上自动禁用不支持的`npugraph_ex`编译，并修复了底层旋转和稀疏注意力平铺/元数据问题。[#12366](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12366)† [#12446](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12446)† [#12841](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12841)†\n"
-"- 修复了小token形状下`npu_dequant_swiglu_quant`的精度问题，并将`return_lse`传播到QuantSFA算子。[#12913](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12913)† [#13197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13197)†\n"
-"- 移除了不必要的Memcache惰性初始化，并通过恢复同步保存、向调度器报告异步加载失败以及在传输线程中使用分组块大小来强化AscendStore传输。[#13028](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13028)† [#13024](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13024)† [#13099](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13099)† [#13110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13110)†\n"
-"- 从自定义算子CMake构建中移除了`-Werror`，使编译器警告不会导致发布构建失败。[#13095](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13095)†"

 "- KV池化可能导致某些长上下文工作负载出现轻微单前缀性能回退，包括DeepSeek-V4-Flash 128K-1K和Qwen3-32B A2 PD混合场景。调查仍在进行中。[#15649](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/15649) [#15295](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/15295) [#12234](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12234)\n"
 "- MiniMax-M2.7 W8A8在A3单节点场景下出现性能回退。128K输入/1K输出的双节点结果也低于基线阈值，但需要更多样本才能确定是持续回退还是正常性能波动。[#15658](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/15658)"
 
-msgid ""
-"- Pipeline parallelism (PP) combined with prefill context parallelism (PCP) is not supported in v0.23.0.\n"
-"- Reduce sampling (`additional_config.enable_reduce_sample=true`) is experimental. It is incompatible with P/D-disaggregated serving and lmhead tensor parallelism, where it is automatically disabled. Do not enable it when sampling logprobs are requested because the logprob values and top-k rankings would be computed over partitioned logits and can be incorrect. [#13469](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13469)† [#13632](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13632)†\n"
-"- GLM-5.2 1M-context deployments were validated only on Atlas 800 A3; the A2 series was not validated for 1M context.\n"
-"- For P/D-disaggregated serving of models using Sparse Flash Attention (SFA), including DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-5.1, and GLM-5.2, DCP must be enabled on both prefiller and decoder nodes or disabled on both. Asymmetric DCP configuration can cause accuracy issues. [#14322](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14322)†\n"
-"- On Ascend 950, context parallelism is not supported with SFA; context-parallel MLA and GQA paths are experimental. [#13303](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13303)†\n"
-"- In v0.23.0, combining GLM-5.2 DCP with Sparse Flash Attention C8 (`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`) has known issues, including performance degradation, and is not recommended. [#14011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14011)†\n"
-"- On Atlas 300I DUO or Atlas 200I Pro (310P), Qwen3.5-2B-W8A8 GSM8K accuracy can fluctuate by more than 1% compared with the floating-point model. [#14335](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14335)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V4 on A2 or A3 can experience 1-2 second TPOT spikes under high concurrency when varying input shapes trigger Triton kernel recompilation. [#14324](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14324)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.1 SWE benchmark results can vary because of intermittent evaluation failures, including container crashes, timeouts, dependency-download failures, and agent nondeterminism. [#14326](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14326)\n"
-"- DeepSeek-V3.1 large-EP deployments have a reported 3%-5% performance gap from the target performance. [#14327](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14327)\n"
-"- GLM-5.1 on an Ascend 950 single-node mixed P/D deployment can incur excessive P/D transfer overhead for a 64k-input/1k-output workload without a prefix-cache hit. [#14328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14328)\n"
-"- GLM-5.1 P/D-disaggregated serving with both `sfa_c8` and `li_c8` enabled has a reported performance regression for 64k-input/1k-output workloads. [#14329](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14329)\n"
-"- In graph mode, `torch.ops._C_ascend.mla_preprocess` and `torch.ops._C_ascend.batch_matmul_transpose` can emit an `rtMemcpy` 107030 error in plog; the reported error does not affect inference. [#14347](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14347)\n"
-"- GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 P/D-disaggregated serving with `enable_sparse_sfa_c8` can show GPQA accuracy fluctuations of approximately 2-3 percentage points across repeated runs. [#14378](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14378)\n"
-"- DeepSeek-V3.1 2P1D throughput has a reported regression of about 15% compared with v0.18.0 in high-throughput deployments. [#12349](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12349)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V4 Pro has an open long-running stability report involving increasing memory use. [#12345](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12345)\n"
-"- Qwen3-30B-A3B floating-point serving has a reported single-batch performance regression. [#12337](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12337)\n"
-"- AscendStore KV Pool has backend-specific constraints for layerwise Memcache, SSD offload, hybrid-attention load failures, and graph fallback behavior. [#12390](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12390)\n"
-"- Ascend 950 graph capture is temporarily limited to a reduced set of stages because of HDK incompatibility, which avoids crashes but can reduce performance. [#12998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12998)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 在 v0.23.0 中，不支持流水线并行（PP）与预填充上下文并行（PCP）的组合。\n"
-"- 减少采样（`additional_config.enable_reduce_sample=true`）为实验性功能。它与 P/D 分离部署和 lmhead 张量并行不兼容，在这些场景下会自动禁用。当请求采样 logprobs 时，请勿启用此功能，因为 logprob 值和 top-k 排名将在分区 logits 上计算，结果可能不正确。[#13469](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13469)† [#13632](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13632)†\n"
-"- GLM-5.2 1M 上下文部署仅在 Atlas 800 A3 上验证过；A2 系列未针对 1M 上下文进行验证。\n"
-"- 对于使用稀疏闪存注意力（SFA）的模型（包括 DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5.1 和 GLM-5.2）的 P/D 分离部署，必须在预填充节点和解码节点上同时启用 DCP 或同时禁用。不对称的 DCP 配置可能导致精度问题。[#14322](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14322)†\n"
-"- 在 Ascend 950 上，SFA 不支持上下文并行；上下文并行的 MLA 和 GQA 路径为实验性功能。[#13303](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13303)†\n"
-"- 在 v0.23.0 中，将 GLM-5.2 DCP 与稀疏闪存注意力 C8（`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`）结合使用存在已知问题，包括性能下降，因此不建议使用。[#14011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14011)†\n"
-"- 在 Atlas 300I DUO 或 Atlas 200I Pro (310P) 上，Qwen3.5-2B-W8A8 GSM8K 精度与浮点模型相比可能出现超过 1% 的波动。[#14335](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14335)\n"
-"- 在高并发场景下，当输入形状变化触发 Triton 内核重新编译时，A2 或 A3 上的 DeepSeek V4 可能出现 1-2 秒的 TPOT 尖峰。[#14324](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14324)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 GLM-5.1 SWE 基准测试结果可能因间歇性评估失败而有所差异，包括容器崩溃、超时、依赖下载失败和代理非确定性。[#14326](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14326)\n"
-"- DeepSeek-V3.1 大规模 EP 部署报告与目标性能存在 3%-5% 的差距。[#14327](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14327)\n"
-"- 在 Ascend 950 单节点混合 P/D 部署上，GLM-5.1 在 64k 输入/1k 输出且无前缀缓存命中的工作负载下可能产生过多的 P/D 传输开销。[#14328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14328)\n"
-"- 同时启用 `sfa_c8` 和 `li_c8` 的 GLM-5.1 P/D 分离部署在 64k 输入/1k 输出工作负载下报告存在性能回退。[#14329](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14329)\n"
-"- 在图模式下，`torch.ops._C_ascend.mla_preprocess` 和 `torch.ops._C_ascend.batch_matmul_transpose` 可能在 plog 中发出 `rtMemcpy` 107030 错误；该报告的错误不影响推理。[#14347](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14347)\n"
-"- 启用 `enable_sparse_sfa_c8` 的 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 P/D 分离部署在重复运行中可能显示 GPQA 精度波动约 2-3 个百分点。[#14378](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14378)\n"
-"- 在高吞吐部署中，DeepSeek-V3.1 2P1D 吞吐量与 v0.18.0 相比报告存在约 15% 的回退。[#12349](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12349)\n"
-"- DeepSeek V4 Pro 有一个关于内存使用持续增长的长期稳定性报告。[#12345](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12345)\n"
-"- Qwen3-30B-A3B 浮点部署报告存在单批次性能回退。[#12337](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12337)\n"
-"- AscendStore KV Pool 在逐层 Memcache、SSD 卸载、混合注意力加载失败和图回退行为方面存在特定后端的限制。[#12390](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12390)\n"
-"- 由于 HDK 不兼容，Ascend 950 图捕获暂时仅限于减少的阶段集，这可以避免崩溃但可能降低性能。[#12998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12998)"

-msgid ""
-"- Added end-to-end support for DeepSeek-V4 on Ascend 950, including piecewise graph mode, DSA attention backend, KV cache management, distributed inference (with PP fixes), and MTP. [#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9473](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9473) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935)\n"
-"- Added Hybrid & Mamba Align Prefix Cache for improved prefix cache reuse in Hybrid and Mamba architectures. [#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533)\n"
-"- Added layerwise KV cache event callbacks for finer per-layer observability and control. [#9468](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9468)\n"
-"- Added GLM4.7-Flash model support with Flash Attention backend. [#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560)\n"
-"- Added `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` graph mode, a hybrid compilation strategy mixing full-graph and piecewise approaches. **Requires HDK 25.5.1+ / CANN 8.5.0+** to remove the old stream-budget limitation, enabling significantly more graph captures — approximately 32k on A3 and 64k on Ascend 950. Legacy capture-size pruning has been cleaned up accordingly. [#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#9962](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9962)\n"
-"- Added W4A8 MXFP4 quantization support for Ascend 950. [#8265](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8265)\n"
-"- Added MXFP8 FlashCommV3 support on Ascend 950. [#9671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9671)\n"
-"- Added NZ layout support for W4A8 MoE compressed tensors and C8 quantization (GQA). [#9625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9625) [#9721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9721)\n"
-"- Added Mooncake Connector hybrid PCP/DCP support for QWen3.5. [#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809)\n"
-"- Added D2D NetLoader weight loading for draft models in speculative decoding. [#9893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9893)\n"
-"- Added Mooncake Connector hybrid attention support. [#8850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8850)\n"
-"- Added Mooncake KV pool usage optimization. [#7820](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7820)\n"
-"- Added KV Pool support for loading failure block IDs without hybrid recompute. [#9701](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9701)\n"
-"- Added NPU storage metadata debug helpers for improved troubleshooting. [#9189](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9189)\n"
-"- Added torch reserved/allocated memory profiling in `execute_model()`. [#9765](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9765)\n"
-"- Added EPLB experts hotness metrics and EPLB time consumption data exposure. [#9536](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9536)\n"
-"- Added `group_name` parameter when creating HCCL config for better group management. [#9667](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9667)\n"
-"- Enabled prefix caching with PCP/DCP, allowing KV cache reuse across prefill and decode in disaggregated deployments. [#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638)\n"
-"- Added simple yet general CPU KV Cache Offloading support. [#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743)\n"
-"- Added Mooncake SSD offload with embedded client for large-scale KV cache storage. [#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731)\n"
-"- Re-added code start compilation caching for npugraph_ex (previously reverted), improving warmup time. [#9914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9914)\n"
-"- Added ACL graph memory estimation before KV cache allocation to prevent OOM during graph capture. [#9865](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9865)\n"
-"- Added DeepSeek-V4 compressor block size [32,64,128] support to improve automatic prefix cache hit rate. [#10354](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10354)\n"
-"- Added batch_invariant_ops setup for reinforcement learning scenarios. [#10034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10034)\n"
-"- Adapted load balance proxy example to shared scheduler workers. [#9645](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9645)\n"
-"- [310P] Added Qwen3.5 MTP and graph mode support. [#10309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10309)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 在Ascend 950上增加了对DeepSeek-V4的端到端支持，包括分段图模式、DSA注意力后端、KV缓存管理、分布式推理（含PP修复）和MTP。[#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9473](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9473) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935)\n"
-"- 增加了Hybrid与Mamba对齐前缀缓存，以改善Hybrid和Mamba架构中的前缀缓存复用。[#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533)\n"
-"- 增加了逐层KV缓存事件回调，以实现更细粒度的逐层可观测性和控制。[#9468](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9468)\n"
-"- 增加了GLM4.7-Flash模型支持，使用Flash Attention后端。[#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560)\n"
-"- 增加了`FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`图模式，这是一种混合全图与分段方法的编译策略。**需要HDK 25.5.1+ / CANN 8.5.0+**以移除旧的流预算限制，从而支持显著更多的图捕获——在A3上约32k个，在Ascend 950上约64k个。相应地清理了旧的捕获大小剪枝逻辑。[#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#9962](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9962)\n"
-"- 增加了对Ascend 950的W4A8 MXFP4量化支持。[#8265](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8265)\n"
-"- 增加了Ascend 950上的MXFP8 FlashCommV3支持。[#9671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9671)\n"
-"- 增加了对W4A8 MoE压缩张量和C8量化（GQA）的NZ布局支持。[#9625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9625) [#9721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9721)\n"
-"- 增加了Mooncake Connector对QWen3.5的混合PCP/DCP支持。[#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809)\n"
-"- 在投机解码中增加了D2D NetLoader对草稿模型的权重加载。[#9893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9893)\n"
-"- 增加了Mooncake Connector混合注意力支持。[#8850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8850)\n"
-"- 增加了Mooncake KV池使用优化。[#7820](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7820)\n"
-"- 增加了KV池对加载失败块ID的支持，无需混合重计算。[#9701](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9701)\n"
-"- 增加了NPU存储元数据调试辅助功能，以改进故障排查。[#9189](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9189)\n"
-"- 在`execute_model()`中增加了torch保留/已分配内存分析。[#9765](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9765)\n"
-"- 增加了EPLB专家热度指标和EPLB耗时数据暴露。[#9536](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9536)\n"
-"- 在创建HCCL配置时增加了`group_name`参数，以实现更好的组管理。[#9667](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9667)\n"
-"- 启用了PCP/DCP前缀缓存，允许在分离式部署中跨prefill和decode复用KV缓存。[#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638)\n"
-"- 增加了简单而通用的CPU KV缓存卸载支持。[#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743)\n"
-"- 增加了带嵌入式客户端的Mooncake SSD卸载，用于大规模KV缓存存储。[#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731)\n"
-"- 重新加入了npugraph_ex的代码起始编译缓存（此前已回退），改善了预热时间。[#9914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9914)\n"
-"- 在KV缓存分配前增加了ACL图内存预估，以防止图捕获期间的OOM。[#9865](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9865)\n"
-"- 增加了DeepSeek-V4压缩器块大小[32,64,128]支持，以提高自动前缀缓存命中率。[#10354](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10354)\n"
-"- 为强化学习场景增加了batch_invariant_ops设置。[#10034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10034)\n"
-"- 将负载均衡代理示例适配到共享调度器工作进程。[#9645](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9645)\n"
-"- [310P] 增加了Qwen3.5 MTP和图模式支持。[#10309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10309)"

-msgid ""
-"- Fixed stale KV-cache writes during DP-aligned dummy runs by invalidating per-KV-group slot mappings before attention metadata construction. [#15362](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15362)\n"
-"- Fixed MTP overlay prefix-cache precision on Atlas 300I DUO and kept W8A8 MXFP8 transformed buffers stable across RL weight reloads in ACL Graph mode. [#14336](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14336) [#13905](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13905)"

-"- 修复了 DP 对齐 dummy run 期间 KV cache 的陈旧写入问题，方法是在构建 attention metadata 之前使每个 KV group 的 slot 映射失效。[#15362](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15362)\n"

-msgid ""
-"- Add Ascend Custom Ops framework. Developers now can write customs ops using AscendC. An example ops `rotary_embedding` is added. More tutorials will come soon. The Custom Ops compilation is disabled by default when installing vllm-ascend. Set `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=1` to enable it.  [#371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/371)\n"
-"- V1 engine is basically supported in this release. The full support will be done in 0.8.X release. If you hit any issue or have any requirement of V1 engine. Please tell us [this issue](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/414). [#376](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/376)\n"
-"- Prefix cache feature works now. You can set `enable_prefix_caching=True` to enable it. [#282](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/282)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 新增昇腾自定义算子框架。开发者现在可以使用 AscendC 编写自定义算子。新增了一个示例算子 `rotary_embedding`。更多教程即将推出。安装 vllm-ascend 时，自定义算子编译默认处于禁用状态。设置 `COMPILE_CUSTOM_KERNELS=1` 可启用它。[#371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/371)\n"
-"- 本版本基本支持 V1 引擎。完整支持将在 0.8.X 版本中完成。如果您遇到任何问题或对 V1 引擎有任何需求，请通过[该 issue](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/414)告知我们。[#376](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/376)\n"
-"- Prefix cache 特性现已可用。您可以设置 `enable_prefix_caching=True` 来启用它。[#282](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/282)"
