-msgid ""
-"- Added FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill and avoided AiCPU fallback for GDN boolean token sorting. [#16420](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16420) [#17219](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17219)\n"
-"- Reused transposed gate across GDN chunk forward kernels. [#17339](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17339)\n"
-"- Fused GLM-5.3-Flash KDA decode output writeback and optimized convolution state copies. [#17011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17011) [#17010](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17010)\n"
-"- Generalized DCP output pack and combine. [#17387](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17387)\n"
-"- Limited PCP embedding exchange to the local token span. [#17561](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17561)\n"
-"- Deduplicated per-step memcache RPCs and cached layerwise hit checks in KV Pool. [#16947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16947)\n"
-"- Fixed and optimized sampling mask packing on Ascend (MRV2 kernel). [#17193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17193)\n"
-"- Improved `dflash_prepare_inputs` performance (MRV2 op). [#15314](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15314)\n"
-"- Avoided redundant resample JIT variants in Triton. [#17575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17575)\n"
-"- Reused device cache-store dispatch for SFA C8. [#17135](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17135)\n"
-"- Fused SFA K-path ops and enabled PROLOG_V3 fused decode for non-PD serving, reusing indexer weight projections and cached slot-mapping conversions. [#16328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16328)\n"
-"- Fused the SFA Q up-projection layout transform with `npu_transpose_batchmatmul`. [#16198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16198)\n"
-"- Restored selective eager DP padding with graph safety. [#16823](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16823)\n"
-"- Skipped repeated MRV2 idle-DP indexer work for MiniMax-M3. [#17538](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17538)\n"
-"- Committed only dirty block-table ranges in MRV1 (later reverted for correctness; see Known Issues). [#17066](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17066) [#17470](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17470)\n"
-"- Fixed a 310P performance issue for Qwen3.5-2B. [#17278](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17278)\n"
-"- Enabled torch.compile for DeepSeek V4.1. [#18081](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18081)\n"
-"- Used bf16 router GEMM with fp32 accumulation for bf16-origin weights in MoE. [#17068](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17068)\n"
-"- Optimized GLM-5.3-Flash Triton KPool and gated norm, and adapted `ROW_BLOCK_SIZE` in `triton_q_rms` for better RMSNorm performance. [#17542](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17542) [#16478](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16478)\n"
-"- Narrowed the KV save fence to requests with released blocks. [#17555](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17555)\n"
-"- Avoided request-count specialization in DSA-CP metadata and fused slot mapping to reduce recompilation. [#17346](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17346) [#17353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17353)\n"
-"- Used FP16 gate projection for MoE routing on 310P. [#17669](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17669)\n"
-"- Skipped unused device metadata copies for GDN fused prefill. [#16887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16887)\n"
-"- Optimized DeepSeek-V4 VL embed_input_ids to remove per-step copies. [#16671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16671)\n"
-"- Optimized the DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant framework path by sharing transform tensors, caching KV plans, and fusing scale correction and cache packing. [#18037](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18037)\n"
-"- Released dead W8A8 fp32 MoE scales under MegaMoe. [#17105](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17105)\n"
-"- Prepared Triton prefill state-copy plans for KDA and widened Mamba temporal postprocess state copies. [#17614](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17614) [#17260](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17260)\n"
-"- Used zero-block cat padding for shared-expert token pads and MoE prepare in place of per-layer `F.pad`. [#17577](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17577) [#16343](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16343)\n"
-"- Accepted optional group_index in the dequant_situ_quant BF16 path. [#17570](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17570)"
-msgstr ""
-"- 为 GDN prefill 新增 FLA NPU 后端，并避免 GDN 布尔 token 排序回退到 AiCPU。[#16420](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16420) [#17219](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17219)\n"
-"- 在 GDN chunk forward 内核间复用转置后的 gate。[#17339](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17339)\n"
-"- 融合 GLM-5.3-Flash KDA decode 输出回写，并优化卷积状态拷贝。[#17011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17011) [#17010](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17010)\n"
-"- 泛化 DCP 输出 pack 与 combine。[#17387](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17387)\n"
-"- 将 PCP embedding 交换限制在本地 token 范围内。[#17561](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17561)\n"
-"- 在 KV Pool 中去重每步 memcache RPC，并缓存逐层命中检查。[#16947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16947)\n"
-"- 修复并优化昇腾上的采样 mask 打包（MRV2 内核）。[#17193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17193)\n"
-"- 提升 `dflash_prepare_inputs` 性能（MRV2 算子）。[#15314](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15314)\n"
-"- 避免 Triton 中冗余的 resample JIT 变体。[#17575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17575)\n"
-"- 为 SFA C8 复用设备 cache-store 分发。[#17135](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17135)\n"
-"- 融合 SFA K-path 算子，并为非 PD 推理启用 PROLOG_V3 融合 decode，复用 indexer 权重投影和缓存的 slot-mapping 转换。[#16328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16328)\n"
-"- 将 SFA Q up-projection 布局变换与 `npu_transpose_batchmatmul` 融合。[#16198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16198)\n"
-"- 恢复带图安全性的选择性 eager DP padding。[#16823](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16823)\n"
-"- 为 MiniMax-M3 跳过重复的 MRV2 idle-DP indexer 工作。[#17538](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17538)\n"
-"- 在 MRV1 中仅提交脏 block-table 范围（后续因正确性问题回退；见已知问题）。[#17066](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17066) [#17470](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17470)\n"
-"- 修复 Qwen3.5-2B 在 310P 上的性能问题。[#17278](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17278)\n"
-"- 为 DeepSeek V4.1 启用 torch.compile。[#18081](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18081)\n"
-"- 在 MoE 中对 bf16 来源权重使用带 fp32 累加的 bf16 router GEMM。[#17068](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17068)\n"
-"- 优化 GLM-5.3-Flash Triton KPool 和 gated norm，并调整 `triton_q_rms` 中的 `ROW_BLOCK_SIZE` 以提升 RMSNorm 性能。[#17542](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17542) [#16478](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16478)\n"
-"- 将 KV save fence 缩小到已释放 block 的请求。[#17555](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17555)\n"
-"- 避免 DSA-CP 元数据中的请求数特化，并融合 slot mapping 以减少重编译。[#17346](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17346) [#17353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17353)\n"
-"- 在 310P 上对 MoE 路由使用 FP16 gate 投影。[#17669](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17669)\n"
-"- 为 GDN 融合 prefill 跳过未使用的设备元数据拷贝。[#16887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16887)\n"
-"- 优化 DeepSeek-V4 VL embed_input_ids 以消除每步拷贝。[#16671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16671)\n"
-"- 通过共享 transform 张量、缓存 KV 计划以及融合 scale 校正与 cache 打包，优化 DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant 框架路径。[#18037](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18037)\n"
-"- 在 MegaMoe 下释放无用的 W8A8 fp32 MoE scales。[#17105](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17105)\n"
-"- 为 KDA 准备 Triton prefill 状态拷贝计划，并拓宽 Mamba 时序后处理状态拷贝。[#17614](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17614) [#17260](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17260)\n"
-"- 对共享专家 token padding 和 MoE prepare 使用 zero-block cat padding，替代逐层 `F.pad`。[#17577](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17577) [#16343](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16343)\n"
-"- 在 dequant_situ_quant BF16 路径中接受可选的 group_index。[#17570](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17570)"

-"- Supported non-uniform KV cache page sizes. [#16966](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16966)\n"
-"- Preserved private cache groups with prefix caching disabled. [#17569](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17569)\n"
-"- Fixed GLM MRV2 issues, GLM-5.2 DSpark sequence lengths/per-request FIA bounds, and GLM-5.3-Flash small slot page inflation. [#17613](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17613) [#17571](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17571) [#17545](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17545)\n"
-"- Preserved SFA and indexer cache writes across device adaptors and aligned DP-padded SFA inputs with attention metadata. [#17594](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17594) [#16768](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16768)\n"
-"- Rebuilt the sparse MLA plan from passed indices for MTP drafts. [#17535](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17535)\n"
-"- Refreshed MLA/SFA runtime weights in place on reload. [#16717](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16717)\n"
-"- Fixed Mooncake empty receives with decode-only DCP and truncated Mooncake hybrid prefill before prefix-cache lookup. [#17497](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17497) [#17407](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17407)\n"
-"- Fixed MRV2 P/D: `register_kv_caches` first-tensor-only bug, recompute-scheduler skip of `prepare_prefill_inputs`, and preempt offloading multi-D2H with mamba align resume index. [#17522](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17522) [#17445](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17445) [#16729](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16729)\n"
-"- Released requantized W4A4 MXFP4 activations before GMM1 in MoE. [#16968](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16968)\n"
-"- Restored hybrid KV cache capacity on 310P by sharing Mamba group slots; fixed LoRA in graph mode on 310P and opened MRV2 LoRA. [#17416](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17416) [#16457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16457)\n"
-"- Corrected rejected token seq_lens in MRV1 and preserved tensor state when skipping drafts. [#14883](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14883) [#17274](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17274)\n"
-"- Fixed KV Pool layerwise cache group indexing under PP and layerwise state prep/allocation rounding. [#17246](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17246) [#17487](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17487)\n"
-"- Kept a dedicated 1 MiB HCCL lifecycle anchor in sleep mode; destroyed native HCCL communicators on weight-transfer shutdown. [#15340](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15340) [#17154](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17154)\n"
-"- Selected local communication endpoints by bound NPU. [#16249](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16249)\n"
-"- Fixed Engram BF16 checkpoints without implicit quantization, HOST_UVA page migration during CPU binding, and same-node external DP launches. [#17513](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17513) [#17348](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17348) [#17248](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17248)\n"
-"- Respected per-layer KV cache dtype and kept KV cache contiguous for paged attention. [#18003](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18003) [#17924](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17924)\n"
-"- Fixed `scatter_nd_update_sk` silent row loss for non-contiguous inputs and supported block-strided KV caches in the transpose operator. [#17647](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17647) [#17868](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17868)\n"
-"- Fixed GLM C8 with custom speculative models, preserved packed C8 KPool hybrid block alignment, and preserved the first packed causal convolution state. [#17919](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17919) [#17922](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17922) [#17828](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17828)\n"
-"- Fixed DSA CP FULL graph replay metadata and aligned DSpark SAS metadata with shared visible KV. [#17750](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17750) [#17911](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17911)\n"
-"- Fixed MXFP8 O-proj TP and MRV2 DSACP serving, and honored interleaved RoPE in AscendApplyRotaryEmb. [#17961](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17961) [#17825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17825)\n"
-"- Fixed MooncakeConnectorV1 combined attention cache normalization and reset request-level states in sparse KV offload. [#17867](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17867) [#17708](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17708)\n"
-"- Fixed 310P kernel block sizes to stay compatible with physical KV cache blocks. [#17964](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17964)\n"
-"- Fixed MLA empty PCP prefill ranks and SFA O-projection gathers for short prefills. [#17972](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17972) [#17947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17947)\n"
-"- Fixed Engram history and lookup timing in Model Runner V2, and fixed multi-node DP node-local head sharding. [#17794](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17794) [#17427](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17427)\n"
-"- Restored C8 V scales on hybrid cache page reassignment. [#17956](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17956)\n"
-"- Resolved MoE communication methods with MoE config, dropped `need_expert_scale` setup, and supported SiTU and MRV2 in MegaMoe. [#17916](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17916) [#18024](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18024) [#17587](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17587)\n"
-"- Restored Mamba block tables before deferred PP postprocessing and avoided full recurrent-state copies on Ascend. [#17954](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17954) [#17565](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17565)\n"
-"- Restored platform-default indexer KV dtype for DeepSeek V4 and initialized V4 IndexCache at the first C4 of each PP stage. [#17635](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17635) [#17921](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17921)\n"
-"- Passed `worldSize` explicitly to `dispatch_ffn_combine` ops and constexpr args to the KDA compiled launcher. [#17914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17914) [#17913](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17913)\n"

-"- 遵循逐层 KV cache dtype，并为分页 attention 保持 KV cache 连续。[#18003](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18003) [#17924](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17924)\n"

-"- 修复了 MLA 空 PCP prefill rank 以及短 prefill 的 SFA O-projection gather。[#17972](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17972) [#17947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17947)\n"
-"- 修复了 Model Runner V2 中的 Engram 历史和查找时序，并修复了多节点 DP 节点本地 head 分片。[#17794](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17794) [#17427](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17427)\n"

-"- 将 `worldSize` 显式传递给 `dispatch_ffn_combine` 算子，并将 constexpr 参数传递给 KDA 编译启动器。[#17914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17914) [#17913](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17913)\n"

-"- 修复了 DFlash2 eager 元数据和 QuaRot 权重对齐，并对齐了混合 DFlash K/V 页。[#17772](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17772) [#17683](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17683)\n"

-"- 在 KV Pool 中同步 MemCache 初始化。[#17289](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17289)\n"
-"- 在 cudagraph capture 后将静态 KV buffer 置零。[#17659](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17659)\n"
-"- 在 Model Runner V2 中拒绝旧版 DSA-CP。[#18206](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18206)\n"
-"- 修复了 CANN MegaMoE 的 E8M0 scale dtype 和缺失的 activation kwargs。[#18157](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18157) [#18137](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18137)\n"
-"- 在抢占卸载中处理混合缓存视图。[#18140](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18140)\n"
-"- 为全词表 DSpark 模型定义草稿 token 映射，并处理不带 TurboQuant 的 DSpark 后端。[#18182](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18182) [#18183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18183)\n"
-"- 通过权重加载器应用 DeepSeek-V4 attention sinks。[#16958](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16958)\n"
-"- 对 MiniMax-M3 FP8 KV 使用 64 token 的 kernel 最小值。[#18125](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18125)\n"
-"- 为 ACL graph padding 调整 DFlash query buffer 大小。[#17379](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17379)\n"
-"- 移除了 QSFA tiling 中遗留的调试日志。[#18110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18110)\n"
-"- 当 o_proj 容量超出时，引导用户查看 recipe 修复方案。[#18126](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18126)\n"
-"- 将 DSA 块大小设为 Triton constexpr 对象。[#18079](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18079)\n"

-"- 在 MRV2 上支持 encoder-decoder 模型状态。[#17979](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17979)\n"
-"- 避免了 MiniMax-M3 MRV2 forward 中的 current-config 查找。[#17994](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17994)\n"
-"- 在 KV cache 中归一化 GQA 元组并注册跨步缓存 span。[#17934](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17934)\n"
-"- 对齐了 MLA DCP DSpark 草稿元数据。[#17580](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17580)\n"
-"- 移除了 MRv1 routed-experts capture，并保持 MRV2 可启动。[#17315](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17315)\n"
-"- 在 CompressorMetadataKernel 中将 tilingData 标记为 const。[#17463](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17463)\n"
-"- 在构建 PP=1 草稿配置时避免 CPP 校验。[#17381](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17381)"

+msgid ""
+"- Added FLA NPU backend for GDN prefill and avoided AI CPU fallback for GDN boolean token sorting. [#16420](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16420) [#17219](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17219)\n"
+"- Reused transposed gate across GDN chunk forward kernels. [#17339](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17339)\n"
+"- Fused GLM-5.3-Flash KDA decode output writeback and optimized convolution state copies. [#17011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17011) [#17010](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17010)\n"
+"- Generalized DCP output pack and combine. [#17387](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17387)\n"
+"- Limited PCP embedding exchange to the local token span. [#17561](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17561)\n"
+"- Deduplicated per-step memcache RPCs and cached layerwise hit checks in KV Pool. [#16947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16947)\n"
+"- Fixed and optimized sampling mask packing on Ascend (MRV2 kernel). [#17193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17193)\n"
+"- Improved `dflash_prepare_inputs` performance (MRV2 op). [#15314](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15314)\n"
+"- Avoided redundant resample JIT variants in Triton. [#17575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17575)\n"
+"- Reused device cache-store dispatch for SFA C8. [#17135](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17135)\n"
+"- Fused SFA K-path ops and enabled PROLOG_V3 fused decode for non-PD serving, reusing indexer weight projections and cached slot-mapping conversions. [#16328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16328)\n"
+"- Fused the SFA Q up-projection layout transform with `npu_transpose_batchmatmul`. [#16198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16198)\n"
+"- Restored selective eager DP padding with graph safety. [#16823](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16823)\n"
+"- Skipped repeated MRV2 idle-DP indexer work for MiniMax-M3. [#17538](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17538)\n"
+"- Committed only dirty block-table ranges in MRV1 (later reverted for correctness; see Known Issues). [#17066](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17066) [#17470](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17470)\n"
+"- Fixed a 310P performance issue for Qwen3.5-2B. [#17278](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17278)\n"
+"- Enabled torch.compile for DeepSeek V4.1. [#18081](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18081)\n"
+"- Used bf16 router GEMM with fp32 accumulation for bf16-origin weights in MoE. [#17068](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17068)\n"
+"- Optimized GLM-5.3-Flash Triton KPool and gated norm, and adapted `ROW_BLOCK_SIZE` in `triton_q_rms` for better RMSNorm performance. [#17542](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17542) [#16478](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16478)\n"
+"- Narrowed the KV save fence to requests with released blocks. [#17555](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17555)\n"
+"- Avoided request-count specialization in DSA-CP metadata and fused slot mapping to reduce recompilation. [#17346](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17346) [#17353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17353)\n"
+"- Used FP16 gate projection for MoE routing on 310P. [#17669](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17669)\n"
+"- Skipped unused device metadata copies for GDN fused prefill. [#16887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16887)\n"
+"- Optimized DeepSeek-V4 VL embed_input_ids to remove per-step copies. [#16671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16671)\n"
+"- Optimized the DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant framework path by sharing transform tensors, caching KV plans, and fusing scale correction and cache packing. [#18037](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18037)\n"
+"- Released dead W8A8 fp32 MoE scales under MegaMoE. [#17105](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17105)\n"
+"- Prepared Triton prefill state-copy plans for KDA and widened Mamba temporal postprocess state copies. [#17614](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17614) [#17260](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17260)\n"
+"- Used zero-block cat padding for shared-expert token pads and MoE prepare in place of per-layer `F.pad`. [#17577](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17577) [#16343](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16343)\n"
+"- Accepted optional group_index in the dequant_situ_quant BF16 path. [#17570](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17570)"
+msgstr ""
+"- 新增用于 GDN prefill 的 FLA NPU 后端，并避免 GDN 布尔 token 排序回退到 AI CPU。[#16420](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16420) [#17219](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17219)\n"
+"- 在 GDN chunk 前向 kernel 之间复用转置后的 gate。[#17339](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17339)\n"
+"- 融合 GLM-5.3-Flash KDA decode 输出回写，并优化卷积状态拷贝。[#17011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17011) [#17010](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17010)\n"
+"- 泛化 DCP 输出 pack 与 combine。[#17387](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17387)\n"
+"- 将 PCP embedding 交换限制在本地 token 范围内。[#17561](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17561)\n"
+"- 对每步 memcache RPC 去重，并在 KV Pool 中缓存逐层命中检查。[#16947](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16947)\n"
+"- 修复并优化昇腾上的采样 mask 打包（MRV2 kernel）。[#17193](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17193)\n"
+"- 提升 `dflash_prepare_inputs` 性能（MRV2 op）。[#15314](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/15314)\n"
+"- 避免 Triton 中冗余的 resample JIT 变体。[#17575](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17575)\n"
+"- 为 SFA C8 复用 device cache-store 分发。[#17135](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17135)\n"
+"- 融合 SFA K-path 算子，并为非 PD 服务启用 PROLOG_V3 融合 decode，同时复用 indexer 权重投影和已缓存的 slot mapping 转换。[#16328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16328)\n"
+"- 将 SFA Q 上投影布局变换与 `npu_transpose_batchmatmul` 融合。[#16198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16198)\n"
+"- 恢复带图安全保障的选择性 eager DP padding。[#16823](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16823)\n"
+"- 对 MiniMax-M3 跳过重复的 MRV2 idle-DP indexer 工作。[#17538](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17538)\n"
+"- 在 MRV1 中仅提交脏的 block-table 范围（后续因正确性问题回退；见已知问题）。[#17066](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17066) [#17470](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17470)\n"
+"- 修复 Qwen3.5-2B 在 310P 上的性能问题。[#17278](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17278)\n"
+"- 为 DeepSeek V4.1 启用 torch.compile。[#18081](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18081)\n"
+"- 在 MoE 中对 bf16 原始权重使用带 fp32 累加的 bf16 router GEMM。[#17068](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17068)\n"
+"- 优化 GLM-5.3-Flash Triton KPool 和 gated norm，并调整 `triton_q_rms` 中的 `ROW_BLOCK_SIZE` 以提升 RMSNorm 性能。[#17542](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17542) [#16478](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16478)\n"
+"- 将 KV save fence 收窄至已释放 block 的请求。[#17555](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17555)\n"
+"- 避免 DSA-CP 元数据中按请求数量特化，并融合 slot mapping 以减少重编译。[#17346](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17346) [#17353](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17353)\n"
+"- 在 310P 上对 MoE 路由使用 FP16 gate 投影。[#17669](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17669)\n"
+"- 跳过 GDN 融合 prefill 中无用的 device 元数据拷贝。[#16887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16887)\n"
+"- 优化 DeepSeek-V4 VL 的 embed_input_ids，消除每步拷贝。[#16671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16671)\n"
+"- 通过共享变换张量、缓存 KV 计划以及融合 scale 校正与 cache 打包，优化 DeepSeek V4 TurboQuant 框架路径。[#18037](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18037)\n"
+"- 在 MegaMoE 下释放废弃的 W8A8 fp32 MoE scale。[#17105](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17105)\n"
+"- 为 KDA 准备 Triton prefill 状态拷贝计划，并扩展 Mamba 时序后处理状态拷贝。[#17614](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17614) [#17260](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17260)\n"
+"- 对共享专家 token padding 和 MoE prepare 采用零块 cat padding，替代逐层 `F.pad`。[#17577](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17577) [#16343](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/16343)\n"
+"- 在 dequant_situ_quant BF16 路径中支持可选的 group_index。[#17570](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17570)"
+

+"- Fixed KV-transfer ordering and TP-shard consistency, Mooncake grouping, AscendStore hash/lease/lookup handling, and layerwise KV Pool failures. [#11887](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11887) [#12252](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12252) [#12371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12371)† [#12797](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12797)† [#12819](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12819)†\n"
+"- Fixed DCP/DP service hangs, limited the recompute scheduler to decode nodes, and delayed AscendStore initialization until the first real decode request. [#12034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12034) [#11490](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11490) [#11673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11673)\n"
+"- Disabled unsupported shared-expert multistream overlap with fused MC2 and fixed low MTP acceptance for SFA with DSA-CP and multiple speculative tokens. [#12245](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12245) [#10878](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10878)\n"
+"- Fixed AscendStore compatibility with pipeline parallelism and surfaced backend failures. [#12762](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12762)†\n"
+"- Fixed invalid-GVA handling for layerwise KV Pool transfers. [#12643](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12643)†\n"
+"- Fixed A5 BF16 `mm_reduce_scatter` communication-mode selection and restricted FP8 quantization detection to A5 devices. [#12826](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12826)† [#12895](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12895)†\n"
+"- Packed SFA DSA-CP KV tensors into one all-gather to correct and streamline the communication path. [#12867](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12867)†\n"
+"- Disabled unsupported `npugraph_ex` compilation automatically on Atlas 300I Duo and fixed low-level rotary and sparse-attention tiling/metadata issues. [#12366](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12366)† [#12446](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12446)† [#12841](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12841)†\n"
+"- Fixed `npu_dequant_swiglu_quant` precision for small token shapes and propagated `return_lse` to QuantSFA operators. [#12913](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12913)† [#13197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13197)†\n"
+"- Removed unnecessary Memcache lazy initialization and hardened AscendStore transfers by restoring synchronous saves, reporting asynchronous load failures to the scheduler, and using grouped block sizes in transfer threads. [#13028](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13028)† [#13024](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13024)† [#13099](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13099)† [#13110](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13110)†\n"
+"- Removed `-Werror` from custom-operator CMake builds so compiler warnings do not fail release builds. [#13095](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13095)†"

+msgid ""
+"- **Upstream vLLM**: v0.23.0.\n"
+"- **Python**: >= 3.10, < 3.13.\n"
+"- **CANN**: 9.1.0 for A2, A3, and Ascend 950; refer to the Atlas 300I Duo installation guide for its platform-specific CANN package. [#13421](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13421)†\n"
+"- **PyTorch / torch_npu**: 2.10.0 / 2.10.0.post4.\n"
+"- **Triton Ascend**: 3.2.2 for A2, A3, and Ascend 950; Triton Ascend is not supported on Atlas 300I Duo.\n"
+"- **Mooncake**: 0.3.11.post1 in the release images."

+msgid ""
+"- Pipeline parallelism (PP) combined with prefill context parallelism (PCP) is not supported in v0.23.0.\n"
+"- Reduce sampling (`additional_config.enable_reduce_sample=true`) is experimental. It is incompatible with P/D-disaggregated serving and lmhead tensor parallelism, where it is automatically disabled. Do not enable it when sampling logprobs are requested because the logprob values and top-k rankings would be computed over partitioned logits and can be incorrect. [#13469](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13469)† [#13632](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13632)†\n"
+"- GLM-5.2 1M-context deployments were validated only on Atlas 800 A3; the A2 series was not validated for 1M context.\n"
+"- For P/D-disaggregated serving of models using Sparse Flash Attention (SFA), including DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-5.1, and GLM-5.2, DCP must be enabled on both prefiller and decoder nodes or disabled on both. Asymmetric DCP configuration can cause accuracy issues. [#14322](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14322)†\n"
+"- On Ascend 950, context parallelism is not supported with SFA; context-parallel MLA and GQA paths are experimental. [#13303](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13303)†\n"
+"- In v0.23.0, combining GLM-5.2 DCP with Sparse Flash Attention C8 (`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`) has known issues, including performance degradation, and is not recommended. [#14011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14011)†\n"
+"- On Atlas 300I Duo or Atlas 200I Pro (310P), Qwen3.5-2B-W8A8 GSM8K accuracy can fluctuate by more than 1% compared with the floating-point model. [#14335](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14335)\n"
+"- DeepSeek V4 on A2 or A3 can experience 1-2 second TPOT spikes under high concurrency when varying input shapes trigger Triton kernel recompilation. [#14324](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14324)\n"
+"- DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-5.1 SWE benchmark results can vary because of intermittent evaluation failures, including container crashes, timeouts, dependency-download failures, and agent nondeterminism. [#14326](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14326)\n"
+"- DeepSeek-V3.1 large-EP deployments have a reported 3%-5% performance gap from the target performance. [#14327](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14327)\n"
+"- GLM-5.1 on an Ascend 950 single-node mixed P/D deployment can incur excessive P/D transfer overhead for a 64k-input/1k-output workload without a prefix-cache hit. [#14328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14328)\n"
+"- GLM-5.1 P/D-disaggregated serving with both `sfa_c8` and `li_c8` enabled has a reported performance regression for 64k-input/1k-output workloads. [#14329](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14329)\n"
+"- In graph mode, `torch.ops._C_ascend.mla_preprocess` and `torch.ops._C_ascend.batch_matmul_transpose` can emit an `rtMemcpy` 107030 error in plog; the reported error does not affect inference. [#14347](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14347)\n"
+"- GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 P/D-disaggregated serving with `enable_sparse_sfa_c8` can show GPQA accuracy fluctuations of approximately 2-3 percentage points across repeated runs. [#14378](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14378)\n"
+"- DeepSeek-V3.1 2P1D throughput has a reported regression of about 15% compared with v0.18.0 in high-throughput deployments. [#12349](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12349)\n"
+"- DeepSeek V4 Pro has an open long-running stability report involving increasing memory use. [#12345](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12345)\n"
+"- Qwen3-30B-A3B floating-point serving has a reported single-batch performance regression. [#12337](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12337)\n"
+"- AscendStore KV Pool has backend-specific constraints for layerwise Memcache, SSD offload, hybrid-attention load failures, and graph fallback behavior. [#12390](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12390)\n"
+"- Ascend 950 graph capture is temporarily limited to a reduced set of stages because of HDK incompatibility, which avoids crashes but can reduce performance. [#12998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12998)"
+msgstr ""
+"- v0.23.0 不支持流水线并行（PP）与预填充上下文并行（PCP）组合使用。\n"
+"- Reduce sampling（`additional_config.enable_reduce_sample=true`）属于实验性特性。它与 P/D 分离部署和 lmhead 张量并行不兼容，在这些场景下会被自动禁用。请求采样 logprobs 时请勿启用该特性，因为 logprob 值和 top-k 排序将在切分后的 logits 上计算，可能不正确。 [#13469](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13469)† [#13632](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13632)†\n"
+"- GLM-5.2 的 1M 上下文部署仅在 Atlas 800 A3 上完成验证；A2 系列未针对 1M 上下文进行验证。\n"
+"- 对于使用稀疏 Flash Attention（SFA）的模型（包括 DeepSeek-V3.2、GLM-5.1 和 GLM-5.2）的 P/D 分离部署，必须在 prefiller 和 decoder 节点上同时启用 DCP，或同时禁用。DCP 配置不对称可能导致精度问题。 [#14322](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14322)†\n"
+"- 在昇腾 950 上，SFA 不支持上下文并行；上下文并行的 MLA 和 GQA 路径属于实验性特性。 [#13303](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/13303)†\n"
+"- 在 v0.23.0 中，将 GLM-5.2 DCP 与稀疏 Flash Attention C8（`enable_sparse_sfa_c8`）组合使用存在已知问题，包括性能下降，因此不建议使用。 [#14011](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/14011)†\n"
+"- 在 Atlas 300I Duo 或 Atlas 200I Pro（310P）上，Qwen3.5-2B-W8A8 的 GSM8K 精度相比浮点模型可能出现超过 1% 的波动。 [#14335](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14335)\n"
+"- 在高并发场景下，当变化的输入形状触发 Triton kernel 重新编译时，A2 或 A3 上的 DeepSeek V4 可能出现 1-2 秒的 TPOT 尖峰。 [#14324](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14324)\n"
+"- 由于评测过程中存在间歇性失败（包括容器崩溃、超时、依赖下载失败以及 agent 的不确定性），DeepSeek V4 Flash 和 GLM-5.1 的 SWE 基准测试结果可能有所波动。 [#14326](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14326)\n"
+"- 据报告，DeepSeek-V3.1 大 EP 部署的性能与目标性能存在 3%-5% 的差距。 [#14327](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14327)\n"
+"- 在昇腾 950 单节点混合 P/D 部署中，对于未命中前缀缓存的 64k 输入/1k 输出负载，GLM-5.1 可能产生过高的 P/D 传输开销。 [#14328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14328)\n"
+"- 据报告，同时启用 `sfa_c8` 和 `li_c8` 的 GLM-5.1 P/D 分离部署在 64k 输入/1k 输出负载上存在性能回退。 [#14329](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14329)\n"
+"- 在图模式下，`torch.ops._C_ascend.mla_preprocess` 和 `torch.ops._C_ascend.batch_matmul_transpose` 可能在 plog 中输出 `rtMemcpy` 107030 错误；该报错不影响推理。 [#14347](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14347)\n"
+"- 启用 `enable_sparse_sfa_c8` 的 GLM-5.2-W4A8C8 P/D 分离部署在多次重复运行中，GPQA 精度可能出现约 2-3 个百分点的波动。 [#14378](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/14378)\n"
+"- 据报告，在高吞吐部署中，DeepSeek-V3.1 2P1D 的吞吐相比 v0.18.0 回退约 15%。 [#12349](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12349)\n"
+"- DeepSeek V4 Pro 存在一个尚未解决的长时间运行稳定性报告，涉及内存使用持续增长。 [#12345](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12345)\n"
+"- 据报告，Qwen3-30B-A3B 的浮点部署存在单批性能回退。 [#12337](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12337)\n"
+"- AscendStore KV Pool 在后端层面存在特定约束，涉及分层 Memcache、SSD 卸载、混合注意力加载失败以及图回退行为。 [#12390](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12390)\n"
+"- 由于 HDK 不兼容，昇腾 950 的图捕获暂时被限制在较少的阶段，这样可以避免崩溃，但可能降低性能。 [#12998](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/12998)"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Added end-to-end support for DeepSeek-V4 on Ascend 950, including piecewise graph mode, DSA attention backend, KV cache management, distributed inference (with PP fixes), and MTP. [#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9473](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9473) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935)\n"
+"- Added Hybrid & Mamba Align Prefix Cache for improved prefix cache reuse in Hybrid and Mamba architectures. [#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533)\n"
+"- Added layerwise KV cache event callbacks for finer per-layer observability and control. [#9468](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9468)\n"
+"- Added GLM4.7-Flash model support with Flash Attention backend. [#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560)\n"
+"- Added `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` graph mode, a hybrid compilation strategy mixing full-graph and piecewise approaches. **Requires HDK 25.5.1+ / CANN 8.5.0+** to remove the old stream-budget limitation, enabling significantly more graph captures — approximately 32k on A3 and 64k on Ascend 950. Legacy capture-size pruning has been cleaned up accordingly. [#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#9962](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9962)\n"
+"- Added W4A8 MXFP4 quantization support for Ascend 950. [#8265](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8265)\n"
+"- Added MXFP8 FlashCommV3 support on Ascend 950. [#9671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9671)\n"
+"- Added NZ layout support for W4A8 MoE compressed tensors and C8 quantization (GQA). [#9625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9625) [#9721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9721)\n"
+"- Added Mooncake Connector hybrid PCP/DCP support for Qwen3.5. [#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809)\n"
+"- Added D2D NetLoader weight loading for draft models in speculative decoding. [#9893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9893)\n"
+"- Added Mooncake Connector hybrid attention support. [#8850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8850)\n"
+"- Added Mooncake KV pool usage optimization. [#7820](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7820)\n"
+"- Added KV Pool support for loading failure block IDs without hybrid recompute. [#9701](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9701)\n"
+"- Added NPU storage metadata debug helpers for improved troubleshooting. [#9189](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9189)\n"
+"- Added torch reserved/allocated memory profiling in `execute_model()`. [#9765](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9765)\n"
+"- Added EPLB experts hotness metrics and EPLB time consumption data exposure. [#9536](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9536)\n"
+"- Added `group_name` parameter when creating HCCL config for better group management. [#9667](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9667)\n"
+"- Enabled prefix caching with PCP/DCP, allowing KV cache reuse across prefill and decode in disaggregated deployments. [#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638)\n"
+"- Added simple yet general CPU KV Cache Offloading support. [#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743)\n"
+"- Added Mooncake SSD offload with embedded client for large-scale KV cache storage. [#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731)\n"
+"- Re-added code start compilation caching for npugraph_ex (previously reverted), improving warmup time. [#9914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9914)\n"
+"- Added ACL graph memory estimation before KV cache allocation to prevent OOM during graph capture. [#9865](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9865)\n"
+"- Added DeepSeek-V4 compressor block size [32,64,128] support to improve automatic prefix cache hit rate. [#10354](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10354)\n"
+"- Added batch_invariant_ops setup for reinforcement learning scenarios. [#10034](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10034)\n"
+"- Adapted load balance proxy example to shared scheduler workers. [#9645](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9645)\n"
+"- [310P] Added Qwen3.5 MTP and graph mode support. [#10309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10309)"
+msgstr ""
+"- 新增昇腾950上 DeepSeek-V4 的端到端支持，包括分段图模式、DSA 注意力后端、KV 缓存管理、分布式推理（含 PP 修复）以及 MTP。[#9757](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9757) [#9473](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9473) [#9935](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9935)\n"
+"- 新增 Hybrid & Mamba Align Prefix Cache，提升 Hybrid 与 Mamba 架构下的前缀缓存复用率。[#9533](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9533)\n"
+"- 新增分层 KV 缓存事件回调，实现更精细的逐层可观测性与控制能力。[#9468](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9468)\n"
+"- 新增 GLM4.7-Flash 模型支持，并适配 Flash Attention 后端。[#9560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9560)\n"
+"- 新增 `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` 图模式，这是一种融合全图与分段两种方式的混合编译策略。**需要 HDK 25.5.1+ / CANN 8.5.0+** 以移除旧的 stream 预算限制，从而支持显著更多的图捕获——A3 上约 32k，昇腾950 上约 64k。相应地，旧的捕获尺寸裁剪逻辑已被清理。[#9572](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9572) [#9962](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9962)\n"
+"- 新增昇腾950上的 W4A8 MXFP4 量化支持。[#8265](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8265)\n"
+"- 新增昇腾950上的 MXFP8 FlashCommV3 支持。[#9671](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9671)\n"
+"- 为 W4A8 MoE 压缩张量和 C8 量化（GQA）新增 NZ 布局支持。[#9625](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9625) [#9721](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9721)\n"
+"- 新增 Mooncake Connector 对 Qwen3.5 的 hybrid PCP/DCP 支持。[#9809](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9809)\n"
+"- 新增投机解码中草稿模型的 D2D NetLoader 权重加载支持。[#9893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9893)\n"
+"- 新增 Mooncake Connector 的 hybrid attention 支持。[#8850](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8850)\n"
+"- 新增 Mooncake KV 池使用优化。[#7820](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/7820)\n"
+"- 新增 KV Pool 支持，可在不进行 hybrid 重算的情况下加载失败的 block ID。[#9701](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9701)\n"
+"- 新增 NPU 存储元数据调试辅助工具，提升问题定位能力。[#9189](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9189)\n"
+"- 在 `execute_model()` 中新增 torch reserved/allocated 内存 profiling。[#9765](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9765)\n"
+"- 新增 EPLB 专家热度指标以及 EPLB 耗时数据的对外暴露。[#9536](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9536)\n"
+"- 创建 HCCL 配置时新增 `group_name` 参数，以便更好地管理通信组。[#9667](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9667)\n"
+"- 在 PCP/DCP 下启用前缀缓存，使分离式部署中的 prefill 与 decode 阶段可复用 KV 缓存。[#9638](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9638)\n"
+"- 新增简单且通用的 CPU KV Cache 卸载支持。[#8743](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/8743)\n"
+"- 新增带内嵌客户端的 Mooncake SSD 卸载，用于大规模 KV 缓存存储。[#9731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9731)\n"
+"- 重新加入 npugraph_ex 的代码启动编译缓存（此前曾被回退），缩短预热时间。[#9914](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9914)\n"
+"- 在 KV 缓存分配前新增 ACL 图内存估算，防止图捕获过程中出现 OOM。[#9865](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/9865)\n"
+"- 新增 DeepSeek-V4 压缩器 block size [32,64,128] 支持，以提升自动前缀缓存命中率。[#10354](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10354)\n"

+"- Currently, `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FUSED_MC2` is not recommended for multi-DP and large number of tokens case(`kv_producer` or `kv_both`), this case may create large number of padded tokens across dp, which will be routed to certain experts, and make certain ranks receive tokens overload, resulting accuracy and performance issues. +"- **Context Parallel（PCP/DCP）**：[实验性] 新增对 Prefill Context Parallel（PCP）和 Decode Context Parallel（DCP）的全面支持，可与 ACLGraph、MTP、chunked prefill、MLAPO 以及 Mooncake connector 集成。该功能为实验特性，欢迎反馈。 [#3260](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3260) [#3731](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3731) [#3801](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3801) [#3980](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3980) [#4066](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4066) [#4098](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4098) [#4183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4183) [#5672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5672)\n"
+"- **全图模式（ACLGraph）**：[实验性] 增强全图模式，支持 GQA、内存优化、统一 ACLGraph 与 Torchair 之间的逻辑，并提升稳定性。 [#3560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3560) [#3970](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3970) [#3812](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3812) [#3879](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3879) [#3888](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3888) [#3894](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3894) [#5118](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5118)\n"
+"- **多 Token 预测（MTP）**：显著增强 MTP 支持，包括面向 DeepSeek 的 chunked prefill、量化支持、全图模式、PCP/DCP 集成以及异步调度。MTP 目前已在大多数场景下可用，推荐使用。 [#2711](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2711) [#2713](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2713) [#3620](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3620) [#3845](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3845) [#3910](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3910) [#3915](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3915) [#4102](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4102) [#4111](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4111) [#4770](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4770) [#5477](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5477)\n"
+"- **Eagle 投机解码**：Eagle 投机解码现已支持全图模式，并且更加稳定。 [#5118](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5118) [#4893](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4893) [#5804](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5804)\n"
+"- **PD 分离**：将 ADXL engine 设为分离式 Prefill 的默认后端，提升了性能与稳定性。为 DeepSeek decode 节点新增 KV NZ 特性支持。 [#3761](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3761) [#3950](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3950) [#5008](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5008) [#3072](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3072)\n"
+"- **KV Pool 与 Mooncake**：增强 KV pool，支持面向 PCP/DCP 的 Mooncake connector、多种输入后缀，并提升 Layerwise Connector 的性能。 [#3690](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3690) [#3752](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3752) [#3849](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3849) [#4183](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/4183) [#5303](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5303)\n"
+"- **EPLB（专家并行负载均衡）**：[实验性] EPLB 现在更加稳定，修复了大量 bug。Mix placement 现在可以正常工作。 [#6086](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/6086)\n"
+"- **全 Decode Only 模式**：在 full_decode_only 模式下新增对 Qwen3-Next 和 DeepSeekv32 的支持，并修复了若干 bug。 [#3949](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3949) [#3986](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3986) [#3763](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/3763)\n"
+"- **Model Runner V2**：[实验性] 新增对 Model Runner V2（下一代 vLLM）的基础支持，并将在后续版本中默认使用。 [#5210](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/5210)"
+

+msgid "### Known issues"
+msgstr "### 已知问题"
+
+msgid ""
+"- ACLGraph now works with Ray backend. [#2589](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2589)\n"
+"- MTP now works with the token > 1. [#2708](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2708)\n"

+msgstr ""
+"- ACLGraph 现在可与 Ray 后端配合使用。 [#2589](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2589)\n"
+"- MTP 现在支持 token > 1 的场景。 [#2708](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2708)\n"
+"- Qwen2.5 VL 现在支持量化。 [#2778](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2778)\n"
+"- 提升了启用异步调度器时的性能。 [#2783](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2783)\n"
+"- 修复了使用默认调度器时非 MLA 模型的性能回退问题。 [#2894](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2894)"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Bug fixes:\n"
+"    - Updated the graph capture size calculation, somehow alleviated the problem that NPU stream not enough in some scenarios. [#2511](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2511)\n"
+"    - Fixed bugs and refactor cached mask generation logic. [#2442](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2442)\n"
+"    - Fixed the nz format does not work in quantization scenarios. [#2549](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2549)\n"
+"    - Fixed the accuracy issue on Qwen series caused by enabling `enable_shared_expert_dp` by default. [#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)\n"
+"    - Fixed the accuracy issue on models whose rope dim is not equal to head dim, e.g., GLM4.5. [#2601](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2601)\n"
+"- Performance improved through a lot of prs:\n"
+"    - Removed torch.cat and replaced it with List[0]. [#2153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2153)\n"
+"    - Converted the format of gmm to nz. [#2474](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2474)\n"
+"    - Optimized parallel strategies to reduce communication overhead. [#2198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2198)\n"
+"    - Optimized reject sampler in greedy situation. [#2137](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2137)\n"
+"- A batch of refactoring PRs to enhance the code architecture:\n"
+"    - Refactor on MLA. [#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - Refactor on torchair fused_moe. [#2438](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2438)\n"
+"    - Refactor on allgather/mc2-related fused_experts. [#2369](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2369)\n"
+"    - Refactor on torchair model runner. [#2208](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2208)\n"
+"    - Refactor on CI. [#2276](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2276)\n"
+"- Parameters changes:\n"
+"    - Added `lmhead_tensor_parallel_size` in `additional_config`, set it to enable lmhead tensor parallel. [#2309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2309)\n"
+"    - Some unused environment variables `HCCN_PATH`, `PROMPT_DEVICE_ID`, `DECODE_DEVICE_ID`, `LLMDATADIST_COMM_PORT` and `LLMDATADIST_SYNC_CACHE_WAIT_TIME` are removed. [#2448](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2448)\n"
+"    - Environment variable `VLLM_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` is renamed to `VLLM_ASCEND_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` now. [#2450](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2450)\n"
+"    - Added `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLP_OPTIMIZE` in environment variables, Whether to enable mlp optimize when tensor parallel is enabled. This feature provides better performance in eager mode. [#2120](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2120)\n"
+"    - Removed `MOE_ALL2ALL_BUFFER` and `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MOE_ALL2ALL_SEQ` in environment variables. [#2612](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2612)\n"
+"    - Added `enable_prefetch` in `additional_config`, Whether to enable weight prefetch. [#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - Added `mode` in `additional_config.torchair_graph_config`, When using reduce-overhead mode for torchair, mode needs to be set. [#2461](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2461)\n"
+"    - `enable_shared_expert_dp` in `additional_config` is disabled by default now, and it is recommended to be enabled when inferencing with deepseek. [#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)"
+msgstr ""
+"- 问题修复：\n"
+"    - 更新了图捕获大小计算，在一定程度上缓解了某些场景下 NPU stream 不足的问题。[#2511](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2511)\n"
+"    - 修复了若干问题，并重构了缓存 mask 生成逻辑。[#2442](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2442)\n"
+"    - 修复了量化场景下 nz 格式不生效的问题。[#2549](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2549)\n"
+"    - 修复了因默认启用 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 而导致 Qwen 系列模型精度异常的问题。[#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)\n"
+"    - 修复了 rope dim 与 head dim 不相等（例如 GLM4.5）的模型上的精度问题。[#2601](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2601)\n"
+"- 通过大量 PR 提升了性能：\n"
+"    - 移除了 torch.cat，并将其替换为 List[0]。[#2153](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2153)\n"
+"    - 将 gmm 的格式转换为 nz。[#2474](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2474)\n"
+"    - 优化了并行策略，以减少通信开销。[#2198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2198)\n"
+"    - 优化了 greedy 场景下的 reject sampler。[#2137](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2137)\n"
+"- 一批用于增强代码架构的重构 PR：\n"
+"    - 重构 MLA。[#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - 重构 torchair fused_moe。[#2438](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2438)\n"
+"    - 重构 allgather/mc2 相关的 fused_experts。[#2369](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2369)\n"
+"    - 重构 torchair model runner。[#2208](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2208)\n"
+"    - 重构 CI。[#2276](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2276)\n"
+"- 参数变更：\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config` 中新增 `lmhead_tensor_parallel_size`，设置该参数以启用 lmhead 张量并行。[#2309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2309)\n"
+"    - 移除了一些未使用的环境变量：`HCCN_PATH`、`PROMPT_DEVICE_ID`、`DECODE_DEVICE_ID`、`LLMDATADIST_COMM_PORT` 和 `LLMDATADIST_SYNC_CACHE_WAIT_TIME`。[#2448](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2448)\n"
+"    - 环境变量 `VLLM_LLMDD_RPC_PORT` 现已重命名为 `VLLM_ASCEND_LLMDD_RPC_PORT`。[#2450](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2450)\n"
+"    - 在环境变量中新增 `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MLP_OPTIMIZE`，用于控制启用张量并行时是否开启 mlp 优化。该特性在 eager 模式下可提供更好的性能。[#2120](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2120)\n"
+"    - 在环境变量中移除了 `MOE_ALL2ALL_BUFFER` 和 `VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_MOE_ALL2ALL_SEQ`。[#2612](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2612)\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config` 中新增 `enable_prefetch`，用于控制是否启用权重预取。[#2465](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2465)\n"
+"    - 在 `additional_config.torchair_graph_config` 中新增 `mode`；当 torchair 使用 reduce-overhead 模式时，需要设置该参数。[#2461](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2461)\n"
+"    - `additional_config` 中的 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 现在默认关闭；建议在使用 DeepSeek 进行推理时启用。[#2457](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/2457)"
+

[CI] Add /download command and delegate model cache downloads to sync-tools (#21934)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

NPU E2E tests can only run a model once it is on the cluster disk, and
the download itself is network-bound. Today the downloads run in-job on
business O-card NPU runners (`linux-aarch64-a2b3-0`, `a3-800t-0`,
`a3-800i-2`, `a5-0`),
which holds NPU nodes for TB-scale pulls, and `cancel-in-progress: true`
can interrupt a download mid-blob and leave a truncated cache.

This PR moves the download off the Ascend runners entirely and delegates
it to the `ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools` model-library pipeline, and
adds a maintainer `/download` command so the caches can be populated
without a
same-repo PR branch.

- Renames `labeled_download_model_dataset.yaml` to
`pr_download_command.yml` with three triggers:
- `pull_request` on the `model-dataset-download` label (unchanged
behavior);
- `repository_dispatch` via a new `/download` slash command (triage+, PR
comments only), which also works for fork PRs where the label-triggered
run cannot read repository secrets;
- `workflow_dispatch` with explicit `models`/`datasets`/`cluster` inputs
for repairing a cache whose ledger drifted from
`model_dataset_list.json`.
- Uses a single CPU runner (`linux-amd64-cpu-1-hk`) instead of one
Ascend runner per cluster.
- Diffs `model_dataset_list.json` (PR head vs `main`) per cluster and
request only the clusters that actually receive something. `a3` and
`a3-560t` are separate targets; `models.310p` travels with the `a3`
volume the 310p tests mount.
- The triggering comment reports progress in place (accepted →
per-cluste status with the sync-tools job link → final summary), with a
3h wait budget; already-cached items return in seconds (idempotent).
- Registers the command in `slash_command_dispatch.yml`, documents it in
`docs/source/community/slash-commands.md` (and its zh_CN `.po`), and
lists `linux-amd64-cpu-1-hk` in `.github/actionlint.yaml`.

One-time prerequisite for maintainers: a fine-grained PAT scoped to
`ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools` (Actions: read/write), stored as the
`MODEL_SYNC_PAT` repo/org secret.

No behavior change for forks/PRs without the `model-dataset-download`
label.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No — this is a CI/workflow and documentation-only change. The new
`/download` command is a maintainer-facing CI tool, not an end-user API
or runtime behavior change, so no release-note fragment is added.

`slash_command_dispatch.yml` and `.github/actionlint.yaml`.

+# Mirror the models and datasets a PR adds into the CI cluster caches.
+#
+# Triggers:
+#   - the `model-dataset-download` label on a PR (pull_request);
+#   - a maintainer commenting `/download` on a PR (repository_dispatch, gated by
+#     slash_command_dispatch at triage+);
+#   - a manual run with explicit items and cluster (workflow_dispatch).
+#
+# The first two download only what the PR adds to model_dataset_list.json, and
+# only for the clusters that actually receive something: a PR touching
+# `models.a2` produces one request, not four. `a3` and `a3-560t` are the two
+# disks of the a3 cluster and are requested separately; the 310p tests mount the
+# a3 volume, so models.310p travels with a3.
+#
+# The download is delegated to the ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools model-library
+# pipeline, which routes every request to the right cluster disks (idempotent,
+# serialized, xet-disabled, ledger-recorded). No Ascend runner is occupied and
+# no repository secret is needed on the PR branch, so the comment trigger also
+# works for PRs from forks.
+
+name: 'model downloader'
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - '.github/workflows/misc/model_dataset_list.json'
+      - '.github/workflows/pr_download_command.yml'
+    types: [labeled, synchronize]
+  repository_dispatch:
+    types: [download-command]
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      models:
+        description: 'ModelScope model ids (org/name), comma or newline separated'
+        required: false
+        default: ''
+      datasets:
+        description: 'ModelScope dataset ids (org/name), comma or newline separated'
+        required: false
+        default: ''
+      cluster:
+        description: 'Cluster to populate (a3 also covers the 310p entries)'
+        type: choice
+        options: [all, a2, a3, a3-560t, a5]
+        default: all
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash -el {0}
+
+concurrency:
+  # One wait per PR: a newer /download supersedes the previous one. The request
+  # already handed to sync-tools keeps running; it is idempotent. A manual run
+  # gets its own group, so it never cancels another manual download.
+  group: ascend-${{ github.workflow_ref }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.client_payload.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+jobs:
+  download:
+    name: Download models and datasets
+    # The label only gates pull_request events; a dispatch (comment or manual)
+    # is always allowed because a maintainer started it.
+    if: |
+      github.event_name != 'pull_request' ||
+      contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'model-dataset-download')
+    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu-1-hk
+    container:
+      image: swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/base_image/ascend-ci/vllm-ascend/act-environments-ubuntu:act-22.04
+    # The wait below is capped at 3h; this only protects against a stuck step.
+    timeout-minutes: 210
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout PR head
+        if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
+        uses: actions/checkout@v7
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 1
+          # repository_dispatch checks out the default branch; point it at the
+          # PR head so the diff below sees the list this PR proposes.
+          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' && format('refs/pull/{0}/head', github.event.client_payload.pull_request.number) || '' }}
+
+      - name: Plan clusters and items
+        id: plan
+        env:
+          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
+          CLUSTER: ${{ inputs.cluster }}
+          IN_MODELS: ${{ inputs.models }}
+          IN_DATASETS: ${{ inputs.datasets }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          export LC_ALL=C
+
+          JSON_PATH=".github/workflows/misc/model_dataset_list.json"
+          mkdir -p /tmp/plan
+          : > /tmp/plan/datasets
+          : > /tmp/plan/in.models
+
+          # cluster|runner|groups of model_dataset_list.json. `a3` and `a3-560t`
+          # are the two disks of the a3 cluster; the 310p tests mount the a3
+          # volume, so models.310p travels with a3.
+          CLUSTERS='a2|linux-aarch64-a2b3-0|a2
+          a3|linux-aarch64-a3-800t-0|a3,310p
+          a3-560t|linux-aarch64-a3-800i-2|a3,310p
+          a5|linux-aarch64-a5-0|a5'
+
+          split_ids() {
+            tr ',' '\n' | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//' \
+              | grep -v '^$' | sort -u || true
+          }
+
+          if [ "${EVENT_NAME}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
+            want="${CLUSTER:-all}"
+            case "$want" in
+              all|a2|a3|a3-560t|a5) ;;
+              *) echo "::error::unknown cluster '$want' (expected all, a2, a3, a3-560t or a5)"; exit 1 ;;
+            esac
+            printf '%s\n' "${IN_MODELS}"   | split_ids > /tmp/plan/in.models
+            printf '%s\n' "${IN_DATASETS}" | split_ids > /tmp/plan/datasets
+            ids=$(grep -h . /tmp/plan/in.models /tmp/plan/datasets || true)
+            if [ -z "${ids}" ]; then
+              echo "::error::give at least one model or dataset id (org/name)."
+              exit 1
+            fi
+            # The ids are forwarded into another repository's workflow, so only
+            # a conservative charset without '..' is accepted.
+            bad=$(printf '%s\n' "${ids}" \
+              | grep -Ev '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$' || true)
+            if [ -n "${bad}" ] || printf '%s\n' "${ids}" | grep -q '\.\.'; then
+              echo "::error::invalid id(s): expected ModelScope ids such as 'DeepSeek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR', got:"
+              printf '  %s\n' "${bad:-${ids}}"
+              # Hint when the value is a path instead of an id.
+              if printf '%s\n' "${ids}" | grep -qE '^(/|[A-Za-z]:)'; then
+                echo "::notice::'models' and 'datasets' take ModelScope ids, not a filesystem path: the job runs on a CI runner and cannot read a file from your machine. The JSON list is only read by the label and /download paths."
+              fi
+              exit 1
+            fi
+          else
+            git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
+            git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" show "HEAD:${JSON_PATH}" > /tmp/head.json
+            git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" fetch -q --depth=1 origin +main:refs/remotes/origin/main
+            git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" show "origin/main:${JSON_PATH}" > /tmp/base.json
+            for f in /tmp/head.json /tmp/base.json; do
+              jq -e '((.models // {}) | type == "object") and ((.datasets // []) | type == "array")' \
+                "$f" > /dev/null \
+                || { echo "::error::unexpected schema in $f"; exit 1; }
+            done
+            jq -r '(.datasets // [])[]' /tmp/head.json | sort -u > /tmp/plan/d.head
+            jq -r '(.datasets // [])[]' /tmp/base.json | sort -u > /tmp/plan/d.base
+            comm -23 /tmp/plan/d.head /tmp/plan/d.base > /tmp/plan/datasets
+          fi
+
+          # Keep a cluster only when it receives at least one model or dataset.
+          plan='{}'
+          clusters=''
+          while IFS='|' read -r cluster runner groups; do
+            [ -n "$cluster" ] || continue
+            models="/tmp/plan/m.${cluster}"
+            datasets="/tmp/plan/d.${cluster}"
+            : > "$models"
+            : > "$datasets"
+            if [ "${EVENT_NAME}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
+              if [ "$want" = "all" ] || [ "$want" = "$cluster" ]; then
+                cp /tmp/plan/in.models "$models"
+                cp /tmp/plan/datasets "$datasets"
+              fi
+            else
+              jq -r --argjson g "$(printf '%s' "$groups" | jq -R -c 'split(",")')" '
+                def flat($d): [ $g[] as $k | ($d.models[$k] // [])[] ] | unique;
+                flat(.) as $pr | input as $m | flat($m) as $main | ($pr - $main)[]
+              ' /tmp/head.json /tmp/base.json > "$models"
+              cp /tmp/plan/datasets "$datasets"
+            fi
+            [ -s "$models" ] || [ -s "$datasets" ] || continue
+            plan=$(printf '%s' "$plan" | jq -c \
+              --arg c "$cluster" --arg r "$runner" \
+              --argjson m "$(jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' "$models")" \
+              --argjson d "$(jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' "$datasets")" \
+              '. + {($c): {runner: $r, models: $m, datasets: $d}}')
+            clusters="${clusters:+${clusters},}${cluster}"
+          done <<< "$CLUSTERS"
+
+          printf '%s' "$plan" | jq -c . > /tmp/plan/plan.json
+          echo "clusters=${clusters}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          echo "clusters: ${clusters:-none}"
+          jq -r 'to_entries[] | "\(.key) -> \(.value.runner): \(.value.models | length) models, \(.value.datasets | length) datasets"' \
+            /tmp/plan/plan.json
+
+      - name: Delegate to sync-tools
+        id: dispatch
+        env:
+          MODEL_SYNC_PAT: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SYNC_PAT }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ "$(jq 'length' /tmp/plan/plan.json)" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "no cluster needs a download; nothing to request"
+            echo "requested=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          if [ -z "${MODEL_SYNC_PAT:-}" ]; then
+            echo "::error::MODEL_SYNC_PAT is empty: a label-triggered run from a fork cannot read the repository secrets. Use /download instead."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          to_models() {
+            jq -c '[.[] | split("/") | {platform:"modelscope", organization:.[0], model_name:(.[1:] | join("/"))}]'
+          }
+          to_datasets() {
+            jq -c '[.[] | split("/") | {platform:"modelscope", organization:.[0], dataset_name:(.[1:] | join("/"))}]'
+          }
+
+          : > /tmp/rids.txt
+          for cluster in $(jq -r 'keys[]' /tmp/plan/plan.json); do
+            rid="${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${cluster}"
+            runner=$(jq -r --arg c "$cluster" '.[$c].runner' /tmp/plan/plan.json)
+            m=$(jq -c --arg c "$cluster" '.[$c].models'   /tmp/plan/plan.json | to_models)
+            d=$(jq -c --arg c "$cluster" '.[$c].datasets' /tmp/plan/plan.json | to_datasets)
+            payload=$(jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg lbl "$runner" \
+              --argjson m "$m" --argjson d "$d" \
+              '{event_type:"model-download-request", client_payload:{
+                 repo:"vllm-project/vllm-ascend", runner_label:$lbl, request_id:$rid,
+                 models:$m, datasets:$d}}')
+            curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${MODEL_SYNC_PAT}" \
+              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+              https://api.github.com/repos/ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools/dispatches \
+              --data "$payload"
+            echo "${rid} ${runner}" >> /tmp/rids.txt
+            echo "requested ${cluster} on ${runner}: $(printf '%s' "$m" | jq length) models, $(printf '%s' "$d" | jq length) datasets"
+          done
+          echo "requested=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+
+      - name: Acknowledge on the PR
+        if: github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch' && steps.dispatch.outputs.requested == 'true'
+        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v5
+        with:
+          token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
+          repository: ${{ github.event.client_payload.github.payload.repository.full_name }}
+          comment-id: ${{ github.event.client_payload.github.payload.comment.id }}
+          body: |
+            [Bot]: /download accepted, downloading for: `${{ steps.plan.outputs.clusters }}`. This comment is updated as each cluster finishes.
+          reactions: eyes
+
+      - name: Wait for the downloads to land
+        if: steps.dispatch.outputs.requested == 'true'
+        env:
+          MODEL_SYNC_PAT: ${{ secrets.MODEL_SYNC_PAT }}
+          PAT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}
+          REPO: ${{ github.event.client_payload.github.payload.repository.full_name }}
+          COMMENT_ID: ${{ github.event.client_payload.github.payload.comment.id }}
+        run: |
+          set -uo pipefail
+          api=https://api.github.com/repos/ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools
+          auth=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${MODEL_SYNC_PAT}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
+          deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + 10800 ))
+          declare -A run_of=() result=() url_of=()
+          : > /tmp/matches.txt
+
+          # Rewrite the triggering comment with the current per-cluster state, so
+          # a maintainer does not have to wait up to 3h for the final reply.
+          render() {
+            out=""
+            for k in "${!run_of[@]}"; do
+              case "${result[$k]}" in
+                ok) mark="✅" ;;
+                warn) mark="⚠️" ;;
+                failed) mark="❌" ;;
+                *) mark="⏳" ;;
+              esac
+              out="${out}- \`${k#*-}\` ${mark} ${url_of[$k]:-no sync-tools job yet}"$'\n'
+            done
+            printf '%s' "$out"
+          }
+          push_progress() {
+            [ -n "${COMMENT_ID:-}" ] || return 0
+            body=$(printf '[Bot]: /download %s\n\n%s\nRun: %s/%s/actions/runs/%s\n' \
+              "$1" "$(render)" "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}")
+            jq -n --arg b "$body" '{body: $b}' \
+              | curl -sf -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PAT_TOKEN}" \
+                  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
+                  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+                  "https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/issues/comments/${COMMENT_ID}" \
+                  --data-binary @- > /dev/null \
+              || echo "::warning::could not update the PR comment"
+          }
+
+          while read -r rid _runner; do
+            run_of[$rid]=""
+            result[$rid]=""
+          done < /tmp/rids.txt
+          push_progress "running"
+
+          while :; do
+            pending=0
+            for rid in "${!run_of[@]}"; do
+              if [ -z "${result[$rid]}" ]; then
+                if [ -z "${run_of[$rid]}" ]; then
+                  for r in $(curl -s "${auth[@]}" "$api/actions/runs?event=repository_dispatch&per_page=15" \
+                               | jq -r '.workflow_runs[].id'); do
+                    # The job name carries the request id, and html_url is the
+                    # link a maintainer needs to read the download log.
+                    url=$(curl -s "${auth[@]}" "$api/actions/runs/$r/jobs" \
+                          | jq -r --arg rid "$rid" \
+                              '[.jobs[] | select(.name | test(" <- api#" + $rid + "$"))][0].html_url // empty')
+                    if [ -n "$url" ]; then
+                      run_of[$rid]=$r
+                      url_of[$rid]="$url"
+                      echo "matched ${rid} -> ${url}"
+                      echo "${rid} ${url}" >> /tmp/matches.txt
+                      echo "::notice title=${rid}::${url}"
+                      break
+                    fi
+                  done
+                fi
+                if [ -n "${run_of[$rid]}" ]; then
+                  st=$(curl -s "${auth[@]}" "$api/actions/runs/${run_of[$rid]}" \
+                       | jq -r '.status + ":" + (.conclusion // "")')
+                  case "$st" in
+                    completed:success)
+                      result[$rid]=ok
+                      echo "${rid}: landed on the cluster disks" ;;
+                    completed:cancelled|completed:skipped)
+                      result[$rid]=warn
+                      echo "::warning::${rid}: sync-tools run ${run_of[$rid]} ended ${st}" ;;
+                    completed:*)
+                      result[$rid]=failed
+                      echo "::error::${rid}: sync-tools run ${run_of[$rid]} ended ${st}" ;;
+                  esac
+                  [ -n "${result[$rid]}" ] && push_progress "in progress"
+                fi
+              fi
+              [ -z "${result[$rid]}" ] && pending=1
+            done
+            [ "$pending" -eq 0 ] && break
+            if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$deadline" ]; then
+              echo "::warning::timed out after 3h; some downloads are still running in sync-tools"
+              break
+            fi
+            sleep 60
+          done
+
+          failed=""
+          incomplete=""
+          for rid in "${!run_of[@]}"; do
+            case "${result[$rid]:-pending}" in
+              ok) ;;
+              failed) failed="${failed:+${failed} }${rid}" ;;
+              *) incomplete="${incomplete:+${incomplete} }${rid} (${result[$rid]:-pending})" ;;
+            esac
+          done
+          [ -z "$failed" ] || { echo "::error::failed: ${failed}"; exit 1; }
+          [ -z "$incomplete" ] || { echo "::error::incomplete (not landed): ${incomplete}"; exit 1; }
+
+      - name: Compose comment
+        id: comment
+        if: always() && github.event_name == 'repository_dispatch'
+        env:
+          STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
+          CLUSTERS: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.clusters }}
+        run: |
+          set -uo pipefail
+          case "${STATUS}" in
+            success)
+              if [ -z "${CLUSTERS}" ]; then

+### `/download`
+
+Download the models and datasets added by a PR to the CI model caches. Use it for PRs that change `.github/workflows/misc/model_dataset_list.json`: an NPU test cannot run a model that is not on the cluster disk yet, and the download itself is network bound, so it is delegated to the dedicated model-library pipeline instead of an NPU runner.

+
+| Syntax | Description |
+|---|---|
+| `/download` | Download the models and datasets added by this PR |
+
+The command takes no arguments. It compares `.github/workflows/misc/model_dataset_list.json` at the PR head with `main`, flattens the `models` groups, and requests only the entries that `main` does not list yet. Requests are sent per cluster and only for clusters that receive something, so a PR adding a model to `models.a2` produces a single request and does not touch `a3` or `a5`. Datasets are not per cluster, so a new dataset is requested for every cluster. The pipeline is idempotent, so running the command again is cheap.
+
+The clusters and the `model_dataset_list.json` groups they carry are `a2` → `models.a2`; `a3` (800T disk) → `models.a3` + `models.310p`; `a3-560t` (560T disk used by the accuracy E2E tests) → `models.a3` + `models.310p`; `a5` → `models.a5`. The 310p tests mount the a3 volume, which is why `models.310p` travels with both a3 disks.
+
+The requests are dispatched to `ascend-gha-runners/sync-tools`, which routes each one to the right cluster disks. The workflow itself runs on a CPU runner, so no Ascend runner is occupied, and no repository secret is needed on the PR branch — the command also works for PRs from forks. The run waits up to 3 hours for the dispatched downloads, then comments the per-cluster result with a link to the workflow run.
+
+Adding the `model-dataset-download` label to a PR still triggers the same download. The command is only needed when that run cannot do the work, for example on a PR from a fork (the label-triggered run cannot read the repository secrets), or to retry after the list changed.
+
+**Manual download:** run the **model downloader** workflow from the Actions UI (`workflow_dispatch`). Its inputs are `models` and `datasets` (`org/name` ids, comma or newline separated) and `cluster` (`all`, `a2`, `a3`, `a3-560t` or `a5`). Only the selected clusters are requested, and the items are taken verbatim instead of being diffed against `main`, which makes this the way to repair a cache whose ledger drifted from `model_dataset_list.json`.
+
+> **Note**: unlike most other commands, `/download` does not accept a PR author exception. Only users with triage+ permission can trigger it, because the request is forwarded into another repository's workflow.
